title: Lattice Deduction Transformers
summary: We introduce the Lattice Deduction Transformer (LDT), a recurrent transformer that approximates logically sound deduction by projecting its latent state through a lattice between forward passes. We train on-policy in a process that mirrors deduction in a search-based constraint solver and supervise training via a domain-agnostic, abstract-interpretation-based approximation of the set of solution candidates. An $800$K-parameter LDT achieves $100\%$ accuracy on Sudoku-Extreme and Snowflake Sudoku, at a fraction of the training cost of prior small recurrent reasoners, while remaining empirically sound: the model returns a correct answer or abstains. A $1.8$M-parameter variant reaches $99.9\%$ accuracy on Maze-Hard. Frontier LLMs score $0\%$ on all three benchmarks.

title: Egocentric Whole-Body Human Mesh Recovery with Prior-Guided Learning
comments: Accepted to ICIP 2026. This is the author-formatted version of the paper
summary: Egocentric human mesh recovery (HMR) from monocular head-mounted cameras is increasingly important for AR/VR applications, but remains challenging due to the lack of reliable ground-truth (GT) annotations based on parametric human body models such as SMPL and SMPL-X for real egocentric images. Existing egocentric HMR methods typically rely on pseudo-GT and focus on body pose estimation, which limits their ability to recover fine-grained whole-body details such as hands and face. We study egocentric whole-body human mesh recovery and propose a prior-guided learning framework that reconstructs whole-body meshes from a single egocentric image. We construct more accurate optimization-based pseudo-GT aligned with 3D joint supervision, and leverage multiple priors by adapting an exocentric HMR foundation model together with a diffusion-based pose prior. A deterministic undistortion module is further adopted to handle fisheye distortions in egocentric images. Experiments across multiple egocentric benchmarks demonstrate improved whole-body reconstruction compared to state-of-the-art methods, and show that our optimization-based pseudo-GT is substantially more accurate than existing regression-based pseudo-GT. To facilitate reproducibility, the code and dataset annotations are publicly available at https://github.com/naso06/EgoSMPLX.
comment: Accepted to ICIP 2026. This is the author-formatted version of the paper

title: Sheaves as a Means of Maintaining Consistency in Model-based Systems Engineering
summary: We propose that the sheaf condition on a presheaf of design spaces provides a mathematical model for multi-view consistency in the architecture of cyber-physical systems (CPS). In model-based systems engineering, multiple engineering views -- electrical, thermal, mechanical, and software -- must be kept mutually consistent, yet current practice relies on informal procedures without a precise semantic account of global consistency. We construct an architectural site: a topological space whose points are pairwise interfaces between engineering domains and whose open sets represent engineering views. A design presheaf assigns to each view its local design space and to each inclusion the corresponding restriction map. We show that the sheaf condition on this presheaf is equivalent to compatibility on pairwise overlaps, yielding a local criterion for global multi-view consistency. The equivalence and a concrete three-view worked example are machine-verified in Lean 4 using Mathlib. The formalization establishes that the design presheaf is a sheaf, that the sheaf condition is equivalent to pairwise overlap compatibility, and that compatible local design families glue to unique global designs. Global consistency of an arbitrary number of views can be certified by checking only pairwise interface compatibility; compatible local designs determine a unique global design; derived properties computed by limit-preserving functors inherit the same consistency guarantee; and the entire verification chain admits machine-checkable proofs in Lean.

title: Fluid Antennas Assisted RIS-NOMA Communication Networks
summary: This paper introduces a fluid antenna system (FAS) into reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS) assisted non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA) communication networks, where the non-orthogonal users are equipped with planar fluid antennas. Specifically, we formulate a sum rate maximization problem for FAS-RIS-NOMA networks, which jointly optimizes the fluid ports, the RIS deployment, and the phase shift matrix. To solve the resulting non-convex optimization problem involving highly coupled variables, an iterative algorithm based on alternating optimization is employed to decompose the original problem into three subproblems. Exhaustive search is employed for optimizing the fluid ports, particle swarm optimization is used for the RIS deployment, and semidefinite relaxation with successive convex approximation is adopted for optimizing the phase shift matrix. Finally, the simulation results show that: 1) compared with traditional antenna systems and orthogonal multiple access, the FAS-RIS-NOMA networks achieve higher system throughput under high signal-to-noise ratio conditions; and 2) by increasing the number of RIS elements and enlarging the FAS size, the sum rate of FAS-RIS-NOMA networks can be significantly enhanced.

title: The Echo Amplifies the Knowledge: Somatic Marker Analogues in Language Models via Emotion Vector Re-Injection
summary:
Current language model memory systems store what happened but not how it felt. This distinction -- between semantic memory (knowing about a past event) and episodic memory (re-experiencing it) -- was identified by Tulving as the difference between noetic and autonoetic consciousness. Damasio demonstrated that humans with intact knowledge but absent emotional markers exhibit impaired decision-making.
  We bridge this gap for language models. Using Gemma 3 1B-IT with pretrained Gemma Scope 2 sparse autoencoders, we identify 310 emotion-exclusive features at layer 22 with psychologically valid geometry. We construct distinctive-feature emotion vectors during experience and partially re-inject them during recall, triggered by context similarity at layer 7.
  We test four conditions paralleling Damasio's framework: A (no memory), B (semantic labels), C (emotion echo), and BC (semantic + echo). For emotional orientation, the echo alone steepens the threat-safety gradient: the regression slope of threat rating on contextual similarity is 0.80 for C vs 0.56 for A ($p$=0.011, permutation test). For decisions, the echo amplifies knowledge into action: BC=80% good choices vs B=52% ($z$=+2.60, $p$<0.01), while the echo alone has no effect (C=22%, n.s.). The echo changes how the model feels independently, but changes what it does only when combined with knowledge -- replicating Damasio's core finding.
  The echo amplifies knowledge. It does not replace it.

AI.title_translation: 回声放大知识：通过情感向量再注入实现语言模型中的躯体标记类似物
AI.tldr: 语言模型可以通过情感向量再注入来模拟躯体标记，从而在决策中放大知识，而非取代知识。
AI.motivation: 当前的语言模型记忆系统仅存储“发生了什么”（语义记忆），但未能存储“感受如何”（情景记忆）。人类认知科学研究表明，缺乏情感标记会导致决策障碍。本研究旨在弥合语言模型中这一情感与知识之间的鸿沟，以提升其决策能力。
AI.method: 研究使用 Gemma 3 1B-IT 模型和预训练的 Gemma Scope 2 稀疏自编码器，在第 22 层识别出 310 个具有心理学有效几何特征的独占情感特征。在模型体验过程中构建这些独特的特征情感向量，并在回忆时通过第 7 层的上下文相似性触发，将这些情感向量部分重新注入。实验设计了四种条件（无记忆、语义标签、情感回声、语义+回声）进行测试。
AI.result: 在情感导向方面，单独的情感回声（条件 C）使威胁-安全梯度更陡峭（威胁评分对上下文相似性的回归斜率为 0.80，而无记忆条件 A 为 0.56，p=0.011）。在决策方面，情感回声与语义知识结合（条件 BC）显著提高了良好选择的比例（80%），远高于仅有语义知识（条件 B）的 52%（z=+2.60，p<0.01）。单独的情感回声（条件 C）对决策无显著影响（22%，不显著）。结果表明，回声独立改变了模型的感受，但只有与知识结合时才改变其行为，这复制了达马西奥的核心发现。
AI.conclusion: 情感回声能够放大知识，但不能取代知识。将情感标记（躯体标记类似物）整合到语言模型中，在与语义知识结合时，能够显著改善模型的决策能力。
AI.translation:
当前的语言模型记忆系统存储了“发生了什么”，但没有存储“感受如何”。图尔文将语义记忆（了解过去的事件）和情景记忆（重新体验事件）之间的这种区别，确定为无意识和自知意识之间的差异。达马西奥证明，拥有完整知识但缺乏情感标记的人类表现出决策障碍。
我们为语言模型弥合了这一差距。我们使用 Gemma 3 1B-IT 和预训练的 Gemma Scope 2 稀疏自编码器，在第 22 层识别出 310 个具有心理学有效几何特征的独占情感特征。我们在体验过程中构建了独特的特征情感向量，并在回忆过程中通过第 7 层的上下文相似性触发，部分重新注入这些向量。
我们测试了与达马西奥框架平行的四种条件：A（无记忆）、B（语义标签）、C（情感回声）和 BC（语义+回声）。对于情感导向，单独的回声加剧了威胁-安全梯度：威胁评级对上下文相似性的回归斜率对于 C 为 0.80，对于 A 为 0.56（p=0.011，置换检验）。对于决策，回声将知识放大为行动：BC=80% 的良好选择，而 B=52%（z=+2.60，p<0.01），而单独的回声没有效果（C=22%，不显著）。回声独立地改变了模型的感受方式，但只有与知识结合时才改变其行为——这复制了达马西奥的核心发现。
回声放大了知识。它没有取代知识。
AI.summary: 本研究通过情感向量再注入，为语言模型引入了躯体标记类似物，以弥合当前模型在存储“感受”方面的不足。利用 Gemma 模型和稀疏自编码器，研究者识别并重注了独占情感特征。实验结果表明，情感回声能独立改变模型的感受，并在与语义知识结合时显著提升决策质量，从而验证了达马西奥关于情感标记对人类决策重要性的发现，即情感回声能放大而非取代知识。
AI.keywords: 语言模型, 情感向量, 躯体标记, 决策, Gemma
AI.comments: 这项研究的创新之处在于将人类认知科学中的躯体标记理论引入语言模型，通过模拟情感体验来增强模型的决策能力。它不仅弥补了现有语言模型在情感记忆方面的不足，还通过实验验证了情感与知识结合对智能决策的重要性，为未来AI发展提供了新的视角。

title: ATAAT: Adaptive Threat-Aware Adversarial Tuning Framework against Backdoor Attacks on Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Addressing the escalating security vulnerabilities in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, this study investigates backdoor attacks targeting the visual pathway. We identify a core obstacle causing the failure of traditional attack paradigms: "Gradient Interference." This phenomenon represents an optimization failure triggered by conflicting strategies during end-to-end training. To resolve this, we propose an Adaptive Threat-Aware Adversarial Tuning (ATAAT) framework. Through its core "Threat-Method Adaptive Mapping" mechanism, ATAAT intelligently selects the optimal gradient decoupling strategy based on the adversary's capabilities. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ATAAT exhibits significant advantages, achieving a highly robust Targeted Attack Success Rate (TASR > 80%) while maintaining extreme stealthiness with merely a 5% poisoning rate. It efficiently handles complex semantic-level triggers and achieves implicit decoupled attacks in data poisoning scenarios for the first time. This work reveals a critical security vulnerability in VLAs and provides theoretical and methodological support for future defense architectures.

AI.title_translation: ATAAT：针对视觉-语言-动作模型后门攻击的自适应威胁感知对抗性调优框架
AI.tldr: 本研究提出了ATAAT框架，通过自适应威胁感知对抗性调优来解决视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型中后门攻击的“梯度干扰”问题，首次实现了高效且隐蔽的解耦攻击，揭示了VLA模型的关键安全漏洞。
AI.motivation: 针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型中日益升级的安全漏洞，特别是针对视觉通路的后门攻击，传统攻击范式因“梯度干扰”这一优化失败问题而失效。本研究的动机是解决这一核心障碍。
AI.method: 本研究提出了一个自适应威胁感知对抗性调优（ATAAT）框架。其核心机制是“威胁-方法自适应映射”，该机制能根据对手的能力智能选择最优的梯度解耦策略，以解决“梯度干扰”问题。
AI.result: ATAAT框架在后门攻击中表现出显著优势，实现了高度鲁棒的目标攻击成功率（TASR > 80%），同时保持极高的隐蔽性（中毒率仅为5%）。它能有效处理复杂的语义级触发器，并首次在数据投毒场景中实现隐式解耦攻击。
AI.conclusion: 本研究揭示了VLA模型中一个关键的安全漏洞，并为未来的防御架构提供了理论和方法上的支持。
AI.translation: 针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型中日益升级的安全漏洞，本研究调查了针对视觉通路的后门攻击。我们识别出导致传统攻击范式失败的一个核心障碍：“梯度干扰”。这种现象代表了在端到端训练过程中，由于冲突策略引发的优化失败。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一个自适应威胁感知对抗性调优（ATAAT）框架。通过其核心的“威胁-方法自适应映射”机制，ATAAT根据对手的能力智能选择最优的梯度解耦策略。广泛的实验表明，ATAAT展现出显著优势，实现了高度鲁棒的目标攻击成功率（TASR > 80%），同时保持极高的隐蔽性，中毒率仅为5%。它能有效处理复杂的语义级触发器，并首次在数据投毒场景中实现隐式解耦攻击。这项工作揭示了VLA模型中的一个关键安全漏洞，并为未来的防御架构提供了理论和方法上的支持。
AI.summary: 本研究旨在解决视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型中后门攻击的“梯度干扰”问题，该问题导致传统攻击范式失效。为此，提出了一种自适应威胁感知对抗性调优（ATAAT）框架，其核心是“威胁-方法自适应映射”机制，能够根据对手能力选择最优的梯度解耦策略。实验证明，ATAAT在低中毒率下实现了高目标攻击成功率，并首次在数据投毒场景中实现了隐式解耦攻击，揭示了VLA模型的关键安全漏洞。
AI.keywords: VLA模型, 后门攻击, 梯度干扰, ATAAT, 对抗性调优
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地提出了ATAAT框架，通过解决“梯度干扰”问题，首次实现了对VLA模型的高效且隐蔽的隐式解耦后门攻击，这对理解和防御VLA模型的安全漏洞具有重要意义。其自适应映射机制是关键创新点。

title: Generalization Bounds of Emergent Communications for Agentic AI Networking
comments: Accepted at IEEE ISIT Workshop, Guangzhou, China, June 2026
summary: The evolution of 6G networking toward agentic AI networking (AgentNet) systems requires a shift from traditional data pipelines to task-aware, agentic AI-native communication solutions. Emergent communication, a novel communication paradigm in which autonomous agents learn their own signaling protocols through interaction, is increasingly viewed as a promising solution to address the challenges posed by existing rigid, predefined protocol-based networking architecture. However, most existing emergent communication frameworks fail to account for physical networking constraints, such as bandwidth and computational complexity, and often lack a rigorous information-theoretical foundation. To address these challenges, this paper introduces a novel emergent communication framework that facilitates collaborative task-solving among heterogeneous agents through an information-theoretic lens. We propose a novel joint loss function that unifies the optimization of decision-making functions and the learning of communication signaling. Our proposed solution is grounded on the multi-agent and multi-task distributed information bottleneck (DIB) theory, which allows the quantification of the fundamental trade-off between task-relevant information representation and computational complexity. We further provide theoretical generalization bounds of the emergent communication protocol during decentralized inference across unseen environmental states. Experimental validation on a real-world hardware prototype confirms that our proposed framework significantly improves generalization performance, compared to the state-of-the-art solutions.
comment: Accepted at IEEE ISIT Workshop, Guangzhou, China, June 2026

AI.title_translation: 智能体AI网络中涌现通信的泛化界限
AI.tldr: 针对6G智能体AI网络中现有涌现通信框架的局限性，本文提出了一种基于信息论的新型涌现通信框架，通过联合损失函数和分布式信息瓶颈理论，显著提高了在真实硬件原型上的泛化性能，并提供了理论泛化界限。
AI.motivation: 6G网络向智能体AI网络（AgentNet）演进需要从传统数据管道转向任务感知、智能体AI原生的通信解决方案。涌现通信被视为解决现有僵化预定义协议网络架构挑战的有前景方案，但现有框架未考虑物理网络约束（如带宽、计算复杂度），且缺乏严格的信息论基础。
AI.method: 本文提出了一种新型涌现通信框架，通过信息论视角促进异构智能体间的协作任务求解。该框架提出了一种统一决策函数优化和通信信号学习的联合损失函数，并基于多智能体多任务分布式信息瓶颈（DIB）理论，量化了任务相关信息表示与计算复杂度之间的权衡。此外，还提供了去中心化推理在未见环境状态下涌现通信协议的理论泛化界限。
AI.result: 在真实硬件原型上的实验验证表明，与最先进的解决方案相比，所提出的框架显著提高了泛化性能。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的基于信息论的涌现通信框架，通过创新的联合损失函数和DIB理论，有效解决了现有框架的局限性，并在实际部署中展现出卓越的泛化能力，为AgentNet系统的发展提供了重要支持。
AI.translation: 6G网络向智能体AI网络（AgentNet）系统的演进，要求从传统数据管道转向任务感知、智能体AI原生的通信解决方案。涌现通信作为一种新颖的通信范式，其中自主智能体通过交互学习自己的信号协议，正日益被视为解决现有僵化、预定义协议网络架构所带来挑战的有前景解决方案。然而，大多数现有涌现通信框架未能考虑物理网络约束，例如带宽和计算复杂度，并且通常缺乏严格的信息论基础。为了应对这些挑战，本文引入了一种新型涌现通信框架，通过信息论视角促进异构智能体之间的协作任务求解。我们提出了一种新颖的联合损失函数，它统一了决策函数的优化和通信信号的学习。我们提出的解决方案以多智能体多任务分布式信息瓶颈（DIB）理论为基础，该理论允许量化任务相关信息表示和计算复杂度之间的基本权衡。我们进一步提供了在去中心化推理过程中，跨未见环境状态的涌现通信协议的理论泛化界限。在真实世界硬件原型上的实验验证证实，与最先进的解决方案相比，我们提出的框架显著提高了泛化性能。
AI.summary: 本文针对6G智能体AI网络中涌现通信的现有挑战，提出了一种基于信息论的新型涌现通信框架。该框架通过引入创新的联合损失函数和多智能体多任务分布式信息瓶颈（DIB）理论，解决了物理网络约束和信息论基础缺乏的问题。实验结果表明，该框架在真实硬件原型上显著提升了泛化性能，并提供了涌现通信协议的理论泛化界限。
AI.keywords: 涌现通信, 智能体AI网络, 泛化界限, 分布式信息瓶颈, 信息论
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于将信息论严格地引入到涌现通信框架中，特别是利用分布式信息瓶颈理论来量化信息表示与计算复杂度的权衡，并提供了理论泛化界限。这对于在资源受限的智能体AI网络环境中实现高效、鲁棒的通信至关重要，具有重要的理论和实际意义。在真实硬件上的验证也增加了其可信度。

title: DiagnosticIQ: A Benchmark for LLM-Based Industrial Maintenance Action Recommendation from Symbolic Rules
summary: Monitoring complex industrial assets relies on engineer-authored symbolic rules that trigger based on sensor conditions and prompt technicians to perform corrective actions. The bottleneck is not detection but response: translating rules into maintenance steps requires asset-specific knowledge gained through years of practice. We investigate whether LLMs can serve as decision support for this rule-to-action step and introduce \ours{}, a benchmark of 6{,}690 expert-validated multiple-choice questions from 118 rule-action pairs across 16 asset types. We contribute (i) a symbolic-to-MCQA pipeline normalizing rules to Disjunctive Normal Form with embedding-based distractor sampling, (ii) five variants probing distinct failure modes (Pro, Pert, Verbose, Aug, Rationale), and (iii) a benchmark of 29 LLMs and 4 embedding baselines. A human evaluation (9 practitioners, mean 45.0\%) confirms \ours{} requires specialist knowledge beyond operational experience. Three findings stand out. The frontier has closed: the top three LLMs lie within one Macro point, with Bradley-Terry Elo placing claude-opus-4-6 30 points above the next model. Yet \ours{}\,Pro exposes brittleness, with every model losing 13--60\% relative accuracy under distractor expansion. \ours{}\,Aug exposes pattern-matching: under condition inversion, frontier models still select the original answer 49--63\% of the time. The deployment bottleneck is not capability but calibration: frontier models handle template-style fault detection but break under structural perturbation.

AI.title_translation: DiagnosticIQ：一个基于符号规则的LLM工业维护行动建议基准测试
AI.tldr: 研究推出了DiagnosticIQ基准，揭示了当前大模型在处理工业维护规则时的逻辑推理缺陷，即模型表现出严重的模式匹配依赖，难以应对结构化扰动。
AI.motivation: 工业监控依赖工程师编写的符号规则来触发维护建议，但将规则转化为具体维护步骤需要深厚的专业知识，当前的瓶颈在于如何利用大模型作为决策支持系统来辅助这一过程。
AI.method: 构建了名为DiagnosticIQ的基准测试，包含6,690个专家验证的多选题；开发了符号逻辑到MCQA的转换流水线（转化为析取范式并进行嵌入式干扰项采样）；设计了五种探测故障模式的变体（Pro, Pert, Verbose, Aug, Rationale）；并对29个大模型和4个嵌入模型进行了对比评估。
AI.result: 研究发现前沿模型间表现差距缩小，但claude-opus-4-6具有显著优势；模型在面对干扰项扩展时准确率下降13-60%；在条件反转测试中，模型仍倾向于选择原始答案，证明其存在严重的模式匹配倾向而非逻辑推理。
AI.conclusion: 尽管前沿LLM在工业故障检测任务中表现出一定能力，但在面对结构化扰动和逻辑反转时表现出显著的脆弱性，表明当前的LLM尚不能完全替代人类专家的决策支持工作，亟需在逻辑推理和稳健性上进行改进。
AI.translation: 复杂工业资产的监控依赖于工程师编写的符号规则，这些规则基于传感器状态触发，并提示技术人员执行纠正措施。瓶颈不在于检测，而在于响应：将规则转化为维护步骤需要通过多年实践获得的资产特定知识。我们研究了LLM是否可以作为这一“规则到行动”步骤的决策支持，并引入了DiagnosticIQ，这是一个包含来自16种资产类型的118个规则-行动对、共6,690个经专家验证的多项选择题的基准测试。我们的贡献包括：（i）一个将规则标准化为析取范式并进行基于嵌入的干扰项采样的符号到MCQA流水线；（ii）五个探测不同故障模式的变体（Pro, Pert, Verbose, Aug, Rationale）；以及（iii）一个包含29个LLM和4个嵌入基线的基准测试。人类评估（9名从业者，平均准确率45.0%）证实DiagnosticIQ需要超越操作经验的专业知识。研究得出三个显著发现。前沿模型差距已缩小：前三名LLM在宏观分数上仅相差1分，Bradley-Terry Elo评分显示claude-opus-4-6比下一个模型高出30分。然而，DiagnosticIQ-Pro暴露了模型的脆弱性，所有模型在干扰项扩展下相对准确率下降了13-60%。DiagnosticIQ-Aug暴露了模式匹配问题：在条件反转下，前沿模型仍有49-63%的情况下选择原始答案。部署瓶颈不在于能力，而在于校准：前沿模型可以处理模板式的故障检测，但在结构性扰动下会失效。
AI.summary: 本文提出了DiagnosticIQ基准测试，旨在评估大模型在工业维护中将符号规则转化为具体维护行动的能力。通过对29个模型的测试，研究发现尽管模型具备一定的基础能力，但在面对结构化扰动和逻辑反转时表现出明显的脆弱性和模式匹配依赖，难以达到工业级部署的稳健性要求。
AI.keywords: 大型语言模型, 工业维护, 决策支持, 基准测试, 符号推理
AI.comments: 该研究通过构建大规模专家验证的基准测试，揭示了LLM在工业维护决策支持方面的局限性。其创新点在于将复杂的工业规则转化为结构化的MCQA任务，并设计了多种扰动测试来评估模型的稳健性。研究指出模型虽然在基础任务上表现尚可，但在处理结构化扰动和逻辑反转时表现出明显的“模式匹配”缺陷，为工业级AI的可靠性评估提供了重要参考。

title: DSPE: An Energy-Efficient Edge Processor for DeepSeek Inference with MerkleTree-based Incremental Pruning, Multi-Stage Boothing Lookup and Dynamic Adaptive Posit Processing
comments: Accepted by DAC 2026, Long Beach, CA, USA. 7 pages, 8 figures. Corresponding author: Zhou Wang. †These authors contributed equally to this work: Yuhan Zhang and Zhou Wang
summary: In recent years, DeepSeek has achieved strong inference performance but remains hard to deploy on energy-constrained edge devices. This paper presents the DeepSeek Processing Element (DSPE), an edge-oriented architecture that alleviates the model's heavy computational and energy demands. DSPE introduces three techniques: the MerkleTree-based Incremental Pruning Scheme (MIPS) for secure redundant-vector reduction, the Multi-Stage Boothing Lookup Method (MBLM) for bit-flip-aware approximate multiplication, and the Dynamic Adaptive Posit Processing Mechanism (DAPPM), which introduces a new DA-Posit format and its corresponding hardware multiplication architecture. Implemented in TSMC 28nm CMOS, DSPE achieves 109.4 TFLOPS/W energy efficiency compared with state-of-the-art designs and offers a scalable foundation for edge deployment.

AI.title_translation: DSPE：一种基于MerkleTree增量剪枝、多级Booth查找和动态自适应Posit处理的能效型DeepSeek推理边缘处理器
AI.tldr: DSPE是一个针对能耗受限的边缘设备的DeepSeek推理处理器，通过MerkleTree增量剪枝、多级Booth查找和动态自适应Posit处理技术，实现了109.4 TFLOPS/W的能效。
AI.motivation: DeepSeek在推理方面表现出色，但在能耗受限的边缘设备上部署困难。
AI.method: DSPE处理器引入了三种技术：1. 基于MerkleTree的增量剪枝方案（MIPS）用于安全冗余向量约简；2. 多级Booth查找方法（MBLM）用于比特翻转感知近似乘法；3. 动态自适应Posit处理机制（DAPPM），引入了新的DA-Posit格式及其硬件乘法架构。
AI.result: 在TSMC 28nm CMOS上实现，DSPE实现了109.4 TFLOPS/W的能效，优于现有最先进的设计，并为边缘部署提供了可扩展的基础。
AI.conclusion: DSPE是一种能效高的边缘处理器，通过引入MIPS、MBLM和DAPPM技术，解决了DeepSeek在能耗受限设备上的部署难题，并为未来的边缘部署奠定了基础。
AI.translation: 近年来，DeepSeek在推理性能上取得了显著的成就，但在能源受限的边缘设备上部署仍然很困难。本文提出了DeepSeek处理单元（DSPE），一种面向边缘的架构，可以减轻模型繁重的计算和能源需求。DSPE引入了三种技术：基于MerkleTree的增量剪枝方案（MIPS），用于安全冗余向量约简；多级Booth查找方法（MBLM），用于比特翻转感知近似乘法；以及动态自适应Posit处理机制（DAPPM），它引入了一种新的DA-Posit格式及其相应的硬件乘法架构。DSPE采用TSMC 28nm CMOS工艺实现，实现了109.4 TFLOPS/W的能效，与最先进的设计相比具有优势，并为边缘部署提供了可扩展的基础。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了一种名为DSPE的新型边缘处理器，旨在解决DeepSeek模型在能源受限设备上部署的挑战。DSPE集成了MerkleTree增量剪枝、多级Booth查找和动态自适应Posit处理等创新技术，显著提高了计算效率和能耗表现。实验结果表明，DSPE在TSMC 28nm工艺下达到了109.4 TFLOPS/W的能效，为边缘AI的部署提供了有力的支持。
AI.keywords: DSPE, DeepSeek, 边缘处理器, 能效, Posit
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的边缘处理器DSPE，通过结合多种先进技术（如MerkleTree增量剪枝、多级Booth查找和动态自适应Posit处理）来解决DeepSeek模型在能耗受限设备上的部署难题。其在能效方面的成果（109.4 TFLOPS/W）非常显著，为边缘AI应用提供了重要的技术支撑。然而，论文未详细说明这些技术的具体实现细节及其对模型精度的潜在影响，这可能是未来研究可以关注的方向。

title: Robust Server Defense Against Unreliable Clients in One-Shot Fair Collaborative Machine Learning
comments: Accepted at the 2nd International Conference on Federated Learning and Intelligent Computing Systems (FLICS 2026)
summary: Collaborative machine learning (CML) enables multiple clients to train a global model jointly in a data-distributed setting. To address data privacy and communication efficiency, one-shot CML has been increasingly adopted, where clients communicate with the server only once by sharing synthetic or processed proxy data. This single-round communication, however, eliminates the possibility of iterative correction at the server, making the learning process particularly vulnerable to client unreliability. In this setting, unreliable clients, whether malicious or non-malicious, may provide biased proxy data that favors certain groups, thereby degrading the fairness of the global model and harming minority or unprivileged groups. In this work, we propose a server-side defense framework based on a bilevel optimization formulation. The proposed approach learns client-level weights to mitigate the influence of biased client proxy data while enforcing fairness constraints by using a very small trusted root dataset available at the server. Experimental results on benchmark datasets show that our method improves fairness with little accuracy loss under biased proxy data contributions from unreliable clients. Moreover, the proposed approach remains effective even when unreliable clients make up a majority of the system, consistently outperforming other existing methods.
