title: BadDLM: Backdooring Diffusion Language Models with Diverse Targets
summary: Diffusion language models (DLMs) have recently emerged as an alternative modeling paradigm to autoregressive (AR) language models, enabling parallel generation and bidirectional context modeling. Yet their security implications, particularly their vulnerability to backdoor attacks, remain underexplored. We propose BadDLM, a unified framework for studying backdoor attacks against DLMs with diverse targets. We introduce a trigger-aware training objective that emphasizes target-relevant positions in poisoned samples, and theoretically prove that this objective is equivalent to training under an induced forward masking distribution. Unlike backdoors in autoregressive models, which typically manipulate next-token prediction, this characterization indicates that BadDLM can implant backdoors by exploiting the forward masking process. We instantiate BadDLM across different target levels: concept injection (BadDLM_Concept), semantic attribute steering (BadDLM_Attribute), alignment bypass (BadDLM_Align), and code payload injection (BadDLM_Payload). Experiments on mainstream open-source DLMs show that BadDLM achieves strong attack effectiveness across diverse targets while largely preserving benign utility, and remains effective against defenses designed for AR backdoors. Our findings expose a new class of security risks in diffusion-based language generation and call for defenses tailored to DLM denoising dynamics.

title: D2ACE: Multi-Label Batch Selection Guided by Dual Dynamics and Adaptive Correlation Enhancement
summary: Batch selection is crucial for improving both training efficiency and predictive performance in deep multi-label classification (MLC). Existing batch selection methods typically rely on a single metric to assess instance importance and use static label weights to distinguish label significance, neglecting the dynamic evolution of metric utility and label significance during training. In addition, the method that explicitly exploits label correlations is largely affected by abundant irrelevant labels and insensitive to local label distributions. To address these issues, we propose D2ACE, a novel multi-label batch selection method guided by Dual Dynamics and Adaptive Correlation Enhancement. D2ACE explicitly captures metric and label-level training dynamics by combining stage-wise Bernoulli mixture sampling, which balances uncertainty and noise-resistant hardness, with dynamic label weighting to recalibrate label priorities at each epoch based on current metric statistics. Furthermore, D2ACE introduces a local context-aware correlation enhancement to focus on relevant labels with instance-adaptive dependencies. Extensive experiments on tabular and image benchmarks demonstrate that D2ACE outperforms existing batch selection approaches across various deep MLC models, achieving stronger predictive performance and more efficient correlation modeling.

title: ATLAS: Efficient Out-of-Core Inference for Billion-Scale Graph Neural Networks
comments: Preprint of paper to appear in the proceedings of the 35th International Symposium on High-Performance Parallel and Distributed Computing (HPDC 26): Pranjal Naman and Yogesh Simmhan, "ATLAS: Efficient Out-of-Core Inference for Billion-Scale Graph Neural Networks", in International Symposium on High-Performance Parallel and Distributed Computing (HPDC), 2026
summary: Graph Neural Network (GNN) inference on billion-scale graphs is critical for domains like fintech and recommendation systems. Full-graph inference on these large graphs can be challenging due to high communication costs in distributed settings and high I/O costs in disk-backed Out-of-Core (OOC) settings. Existing OOC systems, operating across disk and memory, primarily focus on GNN training and perform poorly for full-graph inference due to massive read amplification, irregular I/O, and memory pressure. We present ATLAS, a disk-based GNN inference framework that enables efficient full-graph, layer-wise inference on graphs whose topologies, features and intermediate embeddings exceed the available memory on single machines. ATLAS replaces gather-based execution with a broadcast-based model that enables sequential, single-pass streaming reads of features and embeddings per layer. A tiered memory-disk hierarchy with minimum-pending-message eviction, graph reordering and a GPU-accelerated pipeline sustains high throughput within $128$ GiB RAM and $2$ TiB SSD. Across out-of-core graphs with up to $4$B edges and $550$ GiB features and multiple GNN architectures, ATLAS improves end-to-end inference time by $\approx12$--$30\times$ over State-of-the-Art (SOTA) OOC baselines on a single workstation, while remaining within $\approx5\%$ when features fit in memory.

title: Sparsity Moves Computation: How FFN Architecture Reshapes Attention in Small Transformers
summary: Architectural choices inside the Transformer feedforward network (FFN) block do not merely affect the block itself; they reshape the computations learned by the rest of the model. We study this effect in one-layer Transformers trained on digit addition with carry, modular arithmetic, and histogram counting. Comparing dense FFNs, gated linear units (GLUs), mixture-of-experts (MoE), and MoE-GLUs, we find that sparse MoE routing can shift computation from FFN to attention, with the strongest ablation-visible effect on carry-based addition. We decompose this redistribution into reduced per-token FFN capacity and sparse partitioning across experts. Critically, frozen random routing nearly matches learned routing, suggesting that redistribution is driven largely by architectural sparsity rather than router-learned specialization. As a secondary finding, GLU-style multiplicative gating rotates task-relevant Fourier structure out of the per-neuron basis and into distributed subspaces, making neuron-level interpretability less informative while preserving structured computation. We validate these conclusions with random-routing, narrow-FFN, and top-2 MoE controls, plus parameter-matching, activation-function, and width-scaling analyses. Together, these results show that local FFN design choices can have nonlocal consequences for Transformer computation.

title: Let the Target Select for Itself: Data Selection via Target-Aligned Paths
summary: Targeted data selection aims to identify training samples from a large candidate pool that improve performance on a specific downstream task. Many recent methods estimate candidate utility by aggregating local attribution scores along a trajectory induced by the candidate pool. When the pool is heterogeneous, however, this reference trajectory may be misaligned with the dynamics of a target-aligned selected subset, creating what we call reference path bias. We propose an alternative reference path: a validation-induced flow obtained from a short, capacity-limited warmup on the available target validation proxy. Along this path, candidates are scored by a normalized endpoint loss drop, yielding a simple zero-order selection rule that requires no candidate gradients or Hessian approximations. Across controlled logistic, vision, and instruction-tuning experiments, this score is competitive with strong dynamic attribution baselines while substantially reducing warmup and storage cost. Moreover, since the reference trajectory is decoupled from any specific candidate pool, the same compact warmup can be reused across additional pools without recomputing the trajectory.

title: AnyDepth-DETR/-YOLO: Any-depth object detection with a single network
summary: Modern object detectors are static, fixed-depth networks optimized for a single operating point, requiring separate models for different deployment scenarios. We present an any-depth detection framework that enables a single network to span a continuous range of accuracy--efficiency trade-offs by controlling depth at inference time without retraining. Each backbone and neck stage is divided into an essential path, which always executes, and a skippable refinement path; this decomposition preserves the full multi-scale feature hierarchy at every depth configuration, unlike conventional early exiting that discards entire stages. To train such a network, jointly optimizing many sub-networks of varying depth introduces conflicting gradient signals. We address this via self-distillation between only the two extremes, with prediction-level and feature-level alignment losses that enforce stage-wise modularity, ensuring the outputs of each stage remain compatible regardless of the paths taken. Instantiated on RT-DETR and YOLOv12, our full-depth configurations match or surpass their respective SOTA baselines with negligible parameter overhead, while the most efficient configurations achieve up to $1.82\times$ speedup at a cost of only 2.0 AP, all from a single set of weights.

title: GravityGraphSAGE: Link Prediction in Directed Attributed Graphs
summary: Link prediction (inferring missing or future connections between nodes in a graph) is a fundamental problem in network science with widespread applications in, e.g., biological systems, recommender systems, finance and cybersecurity. The ability to accurately predict links has significant real-world applications, such as detecting fraudulent financial transactions or identifying drug-target interactions in biomedicine. Despite a rich literature, link prediction is still challenging, especially for graphs enriched with information on edges (direction) and nodes (attributes). In fact, research on link prediction, especially the one based on Graph Deep Learning (GDL), has mostly focused on undirected graphs, without fully leveraging node attributes. Here, we fill this gap by proposing Gravity-GraphSAGE (GG-SAGE), a modified version of GraphSAGE, a GDL model for node embeddings, composed of a gravity-inspired decoder. This implementation is the first example in the literature of a GraphSAGE backbone adopted for directed link prediction. Using the benchmark datasets Cora, Citeseer, PubMed and 16 real-world graphs from the online Netzschleuder repository, we show that our proposed model outperforms state-of-the-art GDL link prediction techniques. Using further experimental evidence, we relate the quality of the output of our model with various characteristics of the graph, suggesting that our framework scales well when applied to data of increasing complexity.

title: RePO-VLA: Recovery-Driven Policy Optimization for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models remain brittle in long-horizon, contact-rich manipulation because success-only imitation provides little supervision for execution drift, while failed rollouts are often discarded. We introduce RePO-VLA, a recovery-driven policy optimization framework that assigns distinct roles to success, recovery, and failure trajectories. RePO-VLA first applies Recovery-Aware Initialization (RAI), slicing recovery segments and resetting history so corrective actions depend on the current adverse state rather than the preceding failure. It then learns a Progress-Aware Semantic Value Function (PAS-VF), aligning spatiotemporal trajectory features with instructions and successful references. The resulting labels salvage useful failure prefixes via reliability decay, while low-value labels mark drift and terminal breakdowns, teaching differences among nominal, failed, and corrective actions. The data engine turns adverse states into planner-generated or human-collected corrective rollouts, teaching recovery to the success manifold. Value-Conditioned Refinement (VCR) trains the policy to prefer high-progress actions. At deployment, a fixed high value ($v=1.0$) biases actions toward the learned success manifold without online failure detectors or heuristic retries. We introduce FRBench, with standardized error injection and recovery-focused evaluation. Across simulated and real-world bimanual tasks, RePO-VLA improves robustness, raising adversarial success from 20% to 75% on average and up to 80% in scaled real-world trials.

title: Persistent Amortised Analysis, Operationally
summary:
Amortised analysis is a technique for proving a combined time bound for a batch of operations on a data structure, even if some of those operations are expensive. But the traditional method of amortised analysis yields incorrect time bounds when the data structure is used persistently. Persistence allows operations to be performed on previous versions of the data structure, which prevents us from amortising expensive restructuring work. In his seminal book, Chris Okasaki showed how to extend amortised analysis to persistent usage. His method works by extending the data structure with thunks and performing the analysis with debits rather than credits. His argument, that credits are unsound for analysing persistent usage, has become folklore.
  In this paper, we provide a new perspective on the role of debits in Okasaki's work. First, we set up an operational semantics of call-by-value lambda calculus with thunks, and show formally that traditional amortised analysis does not work in a persistent setting. Then we show that, contrary to the folklore, credit-based amortised analysis can be sound in a persistent setting as long as credits are only stored on thunks. Finally, we provide a formal semantics for Okasaki's debit-based approach. Our paper clarifies the formal foundation of Okasaki's work and makes it accessible to a wider audience.

title: Cross-Cultural Transfer of Emoji Semantics and Sentiment in Financial Social Media
comments: Accepted to Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: ACL 2026
summary:
Emojis are widely used in online financial communication, but it is unclear whether they provide transferable sentiment signals across languages, platforms, and asset communities. This study examines the extent to which emoji usage, semantics, and sentiment polarity remain stable across financial communities, and how these layers influence zero-shot sentiment transfer. Using large corpora of Twitter and StockTwits posts in four languages, we measure cross-community divergence and evaluate sentiment models trained under emoji-only, text-only, and text+emoji inputs.
  We find that emoji frequencies differ across communities, especially across languages, but their semantics and sentiment polarity are largely stable. Cross-asset transferability shows minimal degradation, while cross-language transfer remains the most challenging. Including emojis consistently reduces transfer gaps relative to text-only models. These results indicate that financial communication exhibits a partially shared ``emoji code,'' and that emojis provide compact, language-independent sentiment cues that improve model generalization across markets and platforms.

title: Strategic commitments shape collective cybersecurity under AI inequality
summary: The growing integration of AI into cybersecurity is reshaping the balance between attackers and defenders. When access to advanced AI-enabled defence tools is uneven, resource-limited defenders may be unable to adopt effective protection, creating persistent system vulnerabilities. We study the impact of differential AI access using an evolutionary game-theoretic model in a finite population. We first show that when high-capability defence is costly, the population is driven toward low-cost, weak-defence behaviour, sustaining attacks and weakening long-run security. To address this problem, we introduce differential access to AI defence tools by allowing defenders to choose between low- and high-capability protection based on their resources. We then examine the role of a small group of committed defenders who always adopt strong defence and influence others through social learning. Although commitment increases the prevalence of strong defence, it alone cannot stabilise secure outcomes due to high defence costs. We therefore incorporate a targeted subsidy to remove the cost disadvantage from committed defenders. Our analysis shows that subsidised commitment significantly increases strong defence adoption, suppresses successful attacks, and improves overall system resilience. Simulations across a broad parameter space confirm that subsidies consistently outperform commitment alone. In addition, social-welfare analysis shows improved defender outcomes while keeping attacker gains low. These findings suggest that targeted support for key defenders can be an effective mechanism for stabilising cybersecurity in AI-driven environments and provide a theoretical bridge between cybersecurity policy, AI governance, and strategic allocation of defensive AI capabilities.

title: A Controlled Diagnostic Study of Hardware-Induced Distortions in Hardware-Aware Training
summary: Hardware-aware training (HAT) is widely used to improve the robustness of neural networks on non-ideal AI accelerators, such as analog in-memory computing (IMC) systems. However, not all hardware-induced distortions are equally compensable by training. This paper presents a diagnostic framework that models hardware non-idealities as structured perturbations of the forward operator and evaluates their compatibility with gradient-based optimization. We analyze six representative perturbation classes--read noise, variability, drift, stuck-at faults, IR-drop, and ADC discretization--and identify three key diagnostics: gradient expectation consistency, bounded gradient variance, and non-degenerate sensitivity. Our results show a clear separation between perturbations that can be compensated by HAT and those that consistently break optimization. This provides practical guidance for hardware-software co-design, clarifying which non-idealities can be addressed at the training level and which require circuit-, architecture-, or calibration-level mitigation. This study should be interpreted as a controlled empirical analysis under vanilla forward-perturbation HAT, rather than as a universal theory of hardware-aware training.

title: SAMOFT: Robust Multi-Object Tracking via Region and Flow
summary: Multi-object tracking (MOT) is a fundamental task in computer vision that requires continuously tracking multiple targets while maintaining consistent identities across frames. However, most existing approaches primarily rely on instance-level object features for trajectory association, which often leads to degraded performance under challenging conditions such as object deformation, nonlinear motion, and occlusion. In this work, we propose SAMOFT, a robust tracker that leverages pixel-level cues to improve robustness under complex motion scenarios. Specifically, we introduce a Pixel Motion Matching (PMM) module that integrates the Segment Anything Model (SAM) with dense optical flow to refine Kalman filter-based motion prediction using instantaneous foreground pixel motion. To further enhance robustness under unreliable detections, we design a Centroid Distance Matching (CDM) module that performs flexible mask-based centroid matching for low-confidence or partially occluded observations. Moreover, a Distribution-Based Correction (DBC) module models long-tailed motion patterns in a training-free manner using historical optical flow statistics and dynamically corrects trajectory states online. We also incorporate a Cluster-Aware ReID (CA-ReID) strategy to improve the stability and discriminative power of trajectory appearance features. Extensive experiments on the DanceTrack and MOTChallenge benchmarks demonstrate that SAMOFT consistently improves baseline trackers and achieves competitive performance compared with recent state-of-the-art methods, validating the effectiveness of leveraging pixel-level cues for robust multi-object tracking.

AI.conclusion: SAMOFT 通过有效利用像素级线索，显著提高了多目标跟踪的鲁棒性，特别是在复杂运动场景下，并验证了其有效性。
AI.translation: 多目标跟踪（MOT）是计算机视觉中的一项基本任务，它要求在帧间保持一致的身份，持续跟踪多个目标。然而，大多数现有方法主要依赖实例级目标特征进行轨迹关联，这在目标形变、非线性运动和遮挡等挑战性条件下往往导致性能下降。在这项工作中，我们提出了 SAMOFT，一个鲁棒的跟踪器，它利用像素级线索来提高复杂运动场景下的鲁棒性。具体来说，我们引入了一个像素运动匹配（PMM）模块，该模块将 Segment Anything Model (SAM) 与密集光流相结合，利用瞬时前景像素运动来细化基于卡尔曼滤波的运动预测。为了在不可靠检测下进一步增强鲁棒性，我们设计了一个质心距离匹配（CDM）模块，该模块为低置信度或部分遮挡的观测执行灵活的基于掩码的质心匹配。此外，一个基于分布的校正（DBC）模块以无训练的方式，利用历史光流统计数据对长尾运动模式进行建模，并在线动态校正轨迹状态。我们还结合了聚类感知重识别（CA-ReID）策略，以提高轨迹外观特征的稳定性和判别力。在 DanceTrack 和 MOTChallenge 基准上的大量实验表明，SAMOFT 持续改进了基线跟踪器，并与最近的最新方法相比取得了有竞争力的性能，验证了利用像素级线索实现鲁棒多目标跟踪的有效性。
AI.summary: 本文提出 SAMOFT，一种创新的多目标跟踪器，旨在解决现有方法在复杂运动、形变和遮挡下性能不佳的问题。SAMOFT 通过引入像素级线索来增强鲁棒性，具体包括结合 SAM 和密集光流的像素运动匹配 (PMM) 模块以细化运动预测，基于掩码的质心距离匹配 (CDM) 模块处理低置信度或遮挡目标，利用历史光流统计的无训练分布校正 (DBC) 模块，以及提高外观特征稳定性的聚类感知重识别 (CA-ReID) 策略。实验结果表明，SAMOFT 在 DanceTrack 和 MOTChallenge 等基准测试上显著优于基线方法并达到先进水平，证明了像素级信息在鲁棒多目标跟踪中的有效性。
AI.keywords: 多目标跟踪, 像素级线索, SAM, 光流, 鲁棒性
AI.comments: SAMOFT 的创新之处在于其将像素级线索（特别是 SAM 和密集光流）深度整合到多目标跟踪框架中，以克服传统基于实例级特征方法的局限性。PMM、CDM 和 DBC 模块协同工作，分别从运动预测、不确定目标关联和长尾运动模式建模方面提升了跟踪的鲁棒性。CA-ReID 策略也为外观特征匹配提供了更强的判别力。该方法通过引入多种新颖的模块，形成了一个全面的解决方案，特别适用于处理复杂和动态的场景。

title: MAG-VLAQ: Multi-modal Aerial-Ground Query Aggregation for Cross-View Place Recognition
summary: Multi-modal cross-view place recognition remains a fundamental challenge in computer vision and robotics due to the severe viewpoint, modality, and spatial-structure discrepancies between ground observations and aerial references. To address this challenge, we present MAG-VLAQ, a foundation-model-enhanced query aggregation framework for multi-modal aerial-ground cross-view place recognition. Specifically, our approach leverages pre-trained foundation models to extract dense visual tokens from both ground and aerial images, as well as expressive geometric tokens from ground LiDAR observations. These heterogeneous tokens are then projected into a shared embedding space for cross-modal alignment and fusion. As our main contribution, we propose ODE-conditioned VLAQ, which tightly couples neural ordinary differential equations (ODE)-based RGB-LiDAR fusion with vectors of locally aggregated queries (VLAQ). In this design, the VLAQ query centers are dynamically adapted according to the fused multi-modal state. This mechanism allows the final global descriptor to preserve globally learned retrieval prototypes while remaining responsive to scene-specific visual and geometric evidence, significantly improving aerial-ground matching. Extensive experiments on KITTI360-AG and nuScenes-AG validate the effectiveness of our proposed MAG-VLAQ. Notably, on KITTI360-AG, our MAG-VLAQ nearly doubles the state-of-the-art performance, achieving 61.1 Recall@1 in the satellite setting, compared with 34.5 from the closest competing approach.

AI.title_translation: MAG-VLAQ：用于跨视角地点识别的多模态空地查询聚合
AI.tldr: MAG-VLAQ是一个增强了基础模型的多模态空地跨视角地点识别框架。它利用预训练的基础模型从地面和空中图像中提取视觉特征，并从地面激光雷达观测中提取几何特征。这些特征被投影到共享嵌入空间中进行对齐和融合。其主要贡献是提出了一种ODE条件VLAQ，将基于神经常微分方程（ODE）的RGB-LiDAR融合与局部聚合查询向量（VLAQ）紧密结合，显著提高了空地匹配性能，并在KITTI360-AG数据集上将SOTA性能几乎翻倍。
AI.motivation: 多模态跨视角地点识别在计算机视觉和机器人领域仍然是一个基本挑战，主要原因在于地面观测和空中参考之间存在严重的视角、模态和空间结构差异。
AI.method: 本研究提出了MAG-VLAQ框架，这是一个基础模型增强的查询聚合框架，用于多模态空地跨视角地点识别。具体方法包括：1. 利用预训练的基础模型从地面和空中图像中提取密集的视觉标记，并从地面LiDAR观测中提取富有表现力的几何标记。2. 将这些异构标记投影到共享嵌入空间中进行跨模态对齐和融合。3. 提出ODE条件VLAQ作为主要贡献，该方法将基于神经常微分方程（ODE）的RGB-LiDAR融合与局部聚合查询向量（VLAQ）紧密耦合。4. 在此设计中，VLAQ查询中心根据融合的多模态状态进行动态调整，使最终的全局描述符既能保留全局学习的检索原型，又能响应场景特定的视觉和几何证据。
AI.result: 在KITTI360-AG和nuScenes-AG数据集上的广泛实验验证了MAG-VLAQ的有效性。值得注意的是，在KITTI360-AG数据集上，MAG-VLAQ的性能几乎是现有最佳方法的两倍，在卫星设置下实现了61.1的Recall@1，而最接近的竞争方法为34.5。
AI.conclusion: MAG-VLAQ通过创新的ODE条件VLAQ机制，有效解决了多模态空地跨视角地点识别中的挑战，显著提高了匹配性能，并有望在相关领域得到应用。
AI.translation: 多模态跨视角地点识别由于地面观测和空中参考之间存在严重的视角、模态和空间结构差异，仍然是计算机视觉和机器人领域的一个基本挑战。为了解决这一挑战，我们提出了MAG-VLAQ，一个基础模型增强的查询聚合框架，用于多模态空地跨视角地点识别。具体来说，我们的方法利用预训练的基础模型从地面和空中图像中提取密集的视觉标记，并从地面LiDAR观测中提取富有表现力的几何标记。然后，这些异构标记被投影到共享嵌入空间中进行跨模态对齐和融合。作为我们的主要贡献，我们提出了ODE条件VLAQ，它将基于神经常微分方程（ODE）的RGB-LiDAR融合与局部聚合查询向量（VLAQ）紧密耦合。在此设计中，VLAQ查询中心根据融合的多模态状态进行动态调整。这种机制使得最终的全局描述符既能保留全局学习的检索原型，又能响应场景特定的视觉和几何证据，显著提高了空地匹配性能。在KITTI360-AG和nuScenes-AG上的大量实验验证了我们提出的MAG-VLAQ的有效性。值得注意的是，在KITTI360-AG上，我们的MAG-VLAQ性能几乎是现有最佳方法的两倍，在卫星设置下实现了61.1的Recall@1，而最接近的竞争方法为34.5。
AI.summary: 本论文提出了MAG-VLAQ，一个针对多模态空地跨视角地点识别的查询聚合框架。该方法利用预训练的基础模型提取图像和LiDAR的视觉与几何特征，并将其融合到共享嵌入空间。核心创新是ODE条件VLAQ，它将神经ODE驱动的RGB-LiDAR融合与动态调整的VLAQ查询中心结合，使全局描述符兼顾全局原型和场景特定证据，从而显著提升了空地匹配的准确性。实验结果显示，MAG-VLAQ在KITTI360-AG数据集上实现了近乎翻倍的SOTA性能。
AI.keywords: 跨视角地点识别, 多模态融合, 查询聚合, 基础模型, ODE条件VLAQ
AI.comments: MAG-VLAQ的创新点在于其提出的ODE条件VLAQ机制，该机制巧妙地结合了神经常微分方程与局部聚合查询向量，实现了多模态特征的动态自适应融合。这种方法不仅解决了空地跨视角识别中固有的视角、模态和空间结构差异，而且通过在特征描述符中平衡全局检索原型和场景特定信息，显著提升了匹配性能。在KITTI360-AG数据集上取得的近乎翻倍的性能提升，充分证明了其重要性和有效性。该研究为多模态地点识别领域提供了一个强大的新范式。

title: From Passive Reuse to Active Reasoning: Grounding Large Language Models for Neuro-Symbolic Experience Replay
summary: While experience replay is essential for data efficiency in reinforcement learning (RL), standard methods treat the replay buffer as a passive memory system, prioritizing samples based on numerical prediction errors rather than their semantic significance. This approach stands in contrast to human learning, which accelerates mastery by actively abstracting fragmented experiences into behavioral rules. To bridge this gap, we propose Neuro-Symbolic Experience Replay (NSER), a framework that transforms experience replay from a passive sample reuse mechanism into an active engine for knowledge construction. Specifically, NSER addresses the incompatibility between linguistic reasoning and numerical optimization through a novel neuro-symbolic grounding pipeline. It leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) in a zero-shot manner to induce candidate behavioral rules from accumulated trajectories, grounds these insights into differentiable first-order logic representations, and utilizes the resulting symbolic structures to dynamically reweight the replay distribution. By allowing abstract knowledge to directly shape policy optimization, NSER achieves consistent superior sample efficiency and convergence speed across reactive, rule-based, and procedural benchmarks.

AI.title_translation: 从被动重用到主动推理：为神经符号经验回放奠定大型语言模型基础
AI.tldr: NSER框架将经验回放从被动样本重用转变为主动知识构建引擎，利用LLM诱导行为规则并将其转化为可微分逻辑表示，以动态调整回放分布，从而在强化学习中实现卓越的样本效率和收敛速度。
AI.motivation: 标准经验回放方法将回放缓冲区视为被动记忆系统，根据数值预测误差而非语义重要性来优先处理样本，这与人类通过主动抽象经验来加速学习的方式形成对比。本文旨在弥合这一差距。
AI.method: 本文提出了神经符号经验回放（NSER）框架。它通过新颖的神经符号基础管道解决语言推理和数值优化之间的不兼容性。NSER零样本利用大型语言模型（LLMs）从轨迹中诱导候选行为规则，将这些见解转化为可微分的一阶逻辑表示，并利用得到的符号结构动态地重新加权回放分布。
AI.result: NSER通过允许抽象知识直接影响策略优化，在反应式、基于规则和程序性基准测试中，始终实现了卓越的样本效率和收敛速度。
AI.conclusion: NSER框架通过将经验回放从被动样本重用转变为主动知识构建引擎，并在强化学习中实现神经符号基础，显著提高了样本效率和收敛速度，从而弥合了标准经验回放与人类学习之间的差距。
AI.translation: 尽管经验回放对于强化学习（RL）中的数据效率至关重要，但标准方法将回放缓冲区视为被动记忆系统，优先处理基于数值预测误差而非语义重要性的样本。这种方法与人类学习形成对比，人类学习通过主动将零碎经验抽象为行为规则来加速掌握。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了神经符号经验回放（NSER），一个将经验回放从被动样本重用机制转变为主动知识构建引擎的框架。具体来说，NSER通过新颖的神经符号基础管道解决了语言推理和数值优化之间的不兼容性。它以零样本方式利用大型语言模型（LLMs）从积累的轨迹中诱导候选行为规则，将这些见解转化为可微分的一阶逻辑表示，并利用得到的符号结构动态地重新加权回放分布。通过允许抽象知识直接影响策略优化，NSER在反应式、基于规则和程序性基准测试中始终实现了卓越的样本效率和收敛速度。
AI.summary: 本文提出神经符号经验回放（NSER）框架，旨在将强化学习中的经验回放从被动样本重用升级为主动知识构建。针对标准方法忽视样本语义重要性的问题，NSER利用大型语言模型零样本诱导行为规则，并将其转化为可微分的一阶逻辑表示，进而动态调整回放分布。实验证明，NSER在多种基准测试中均展现出卓越的样本效率和收敛速度，通过抽象知识直接指导策略优化，有效弥合了机器学习与人类学习之间的差距。
AI.keywords: 神经符号经验回放, 大型语言模型, 强化学习, 样本效率, 知识构建
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入神经符号经验回放（NSER）框架，创新性地将大型语言模型（LLMs）的语义理解能力与强化学习的经验回放机制相结合。其核心在于将LLM诱导的抽象行为规则转化为可微分的逻辑表示，并用于动态调整回放分布，这是一种将符号推理融入数值优化以提高样本效率的有效尝试。这种方法对于解决RL中长期存在的样本效率低下问题具有重要意义，并为构建更像人类的学习系统提供了新思路。

title: Relational Retrieval: Leveraging Known-Novel Interactions for Generalized Category Discovery
comments: Accepted by ICMR 2026. Generalized category discovery, semi-supervised learning, contrastive learning
summary: In this study, we tackle Generalized Category Discovery (GCD) via a Relational Retrieval perspective, explicitly coupling labeled and unlabeled data through bidirectional knowledge transfer. While existing methods treat these sources separately, missing valuable interaction opportunities, we propose Relational Pattern Consistency (RPC) that enables mutual enhancement. RPC employs One-vs-All classifiers for soft ID/OOD decomposition, then introduces two mechanisms: (i) for known-class preservation, we transfer semantic behavioral alignment; (ii) for category discovery, we leverage the insight that samples from the same category maintain invariant relationships with known-class prototypes, transforming unreliable pseudo-labeling into well-defined relational pattern matching. This bidirectional design allows labeled data to guide unlabeled learning while discovering novel categories through their collective relational signatures. Extensive experiments demonstrate RPC achieves state-of-the-art performance on both generic and fine-grained benchmarks.
comment: Accepted by ICMR 2026. Generalized category discovery, semi-supervised learning, contrastive learning

AI.title_translation: 关系检索：利用已知-新颖交互进行广义类别发现
AI.tldr: 本研究通过关系检索视角解决广义类别发现（GCD）问题，提出关系模式一致性（RPC）方法，通过双向知识迁移显式耦合有标签和无标签数据，实现了最先进的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在广义类别发现（GCD）中单独处理有标签和无标签数据，错失了有价值的交互机会。
AI.method: 提出关系模式一致性（RPC）方法。RPC使用One-vs-All分类器进行软ID/OOD分解，并引入两个机制：(i) 用于已知类别保留，迁移语义行为对齐；(ii) 用于类别发现，利用同一类别样本与已知类别原型保持不变关系的洞察，将不可靠的伪标签转换为明确的关系模式匹配。这种双向设计允许有标签数据指导无标签学习，并通过集体关系签名发现新颖类别。
AI.result: RPC在通用和细粒度基准上均实现了最先进的性能。
AI.translation: 在这项研究中，我们通过关系检索的视角解决了广义类别发现（GCD）问题，通过双向知识迁移显式地耦合了有标签和无标签数据。现有方法将这些数据源分开处理，错失了宝贵的交互机会，而我们提出了关系模式一致性（RPC），它能够实现相互增强。RPC采用“一对多”分类器进行软ID/OOD分解，然后引入两种机制：(i) 对于已知类别保留，我们迁移语义行为对齐；(ii) 对于类别发现，我们利用了这样一个洞察：同一类别的样本与已知类别原型保持不变关系，从而将不可靠的伪标签转换为明确的关系模式匹配。这种双向设计允许有标签数据指导无标签学习，同时通过它们的集体关系签名发现新颖类别。广泛的实验表明，RPC在通用和细粒度基准上均达到了最先进的性能。
AI.summary: 本文通过关系检索视角解决了广义类别发现（GCD）问题，引入了关系模式一致性（RPC）方法。RPC通过双向知识迁移显式地将有标签和无标签数据耦合起来，以实现相互增强。该方法利用One-vs-All分类器进行ID/OOD分解，并通过语义行为对齐来保留已知类别，同时通过关系模式匹配来发现新颖类别。实验结果表明，RPC在多个基准上均达到了最先进的性能。
AI.keywords: 广义类别发现, 关系检索, 关系模式一致性, 双向知识迁移, 伪标签
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了关系检索视角来解决广义类别发现问题，并引入了关系模式一致性（RPC）方法，通过双向知识迁移显式地耦合了有标签和无标签数据。这种方法克服了现有方法单独处理数据源的局限性，通过利用样本与已知类别原型之间的不变关系进行类别发现，提高了伪标签的可靠性。

title: MACAA: Belief-Revision Multi-Agent Reasoning for Open-World Code Authorship Verification
summary: Code authorship attribution (CAA) supports software forensics, plagiarism detection, and intellectual property protection. However, existing supervised CAA approaches suffer from scarce training data and closed-world assumptions: they require sufficient labeled code from fixed candidate-author sets, making training difficult in low-data cases and predictions unreliable for open-world test pairs with unseen samples, or heterogeneous code pairs. Large language models remove task-specific training, but direct prompting depends on costly expert-designed prompts, can hallucinate over complex heterogeneous code pairs, and rarely yields auditable evidence traces. We propose MACAA, a belief-revision-based multi-agent framework for training-free code authorship verification. MACAA comprises a Coordinator and four Expert Agents analyzing layout, lexical, syntactic, and programming-pattern evidence. The Coordinator gathers expert signals for expansion, discounts unreliable evidence through contraction, and resolves conflicts through revision to preserve belief consistency, replacing direct LLM judgment with auditable hypothesis refinement. MACAA achieves 89.15\% F1 on same-language benchmarks and 80.00\% on mixed cross-language pairs, surpassing all baselines.

AI.title_translation: MACAA：基于信念修正的多智能体推理，用于开放世界代码作者身份验证
AI.tldr: MACAA是一个基于信念修正的多智能体框架，无需训练即可验证代码作者身份，解决了现有方法的训练数据稀缺和封闭世界假设问题，并提供可审计的证据。
AI.motivation: 现有监督式代码作者归因(CAA)方法受限于训练数据稀缺和封闭世界假设，导致在低数据和开放世界（未见样本或异构代码）场景下训练困难且预测不可靠。大型语言模型虽然无需任务特定训练，但直接提示成本高、可能产生幻觉且缺乏可审计证据。
AI.method: 提出MACAA，一个基于信念修正的无训练多智能体框架，用于代码作者身份验证。它包括一个协调器（Coordinator）和四个专家智能体（Expert Agents），分别分析布局、词汇、句法和编程模式证据。协调器通过扩展收集专家信号，通过收缩剔除不可靠证据，并通过修正解决冲突以保持信念一致性，从而用可审计的假设细化取代直接的LLM判断。
AI.result: MACAA在同语言基准测试中F1分数达到89.15%，在混合跨语言对中达到80.00%，均超越所有基线方法。
AI.conclusion: MACAA通过其多智能体和信念修正框架，有效解决了代码作者身份验证中的开放世界和训练数据稀缺问题，并提供了优于现有方法的性能和可审计性。
AI.translation: 代码作者归因（CAA）支持软件取证、抄袭检测和知识产权保护。然而，现有的监督式CAA方法存在训练数据稀缺和封闭世界假设的问题：它们需要来自固定候选作者集的足够标注代码，这使得在低数据情况下训练困难，并导致对包含未见样本或异构代码对的开放世界测试对的预测不可靠。大型语言模型消除了任务特定训练，但直接提示依赖于昂贵的专家设计提示，可能在复杂的异构代码对上产生幻觉，并且很少产生可审计的证据痕迹。我们提出了MACAA，一个基于信念修正的无训练多智能体框架，用于代码作者身份验证。MACAA由一个协调器和四个专家智能体组成，分别分析布局、词汇、句法和编程模式证据。协调器收集专家信号进行扩展，通过收缩剔除不可靠证据，并通过修正解决冲突以保持信念一致性，用可审计的假设细化取代直接的LLM判断。MACAA在同语言基准测试中F1分数达到89.15%，在混合跨语言对中达到80.00%，均超越所有基线。
AI.summary: 本文提出了MACAA，一个基于信念修正的无训练多智能体框架，用于解决开放世界代码作者身份验证中训练数据稀缺和现有方法可靠性差的问题。MACAA通过协调器整合四个专家智能体（分析布局、词汇、句法和编程模式）的证据，利用扩展、收缩和修正机制进行可审计的假设细化，从而避免了直接LLM判断的局限性。实验结果表明，MACAA在同语言和跨语言基准测试中均显著优于现有基线。
AI.keywords: 代码作者归因, 多智能体系统, 信念修正, 开放世界, 无训练
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于提出了一个无需训练、基于信念修正的多智能体框架MACAA，有效解决了传统代码作者归因方法在开放世界和低数据场景下的局限性。通过将复杂的判断分解给多个专家智能体并引入信念修正机制，MACAA不仅提升了性能，还提供了可审计的推理过程，避免了大型语言模型直接提示的幻觉问题和缺乏证据痕迹的缺点，具有重要的实践价值。

title: Perception Without Engagement: Dissecting the Causal Discovery Deficit in LMMs
summary: Although Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) have achieved strong performance on general video understanding, their susceptibility to textual prior shortcuts during causal discovery has been recognized as a critical deficit. The underlying mechanisms of this phenomenon remain incompletely understood, as existing benchmarks only measure response accuracy without revealing the sources and extent of the deficit. We introduce ProCauEval, a perturbation-based evaluation protocol that shifts from outcome assessment to mechanism diagnosis, probing causal discovery through five controlled configurations that systematically manipulate visual and textual modalities to decompose their respective contributions to model behavior and dissect the failure modes. Evaluating 17 mainstream LMMs, we find that models faithfully perceive video content yet systematically underexploit it during causal reasoning. We further observe that stronger post-training amplifies rather than mitigates textual prior reliance, and that higher baseline performance correlates with greater fragility under perturbation. To address these, we propose Anti-Distillation Policy Optimization (ADPO), a reinforcement learning framework built on negative teacher alignment, which augments GRPO by explicitly pushing the policy away from a prior-only counterfactual teacher induced by visual corruption. Specifically, ADPO maximizes the divergence between the policy distributions conditioned on the original and visually corrupted inputs, thereby forcing the model to ground its reasoning in visual evidence rather than textual shortcuts. Extensive experiments show that ADPO improves visual engagement without sacrificing fundamental comprehension, thus offering a preliminary step toward reliable causal discovery.

AI.title_translation: 感知而非参与：剖析大型多模态模型中的因果发现缺陷
AI.tldr: 大型多模态模型（LMMs）在因果发现中过度依赖文本先验，即使它们能感知视频内容。本研究提出了ProCauEval评估协议来诊断这一缺陷，并提出了Anti-Distillation Policy Optimization (ADPO) 框架来增强视觉参与，减少对文本先验的依赖。
AI.motivation: 尽管大型多模态模型（LMMs）在视频理解方面表现出色，但在因果发现中，它们容易受到文本先验捷径的影响，这是一个关键缺陷。现有基准只测量响应准确性，未能揭示缺陷的来源和程度，导致对这种现象的底层机制理解不完整。
AI.method: 本研究引入了ProCauEval，一种基于扰动的评估协议，通过系统地操纵视觉和文本模态的五种受控配置来分解它们对模型行为的贡献并剖析故障模式。为了解决发现的问题，本研究提出了Anti-Distillation Policy Optimization (ADPO)，一个基于负教师对齐的强化学习框架。ADPO通过明确地将策略推离由视觉损坏引起的仅先验反事实教师，从而增强GRPO。具体来说，ADPO最大化了在原始输入和视觉损坏输入条件下策略分布之间的差异，迫使模型将其推理建立在视觉证据而非文本捷径上。
AI.result: 评估了17个主流LMMs，发现模型忠实地感知视频内容，但在因果推理过程中系统地未充分利用它。观察到更强的后训练会放大而非减轻对文本先验的依赖，并且更高的基线性能在扰动下与更大的脆弱性相关。ADPO改进了视觉参与，同时不牺牲基本理解。
AI.conclusion: LMMs在因果发现中存在感知与参与脱节的问题，过度依赖文本先验。ProCauEval揭示了这一缺陷的机制，而ADPO提供了一个初步的解决方案，通过增强视觉参与来提高因果发现的可靠性，而不牺牲基本理解。
AI.translation: 尽管大型多模态模型（LMMs）在通用视频理解方面取得了强大性能，但它们在因果发现过程中容易受到文本先验捷径的影响，这已被认为是一个关键缺陷。这种现象的底层机制仍未被完全理解，因为现有基准只测量响应准确性，未能揭示缺陷的来源和程度。我们引入了ProCauEval，一个基于扰动的评估协议，它从结果评估转向机制诊断，通过五种受控配置探测因果发现，这些配置系统地操纵视觉和文本模态，以分解它们各自对模型行为的贡献并剖析故障模式。在评估了17个主流LMMs后，我们发现模型忠实地感知视频内容，但在因果推理过程中系统地未充分利用它。我们进一步观察到，更强的后训练会放大而非减轻对文本先验的依赖，并且更高的基线性能在扰动下与更大的脆弱性相关。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了Anti-Distillation Policy Optimization (ADPO)，一个基于负教师对齐的强化学习框架，它通过明确地将策略推离由视觉损坏引起的仅先验反事实教师来增强GRPO。具体来说，ADPO最大化了在原始输入和视觉损坏输入条件下策略分布之间的差异，从而迫使模型将其推理建立在视觉证据而非文本捷径上。大量的实验表明，ADPO改进了视觉参与，同时不牺牲基本理解，从而为可靠的因果发现迈出了初步一步。
AI.summary: 本研究旨在解决大型多模态模型（LMMs）在因果发现中过度依赖文本先验的缺陷。文章引入了ProCauEval评估协议，通过系统地操纵视觉和文本模态来诊断LMMs的失败模式，发现模型能够感知视频内容但未充分利用。研究还发现，更强的后训练会加剧对文本先验的依赖。为此，本文提出了Anti-Distillation Policy Optimization (ADPO) 框架，一个基于负教师对齐的强化学习方法，旨在通过最大化策略分布差异，迫使模型将推理建立在视觉证据而非文本捷径上。实验证明ADPO能增强视觉参与，提升因果发现的可靠性。
AI.keywords: 大型多模态模型, 因果发现, 文本先验, 视觉参与, 强化学习
AI.comments: 本文揭示了LMMs在因果发现中“感知而不参与”的关键问题，即模型虽能感知视觉信息，但在推理时却过度依赖文本先验。ProCauEval协议的设计非常巧妙，通过扰动来诊断而非仅仅评估结果，为理解LMMs的内部工作机制提供了新视角。ADPO作为一种负向对齐的强化学习方法，试图从根本上解决视觉信息利用不足的问题，其创新性在于反向推动策略，强制模型关注视觉证据。这对于提升LMMs的鲁棒性和可靠性具有重要意义，是未来LMMs发展中值得关注的方向。

title: SimWorld Studio: Automatic Environment Generation with Evolving Coding Agent for Embodied Agent Learning
summary: LLM/VLM-based digital agents have advanced rapidly thanks to scalable sandboxes for coding, web navigation, and computer use, which provide rich interactive training grounds. In contrast, embodied agents still lack abundant, diverse, and automatically generated 3D environments for interactive learning. Existing embodied simulators rely on manually crafted scenes or procedural templates, while recent LLM-based 3D generation systems mainly produce static scenes rather than deployable environments with verifiable tasks and standard learning interfaces. We introduce SimWorld Studio, an open-source platform built on Unreal Engine 5 for generating evolving embodied learning environments. At its core is SimCoder, a tool/skill-augmented coding agent that writes and executes engine-level code to construct physically grounded 3D worlds from language/image instructions. SimCoder self-evolves by using verifier feedback (e.g., compilation errors, physics checks, VLM critiques) to revise environments and autonomously add reusable tools and skills to its library. Generated worlds are exported as Gym-style environments for embodied agent learning. SimWorld Studio further enables co-evolution between environment generation and embodied learning: agent performance feedback guides SimCoder to generate adaptive curricula near the learner's capability frontier, so that environments become increasingly challenging as the embodied agent improves. Three case studies on embodied navigation show that self-evolution improves generation reliability, generated environments substantially improve embodied agent performance that generalizes to unseen benchmarks, and co-evolution yields an 18-point success-rate gain over fixed-environment learning and a 40-point gain over an untrained agent.

AI.title_translation: SimWorld Studio：具有进化编码代理的自动环境生成，用于具身代理学习
AI.tldr: 本研究提出了 SimWorld Studio，一个在虚幻引擎 5 上构建的开源平台，用于自动生成动态的 3D 具身学习环境。其核心是 SimCoder，一个能够根据语言或图像指令编写和执行引擎代码来构建物理真实世界的人工智能代理。SimCoder 通过验证器反馈（如编译错误、物理检查、视觉语言模型批评）进行自我进化，从而改进环境并自主添加可重用工具和技能。生成的环境可导出为 Gym 风格的接口，用于具身代理学习。该平台还支持环境生成与具身学习之间的协同进化，使环境能够根据学习者的能力动态调整难度。实验表明，SimWorld Studio 提高了生成环境的可靠性，显著提升了具身代理的学习性能，并且协同进化策略比固定环境学习带来了更大的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现有的具身代理学习缺乏丰富、多样化且能自动生成的 3D 环境。现有的模拟器依赖手动创建或模板化场景，而基于 LLM 的 3D 生成系统主要产生静态场景，缺乏可验证的任务和标准的学习接口。
AI.method: 介绍 SimWorld Studio，一个基于虚幻引擎 5 的开源平台，用于生成动态的具身学习环境。核心是 SimCoder，一个工具/技能增强的编码代理，它编写和执行引擎级别的代码，根据语言/图像指令构建物理上真实的 3D 世界。SimCoder 通过验证器反馈（如编译错误、物理检查、VLM 批评）进行自我进化，以修改环境并自主添加可重用的工具和技能。生成的环境以 Gym 风格导出，用于具身代理学习。SimWorld Studio 还实现了环境生成与具身学习之间的协同进化，通过学习者的性能反馈来指导 SimCoder 生成适应性课程。
AI.result: SimWorld Studio 在三个具身导航案例研究中表现出色：自我进化提高了生成环境的可靠性；生成的环境显著提高了具身代理的学习性能，并能泛化到未见过的基准；协同进化比固定环境学习带来了 18 个百分点的成功率提升，比未训练的代理带来了 40 个百分点的提升。
AI.conclusion: SimWorld Studio 是一个创新的平台，它通过自动生成和动态适应的 3D 环境，解决了具身代理学习中的关键挑战。SimCoder 的自我进化能力和协同进化机制相结合，显著提高了生成环境的质量和学习效率，为具身智能体的发展开辟了新的途径。
AI.translation: LLM/VLM 驱动的数字代理因可扩展的编码、网页导航和计算机使用沙箱而迅速发展，这些沙箱提供了丰富的交互式训练场。相比之下，具身代理仍然缺乏丰富、多样化且可自动生成的 3D 环境用于交互式学习。现有的具身模拟器依赖手动创建的场景或程序化模板，而最近基于 LLM 的 3D 生成系统主要产生静态场景，而不是具有可验证任务和标准学习接口的可部署环境。我们引入了 SimWorld Studio，一个基于虚幻引擎 5 构建的开源平台，用于生成动态的具身学习环境。其核心是 SimCoder，一个工具/技能增强的编码代理，它编写和执行引擎级别的代码，根据语言/图像指令构建物理上真实的 3D 世界。SimCoder 通过验证器反馈（如编译错误、物理检查、VLM 批评）进行自我进化，以修改环境并自主添加可重用的工具和技能。生成的环境以 Gym 风格导出，用于具身代理学习。SimWorld Studio 还实现了环境生成与具身学习之间的协同进化：代理性能反馈指导 SimCoder 生成接近学习者能力前沿的适应性课程，从而随着具身代理的进步，环境变得越来越具有挑战性。在三个关于具身导航的案例研究中，我们展示了自我进化提高了生成环境的可靠性，生成的环境显著提高了具身代理的学习性能，并且泛化到未见过的基准，协同进化带来了比固定环境学习高 18 个百分点的成功率提升，以及比未训练代理高 40 个百分点的提升。
AI.summary: SimWorld Studio 是一个用于具身代理学习的自动环境生成平台。它使用一个名为 SimCoder 的编码代理，该代理能够根据文本或图像指令在虚幻引擎 5 中创建和修改 3D 环境。SimCoder 通过接收反馈（如错误信息和 VLM 评估）来不断改进其生成能力，并能自主添加新的工具和技能。该平台还支持环境生成与代理学习之间的协同进化，使环境能够根据代理的学习进度动态调整难度。实验结果表明，该方法提高了环境生成的可靠性，并显著提升了具身代理的学习效果，尤其是在导航任务上。
AI.keywords: 具身代理学习, 自动环境生成, 进化编码代理, SimWorld Studio, 协同进化
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种新颖的自动环境生成方法，解决了具身代理学习中的一个关键瓶颈。SimCoder 的自我进化和与学习代理的协同进化机制非常有前景，能够创建动态且具有挑战性的学习环境。然而，其在复杂现实世界场景中的可扩展性和效率仍有待进一步验证。此外，对 VLM 批评的依赖可能引入其固有的偏差和局限性。

title: Tabular Foundation Model for Generative Modelling
summary: Generative modelling is a demanding test of foundation models, because it requires robust, holistic representation learning for a given data modality, rather than optimisation for a supervised prediction target alone. While recent work on tabular foundation models has achieved remarkable progress in predictive modelling, generative tabular foundation models remain underexplored. Existing tabular foundation generators, in particular, have not yet consistently matched strong dataset-specific generators in synthetic data quality. A key reason is their misalignment with the distinctive causal structural prior of heterogeneous tabular data. In this paper, we address this gap by introducing a novel tabular foundation model, \textbf{TabFORGE}, built on pretrained \textbf{Tab}ular \textbf{FO}undational \textbf{R}epresentations for \textbf{GE}neration. TabFORGE is designed to utilise the implicitly learned causal information underlying diverse tabular datasets in a unified latent space induced by a pretrained causality-aware feature encoder. It further decouples latent modelling from decoding through a two-stage design: we first pretrain a score-based diffusion transformer, and then pretrain a denoising-aligned decoder using the denoised latent embeddings. This design elegantly mitigates the distribution shifts in latent embeddings that typically arise between training and inference. We evaluate TabFORGE comprehensively against 22 benchmark methods on 45 real-world datasets. Our results show that TabFORGE effectively learns and leverages generalisable tabular representations, enabling efficient generation of high-quality synthetic tabular data, particularly with strong structural fidelity.

AI.title_translation: 用于生成建模的表格基础模型
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了TabFORGE，一个用于生成建模的新型表格基础模型，通过利用预训练的因果感知特征编码器和两阶段的潜在空间建模来生成高质量的合成表格数据，并在基准测试中表现优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有表格基础模型在生成建模方面仍有待提高，未能一致地匹配特定数据集的生成器，主要原因是未能充分利用表格数据独特的因果结构先验。
AI.method: 提出TabFORGE模型，该模型基于预训练的表格基础表示。它利用因果感知特征编码器在统一的潜在空间中学习到的因果信息，并通过两阶段设计（预训练得分基扩散Transformer，然后使用去噪后的潜在嵌入预训练去噪对齐的解码器）来解耦潜在建模和解码，以缓解潜在嵌入的分布偏移。
AI.result: TabFORGE在45个真实世界数据集的22个基准方法上进行了全面评估，结果表明该模型能有效学习和利用可泛化的表格表示，高效生成高质量的合成表格数据，尤其在结构保真度方面表现出色。
AI.conclusion: TabFORGE通过利用表格数据的因果结构先验和创新的两阶段潜在空间建模方法，成功解决了表格生成建模的挑战，并在生成高质量、结构保真的合成表格数据方面取得了显著进展。
AI.translation: 生成建模是对基础模型要求极高的测试，因为它需要对给定数据模态进行鲁棒、全面的表示学习，而不仅仅是针对监督预测目标进行优化。尽管近期的表格基础模型研究在预测建模方面取得了显著进展，但生成式表格基础模型仍未得到充分探索。特别是，现有的表格基础生成器在合成数据质量方面尚未能持续匹配强大的特定数据集生成器。一个关键原因是它们未能与异构表格数据独特的因果结构先验保持一致。在本研究中，我们通过引入一种新颖的表格基础模型 	extbf{TabFORGE} 来解决这一差距，该模型基于预训练的 	extbf{Tab}ular 	extbf{FO}undational 	extbf{R}epresentations for 	extbf{GE}neration（用于生成的表格基础表示）。TabFORGE旨在利用多样化表格数据潜在的因果信息，在一个由预训练的因果感知特征编码器诱导的统一潜在空间中。它通过两阶段设计进一步解耦了潜在建模和解码：我们首先预训练一个基于得分的扩散Transformer，然后使用去噪后的潜在嵌入预训练一个去噪对齐的解码器。这种设计巧妙地缓解了训练和推理之间通常出现的潜在嵌入的分布偏移。我们在45个真实世界数据集上对TabFORGE与22个基准方法进行了全面评估。我们的结果表明，TabFORGE能够有效学习和利用可泛化的表格表示，能够高效地生成高质量的合成表格数据，尤其是在具有强大结构保真度的情况下。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了TabFORGE，一个创新的表格基础模型，专注于生成建模。与以往的表格基础模型不同，TabFORGE利用了表格数据特有的因果结构先验。它通过一个因果感知特征编码器将数据映射到一个统一的潜在空间，并采用两阶段的生成过程（扩散Transformer预训练和去噪对齐解码器预训练）来生成高质量的合成表格数据。实验结果表明，TabFORGE在生成数据的质量和结构保真度方面均优于现有方法。
AI.keywords: 表格基础模型, 生成建模, TabFORGE, 因果结构, 合成数据
AI.comments: 该研究提出的TabFORGE模型在表格生成建模领域具有重要意义，它成功地将因果推理的思想融入到基础模型的设计中，解决了现有模型在生成数据质量和结构保真度方面的不足。两阶段的设计也有效地处理了潜在空间的分布偏移问题，提高了模型的稳定性和性能。未来的工作可以进一步探索TabFORGE在不同类型的表格数据和更复杂的生成任务中的应用。

title: AtteConDA: Attention-Based Conflict Suppression in Multi-Condition Diffusion Models and Synthetic Data Augmentation
comments: 44 pages, 20 figures. Code and project page available at: https://github.com/ShogoNoguchi/AtteConDA
summary: Recent conditional image generation methods can improve controllability by generating images that are faithful to conditions such as sketches, human poses, segmentation maps, and depth. By applying these techniques to image augmentation while preserving annotations, generated images can be used as additional training data and can improve recognition performance. However, for high-level driving tasks such as traffic-rule extraction and driving-behavior understanding, simply using annotations as conditions is insufficient. Instead, images must be augmented while preserving the detailed high-level structure of the original scene. One possible solution is to use multiple conditions so that generated images retain diverse structural cues after generation. However, when multiple conditions are used, conflicts among conditions can prevent reliable structure preservation. In this work, we input semantic segmentation, depth, and edges extracted from the original image into a multi-condition image generation model, thereby providing rich structural information as conditions. We further propose a modeling approach for handling conflicts among multiple conditions and show that it enables image generation with stronger structural preservation. We also build a generation framework and evaluation protocol for driving tasks, establishing a basis for comparison with prior and future models. As a result, this work contributes to image generation research by addressing condition conflicts in multi-condition generation and provides an important step toward mitigating data scarcity in high-level autonomous-driving tasks.
comment: 44 pages, 20 figures. Code and project page available at: https://github.com/ShogoNoguchi/AtteConDA

AI.title_translation: AtteConDA：多条件扩散模型中的基于注意力机制的冲突抑制与合成数据增强
AI.tldr: 提出AtteConDA方法以解决多条件图像生成中的条件冲突，通过强化结构保持，有效提升了自动驾驶任务中的数据增强质量。
AI.motivation: 现有条件生成模型在处理高层自动驾驶任务时，仅凭单一标注无法保留复杂场景结构，而多条件生成又常因条件间冲突导致结构保持失效，因此需要解决多条件生成中的冲突抑制问题。
AI.method: 提出AtteConDA方法，将语义分割、深度图和边缘检测作为多重条件输入，并设计了一种专门处理这些条件间冲突的建模方法，同时构建了针对自动驾驶任务的生成框架与评估协议。
AI.result: 实验表明，所提出的方法能够实现更强的结构保持，生成的图像更适用于自动驾驶任务中的数据增强，并建立了一套标准的评估协议。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的AtteConDA方法有效解决了多条件生成中的冲突问题，提升了生成图像的结构保持能力，为缓解自动驾驶高层任务中的数据稀缺问题提供了有效途径。
AI.translation: 近期的条件图像生成方法通过生成忠实于草图、人体姿态、分割图和深度等条件的图像，提高了可控性。通过在保留标注的同时将这些技术应用于图像增强，生成的图像可用作额外的训练数据，从而提升识别性能。然而，对于交通规则提取和驾驶行为理解等高层驾驶任务，仅将标注作为条件是不够的。相反，必须在保留原始场景详细高层结构的同时对图像进行增强。一种可能的解决方案是使用多种条件，以便生成的图像在生成后保留多样化的结构线索。然而，当使用多种条件时，条件之间的冲突可能会阻碍可靠的结构保持。在这项工作中，我们将从原始图像中提取的语义分割、深度和边缘信息输入到多条件图像生成模型中，从而提供丰富的结构信息作为条件。我们进一步提出了一种处理多种条件之间冲突的建模方法，并证明它能够实现具有更强结构保持能力的图像生成。我们还为驾驶任务构建了一个生成框架和评估协议，为与先前和未来模型的比较奠定了基础。因此，这项工作通过解决多条件生成中的条件冲突，为图像生成研究做出了贡献，并为缓解高层自动驾驶任务中的数据稀缺迈出了重要一步。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为AtteConDA的注意力机制，旨在解决多条件扩散模型在图像生成过程中的条件冲突问题。通过整合语义分割、深度和边缘信息，该方法能够更好地保留复杂场景的结构，从而为自动驾驶领域的数据增强提供高质量的合成数据。
AI.keywords: 多条件扩散模型, 条件冲突抑制, 数据增强, 自动驾驶, 结构保持
AI.comments: 该研究针对多条件扩散模型中的条件冲突问题提出了创新性解决方案，对于自动驾驶领域中高质量合成数据增强具有重要的应用价值和理论指导意义。其局限性在于未在文中提及该方法在极端天气或复杂动态场景下的表现。

title: FedCIGAR: A Personalized Reconstruction Approach for Federated Graph-level Anomaly Detection
summary: Graph-level anomaly detection (GLAD) is crucial for ensuring the reliability of graph-driven applications by identifying abnormal graphs that deviate from the majority. Considering the privacy concerns in distributed scenarios, federated graph-level anomaly detection (FedGLAD) has emerged as a promising solution to enable collaborative detection without sharing raw data. However, existing methods suffer from poor generalization due to the reliance on unrealistic synthetic anomalies and insufficient personalization capabilities under data heterogeneity. To address these challenges, we propose a novel Federated graph-level anomaly detection approach with Cluster-adaptIve GAted Reconstruction (FedCIGAR). Specifically, we design a reconstruction-based paradigm trained on normal graphs to avoid synthetic data. Furthermore, we introduce a client-side node contribution gating mechanism and a server-side sliding window-based clustering strategy to tackle data heterogeneity. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FedCIGAR achieves superior performance and robustness in contrast to state-of-the-art methods.

AI.title_translation: 联邦图级别异常检测的个性化重构方法
AI.tldr: FedCIGAR通过客户方节点贡献门控和服务器方滑动窗口聚类来解决联邦图级别异常检测中的数据异构性问题，并在正常图上进行训练以避免合成数据，从而实现更好的泛化能力和个性化。
AI.motivation: 现有的联邦图级别异常检测方法存在泛化能力差（依赖不切实际的合成异常）和个性化能力不足（数据异构性）的问题。
AI.method: 提出一种基于重构的范式，在正常图上进行训练，避免使用合成数据；引入客户方节点贡献门控机制和服务器方滑动窗口聚类策略来处理数据异构性。
AI.result: FedCIGAR在与最先进的方法相比时，表现出优越的性能和鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: FedCIGAR通过其新颖的重构范式和处理数据异构性的机制，有效地解决了联邦图级别异常检测中的挑战，并取得了优于现有方法的性能。
AI.translation: 图级别异常检测（GLAD）对于通过识别偏离大多数的异常图来确保图驱动应用程序的可靠性至关重要。考虑到分布式场景下的隐私问题，联邦图级别异常检测（FedGLAD）已成为一种有前景的解决方案，可以在不共享原始数据的情况下进行协作检测。然而，现有方法由于依赖于不切实际的合成异常和在数据异构性下个性化能力不足，存在泛化能力差的问题。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种新颖的具有聚类自适应门控重构（FedCIGAR）的联邦图级别异常检测方法。具体来说，我们设计了一种在正常图上进行训练的基于重构的范式，以避免合成数据。此外，我们引入了一种客户端节点贡献门控机制和一种基于服务器端的滑动窗口聚类策略来解决数据异构性。大量的实验表明，与最先进的方法相比，FedCIGAR取得了优越的性能和鲁棒性。
AI.summary: FedCIGAR是一种新颖的联邦图级别异常检测方法，它通过在正常图上进行重构训练来克服对合成异常的依赖，并通过客户端节点贡献门控和服务器端聚类来解决数据异构性问题，从而提高泛化能力和个性化水平。
AI.keywords: 联邦图级别异常检测, 个性化, 数据异构性, 重构, 聚类
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种在联邦学习框架下进行图级别异常检测的方法（FedCIGAR），着重解决了现有方法在处理数据异构性和避免使用合成异常数据方面的不足。其创新的地方在于引入了客户方节点贡献门控和服务器方滑动窗口聚类策略，并采用了基于重构的范式。这些方法有望提高模型的泛化能力和个性化水平，在保护数据隐私的同时实现更准确的异常检测。

title: Evading Visual Aphasia: Contrastive Adaptive Semantic Token Pruning for Vision-Language Models
summary: Are low-attention visual tokens truly redundant in vision-language reasoning? Existing pruning methods often assume so, ranking visual tokens by shallow text-to-image attention and discarding low-scoring patches to accelerate LVLM inference. We show that this scalar criterion is unreliable for compositional reasoning: tokens ignored in early layers can later become essential for resolving secondary objects, spatial relations, and contextual cues. Premature pruning can therefore induce Visual Aphasia, a failure mode in which the model loses visual grounding and falls back on language priors. We introduce COAST (COntrastive Adaptive Semantic Token Pruning), a training-free pruning framework that casts compression as adaptive semantic routing. COAST uses native cross-modal attention to identify query-specific anchors and estimate contextual dispersion via attention entropy, then adapts the retention trade-off between semantic evidence and spatial context. It further uses a contrastive routing score to preserve both anchor-aligned evidence and complementary spatial context. Across seven benchmarks, COAST reduces visual tokens by 77.8% and achieves a 2.15x latency speedup while retaining 98.64% of the original average performance. Beyond a single backbone or compression setting, COAST consistently outperforms strong pruning baselines across token budgets and generalizes across multiple LVLM families, showing that adaptive semantic routing is a robust alternative to one-shot scalar pruning

AI.title_translation: 逃离视觉失语症：视觉语言模型的对比自适应语义令牌修剪
AI.tldr: 现有的视觉令牌修剪方法过于依赖浅层注意力，可能导致视觉失语症。COAST 框架通过对比自适应语义路由来解决这个问题，在显著减少视觉令牌数量和提高推理速度的同时，保持了模型性能。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉令牌修剪方法假设低注意力令牌是多余的，但这种方法在进行组合推理时不可靠，可能导致模型丢失视觉基础，并依赖语言先验（视觉失语症）。
AI.method: COAST 框架通过对比自适应语义路由来压缩模型。它利用跨模态注意力识别查询特定的锚点，并通过注意力熵估计上下文离散度，然后调整语义证据和空间上下文之间的保留权衡。此外，它使用对比路由分数来保留与锚点对齐的证据和互补的空间上下文。
AI.result: COAST 在七个基准测试中，将视觉令牌减少了 77.8%，实现了 2.15 倍的延迟加速，同时保留了原始性能的 98.64%。
AI.conclusion: COAST 是一种有效的训练前修剪框架，通过自适应语义路由解决了现有方法的问题，在保持模型性能的同时显著提高了效率，并且具有良好的泛化能力。
AI.translation: 现有的视觉令牌修剪方法是否真的在视觉语言推理中是多余的？现有的修剪方法通常是这样假设的，通过浅层的文本到图像注意力对视觉令牌进行排序，并丢弃得分较低的图像块以加速 LVLM 推理。我们表明，这种标量标准对于组合推理是不可靠的：在早期层被忽略的令牌后来可能对于解决次要对象、空间关系和上下文线索至关重要。因此，过早的修剪会导致视觉失语症，这是一种模型丢失视觉基础并依赖语言先验的故障模式。我们引入了 COAST（对比自适应语义令牌修剪），一个训练前修剪框架，将压缩视为自适应语义路由。COAST 使用本地跨模态注意力来识别查询特定的锚点，并通过注意力熵来估计上下文离散度，然后调整语义证据和空间上下文之间的保留权衡。它进一步使用对比路由分数来保留与锚点对齐的证据和互补的空间上下文。在七个基准测试中，COAST 将视觉令牌减少了 77.8%，实现了 2.15 倍的延迟加速，同时保留了原始平均性能的 98.64%。COAST 超越了单一骨干或压缩设置，在令牌预算范围内始终优于强大的修剪基线，并能跨多个 LVLM 系列进行泛化，表明自适应语义路由是单次标量修剪的稳健替代方案。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种名为 COAST 的新颖视觉语言模型（LVLM）压缩框架，旨在解决现有修剪方法因过早丢弃低注意力视觉令牌而导致的“视觉失语症”问题。COAST 采用训练前、无监督的方法，将压缩视为自适应语义路由。它通过分析跨模态注意力来识别关键的语义“锚点”，并利用注意力熵评估上下文信息量。通过一种对比路由机制，COAST 能够动态平衡语义证据和空间上下文的保留，确保即使是早期被忽略的令牌也能在需要时被有效利用。实验结果表明，COAST 在大幅减少视觉令牌数量（77.8%）和提高推理速度（2.15x 延迟加速）的同时，仅损失了极少量的性能（98.64% 的平均性能保留）。该方法在多个基准测试和不同的 LVLM 模型上都表现出优越的性能和泛化能力，为 LVLM 的高效推理提供了一种有效的解决方案。
AI.keywords: 视觉语言模型, 模型压缩, 令牌修剪, 对比学习, 自适应路由
AI.comments: 该研究提出的 COAST 框架在解决视觉语言模型（LVLM）的效率问题上取得了显著进展。通过引入“自适应语义路由”的概念，并结合对比学习机制，有效地解决了传统修剪方法可能导致的“视觉失语症”问题。其训练前、无监督的特性增加了其实用性。实验结果令人印象深刻，表明该方法在保持模型性能的同时，能够大幅提升推理速度并减少计算资源消耗。然而，对于 COAST 在更广泛的 LVLM 架构和不同模态（如音频、视频）上的泛化能力，以及其在实际部署中的鲁棒性，还需要进一步的验证。

title: FlashAR: Efficient Post-Training Acceleration for Autoregressive Image Generation
comments: Post-training acceleration for autoregressive image generation
summary: Large-scale autoregressive models have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in image generation. However, their sequential raster-scan decoding relies on strictly next-token prediction, making inference prohibitively expensive. Existing acceleration methods typically either introduce entirely new generation paradigms that necessitate costly pre-training from scratch, or enable parallel generation at the expense of a training-inference gap or altered prediction objectives. In this paper, we introduce FlashAR, a lightweight post-training adaptation framework that efficiently adapts a pre-trained raster-scan autoregressive model into a highly parallel generator based on two-way next-token prediction. Our key insight is that effective adaptation should minimize modifications to the pre-trained model's original training objective to preserve its learned prior. Accordingly, we retain the original AR head as a horizontal head for row-wise prediction and introduce a complementary, lightweight vertical head for column-wise prediction. To facilitate efficient adaptation, we branch the vertical head from an intermediate layer rather than the final layer, bypassing the inherent horizontal head bias. Moreover, since horizontal and vertical predictions capture complementary dependencies whose relative importance varies across target positions, we employ a learnable fusion gate to dynamically combine the two predictions at each position. To further reduce adaptation cost, we propose a two-stage adaptation pipeline: the vertical head is first initialized through adaptation from the pre-trained autoregressive model before jointly fine-tuned with backbone to adapt to the new decoding paradigm. Extensive experiments on LlamaGen and Emu3.5 show that FlashAR achieves up to a 22.9x speedup for 512x512 image generation through a lightweight post-training with merely 0.05% of the original training data.
comment: Post-training acceleration for autoregressive image generation

AI.title_translation: FlashAR：自回归图像生成的有效训练后加速
AI.tldr: FlashAR是一种轻量级的训练后自回归模型加速框架，通过引入双向预测和可学习融合门，在不改变预训练模型原有目标的情况下，实现高效的并行图像生成，实验证明其在生成512x512图像时可达22.9倍加速。
AI.motivation: 自回归模型在图像生成方面表现出色，但其顺序解码方式导致推理成本高昂。现有加速方法要么需要昂贵的从头预训练，要么在并行生成时牺牲训练-推理一致性或改变预测目标。
AI.method: FlashAR通过引入一个轻量级的垂直预测头，并保留原有的水平预测头，实现双向预测。垂直头从中间层分支以减少对原有水平头偏置的影响。使用可学习融合门动态结合水平和垂直预测。采用两阶段训练：先单独适配垂直头，再与主干网络联合微调。
AI.result: FlashAR在LlamaGen和Emu3.5上进行了实验，在生成512x512图像时，通过使用0.05%的原始训练数据进行训练后适配，实现了高达22.9倍的加速。
AI.conclusion: FlashAR是一种有效的训练后适配框架，能够将预训练的自回归模型高效地转换为并行生成器，显著提高推理速度，同时最大限度地保留预训练模型的性能。
AI.translation: 大型自回归模型在图像生成方面展现了卓越的能力。然而，它们顺序的光栅扫描解码依赖于严格的下一个词预测，使得推理成本高昂。现有的加速方法通常要么引入需要昂贵地从头预训练的全新生成范式，要么在牺牲训练-推理差距或改变预测目标的情况下实现并行生成。在本文中，我们介绍了FlashAR，一个轻量级的训练后适配框架，它能将预训练的光栅扫描自回归模型高效地适配成一个基于双向下一个词预测的高度并行生成器。我们的关键见解是，有效的适配应最大限度地减少对预训练模型原有训练目标的修改，以保留其学习到的先验知识。因此，我们保留了原有的AR头作为用于逐行预测的水平头，并引入了一个互补的、轻量级的垂直头用于逐列预测。为了便于高效适配，我们从中间层而不是最终层分支垂直头，从而绕过了固有的水平头偏置。此外，由于水平和垂直预测捕捉了互补的依赖关系，其相对重要性因目标位置而异，我们采用了一个可学习的融合门来动态地在每个位置组合这两种预测。为了进一步降低适配成本，我们提出了一种两阶段的适配流程：首先通过从预训练自回归模型进行适配来初始化垂直头，然后与主干网络联合微调，以适应新的解码范式。在LlamaGen和Emu3.5上的广泛实验表明，FlashAR通过轻量级的训练后适配，仅使用0.05%的原始训练数据，在生成512x512图像时实现了高达22.9倍的加速。
AI.summary: FlashAR是一种创新的训练后加速框架，通过引入双向预测（水平和垂直）和动态融合机制，解决了自回归图像生成模型推理效率低下的问题。该方法无需从头预训练，仅需少量数据进行微调，即可显著提升生成速度，同时保持模型性能。
AI.keywords: 自回归图像生成, 模型加速, 训练后适配, 并行生成, FlashAR
AI.comments: FlashAR通过巧妙地引入垂直预测头并结合可学习的融合门，在不破坏预训练模型原有能力的情况下实现了高效的并行化，这是一个重要的贡献。其两阶段训练策略和仅使用极少量数据进行适配的优势，使得该方法在实际应用中具有很高的吸引力。未来的工作可以探索更复杂的双向预测模式或更精细的融合机制。

title: PumpSense: Real-Time Detection and Target Extraction of Crypto Pump-and-Dumps on Telegram
comments: Accepted to the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Cryptocurrency (ICBC)
summary: Cryptocurrency pump-and-dump schemes coordinated via Telegram threaten market integrity. However, existing research addressing this specific threat has not yet produced solutions that combine reliable results with fast response. This is in part due to the absence of publicly available, message-level labeled data, as well as design choices. In this paper, we address both issues. In particular, we introduce a corpus of over 280,000 Telegram posts from 39 pump-organizing groups, all manually reviewed to identify 2,246 pump announcements and their targeted cryptocurrency and exchange. Leveraging this dataset, we define two tasks: real-time pump-announcement detection and target cryptocurrency/exchange extraction. For detection, we compare two machine-learning models: a lightweight tree-based LightGBM classifier (F1=0.79, latency=9.4 s/sample) and a transformer-based BGE-M3 (F1=0.83, latency=50 ms/sample). With our proposed approach, we show that message analysis can achieve near-instant pump detection at the level of individual Telegram message windows. Unlike prior work that relies purely on market data and typically detects pumps tens of seconds after abnormal trading activity is observed, our method operates directly on the coordination messages themselves and can be evaluated in microseconds per window on commodity hardware. To our knowledge, we also establish the first benchmark for manipulated coin and exchange extraction. We demonstrate that traditional rule-based extraction methods, widely relied upon in prior literature, are ineffective due to ticker ambiguity. In contrast, LLMs achieve the highest accuracy with a score of 0.91.
comment: Accepted to the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Cryptocurrency (ICBC)

AI.title_translation: PumpSense：Telegram上加密货币“拉高抛售”行为的实时检测与目标提取
AI.tldr: 通过分析Telegram协调消息而非滞后的市场数据，PumpSense系统实现了加密货币“拉高抛售”行为的近乎实时检测与目标资产精准提取。
AI.motivation: 现有的“拉高抛售”检测方案存在响应速度慢、缺乏高质量标注数据以及依赖滞后的市场数据等问题。
AI.method: 构建了包含28万条Telegram帖子的标注数据集；开发了基于LightGBM和BGE-M3模型的检测算法；利用大语言模型（LLM）实现目标加密货币与交易所的精准提取。
AI.result: BGE-M3模型在检测任务中达到0.83的F1分数，延迟仅为50毫秒；LLM在目标资产提取任务中达到了0.91的准确率。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明了直接分析Telegram协调消息能够实现近乎实时的“拉高抛售”检测，且在大语言模型的辅助下，能够有效解决目标资产提取中的歧义问题。
AI.translation: 通过Telegram协调的加密货币“拉高抛售”计划威胁着市场诚信。然而，现有的针对这一特定威胁的研究尚未产生结合可靠结果与快速响应的解决方案。这部分归因于缺乏公开的消息级标注数据，以及设计上的局限。在本文中，我们解决了这两个问题。具体而言，我们引入了一个包含来自39个拉高抛售组织、超过28万条Telegram帖子的语料库，并经过人工审核识别出2,246个拉高抛售公告及其目标加密货币和交易所。利用该数据集，我们定义了两个任务：实时拉高抛售公告检测和目标加密货币/交易所提取。对于检测，我们比较了两种机器学习模型：轻量级树模型LightGBM（F1=0.79，延迟=9.4秒/样本）和基于Transformer的BGE-M3（F1=0.83，延迟=50毫秒/样本）。通过我们提出的方法，我们证明了消息分析可以在单个Telegram消息窗口级别实现近乎实时的拉高抛售检测。与以往仅依赖市场数据且通常在观察到异常交易活动后数十秒才检测到拉高抛售的研究不同，我们的方法直接作用于协调消息本身，并在商用硬件上以每窗口微秒级的速度运行。据我们所知，我们还建立了第一个操纵币种和交易所提取的基准。我们证明了以往文献中广泛依赖的传统基于规则的提取方法因股票代码歧义而失效。相比之下，大语言模型（LLM）取得了0.91的最高准确率。
AI.summary: 本文提出了PumpSense系统，通过构建大规模Telegram标注数据集，利用机器学习和LLM模型实现对加密货币“拉高抛售”行为的实时检测及目标资产精准提取，在速度和准确性上均优于现有的市场数据分析方法。
AI.keywords: 加密货币, 拉高抛售, Telegram, 实时检测, 大语言模型
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于填补了Telegram加密货币“拉高抛售”计划数据集的空白，并通过结合轻量级模型与大语言模型，实现了比传统基于市场数据的监测方法更快、更精准的实时检测。其局限性可能在于对Telegram生态系统的依赖，如果操纵者转移平台，该方法的有效性需重新评估。

title: The Carrier Pigeon Internet Protocol: An Algorithmic (and Lighthearted) Perspective
summary:
The theoretical model behind the pigeon post as a link layer in a communication network was introduced by Shannon (under the guise of studying One-Time Pads for cryptography). That is, to send a one-hop message to $v$, a node $u$ needs a mail pigeon bred and raised at $v$. When sending a message using a pigeon to $v$, node $u$ loses the pigeon. To send another message to $v$, node $u$ needs another pigeon of $v$. It has been demonstrated that the communication bandwidth achievable with pigeon post can exceed that of networks using other media. This has already motivated the introduction of Internet standards that allow the use of pigeons as Internet link-layer media.
  In this paper, we begin to fill in the missing piece: designing algorithms for breeding and scheduling pigeons to meet a given communication demand efficiently, minimizing the number of pigeons required. We consider singlehop, 2-hop, and multihop pigeon use. While the singlehop variant admits a simple characterization, both the 2-hop and the multihop variants are NP-hard. For the latter variants, we present a polynomial-time algorithm based on demand aggregation that achieves a 2-approximation for the number of pigeons used. We believe that this pigeon-based perspective offers both amusing and instructive insights into network design and hopefully, into ornithology.

AI.title_translation: 信鸽互联网协议：一种算法（与轻松）的视角
AI.tldr: 本文将信鸽作为网络链路层媒介，通过算法优化鸽子的调度以最小化资源消耗，并解决了多跳场景下的资源分配难题。
AI.motivation: 尽管信鸽已被提议作为互联网链路层媒介，但目前缺乏有效的算法来管理鸽子的繁育和调度以满足特定的通信需求，且需最小化鸽子数量。
AI.method: 将信鸽通信建模为图论问题，针对单跳、两跳和多跳场景进行分析；证明了两跳及多跳场景的NP-hard性；并提出了一种基于需求聚合的2-近似多项式时间算法。
AI.result: 研究发现单跳场景易于表征，而两跳及多跳场景均属于NP-hard问题；针对多跳场景提出的算法实现了鸽子使用量的2-近似。
AI.conclusion: 论文成功地将信鸽通信建模为网络链路层问题，证明了多跳场景下的NP-hard特性，并给出了有效的近似算法，为非常规网络设计提供了新的视角。
AI.translation: 香农（在研究用于密码学的一次性密码本时）引入了将信鸽邮递作为通信网络链路层的理论模型。即，节点u要向v发送单跳消息，需要一只在v处繁育和饲养的信鸽。当u使用信鸽向v发送消息时，会消耗掉这只鸽子。若要再次向v发送消息，u需要另一只属于v的鸽子。研究表明，信鸽邮递可实现的通信带宽可能超过使用其他媒介的网络，这已推动了将信鸽作为互联网链路层媒介的互联网标准的引入。在本文中，我们开始填补这一空白：设计用于繁育和调度信鸽的算法，以高效满足给定的通信需求，并最小化所需的信鸽数量。我们考虑了单跳、两跳和多跳的信鸽使用方式。虽然单跳变体具有简单的表征，但两跳和多跳变体均是NP-hard问题。对于后者，我们提出了一种基于需求聚合的多项式时间算法，实现了鸽子使用数量的2-近似。我们相信，这种基于信鸽的视角为网络设计，甚至鸟类学，提供了既有趣又有启发性的见解。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了将信鸽作为通信网络链路层的算法实现问题，重点研究如何在满足通信需求的前提下，通过优化鸽子的繁育与调度来最小化资源消耗，并为多跳通信场景提供了高效的近似算法。
AI.keywords: 信鸽协议, 网络链路层, 算法设计, NP-hard, 近似算法
AI.comments: 该论文通过一种幽默且具有启发性的方式，将生物媒介（信鸽）引入网络通信协议研究。虽然其应用场景具有一定的趣味性，但论文在算法复杂性分析（NP-hard证明）和近似算法设计方面提供了严谨的理论支撑，展示了将经典网络通信问题应用于非常规介质的学术价值。

title: Offline Preference Optimization for Rectified Flow with Noise-Tracked Pairs
summary: Existing preference datasets for text-to-image models typically store only the final winner/loser images. This representation is insufficient for rectified flow (RF) models, whose generation is naturally indexed by a specific prior noise sample and follows a nearly straight denoising trajectory. In contrast, prior DPO-style alignment for diffusion models commonly estimates trajectories using an independent forward noising process, which can be mismatched to the true reverse dynamics and introduces unnecessary variance. We propose Prior Noise-Aware Preference Optimization (PNAPO), an off-policy alignment framework specialized for rectified flow. PNAPO augments preference data by retaining the paired prior noises used to generate each winner/loser image, turning the standard (prompt, winner, loser) triplet into a sextuple. Leveraging the straight-line property of RF, we estimate intermediate states via noise-image interpolation, which constrains the trajectory estimation space and yields a tighter surrogate objective for preference optimization. In addition, we introduce a dynamic regularization strategy that adapts the DPO regularization based on (i) the reward gap between winner and loser and (ii) training progress, improving stability and sample efficiency. Experiments on state-of-the-art RF T2I backbones show that PNAPO consistently improves preference metrics while substantially reducing training compute.

AI.title_translation: 基于噪声追踪对的整流流离线偏好优化
AI.tldr: PNAPO通过保留先验噪声信息并利用整流流的直线轨迹特性，实现了更高效、精确的文生图模型偏好优化。
AI.motivation: 现有的偏好数据集仅包含最终图像，无法满足整流流模型对特定先验噪声和直线去噪轨迹的需求，而传统的DPO方法在估计轨迹时存在偏差和高方差问题。
AI.method: 提出Prior Noise-Aware Preference Optimization (PNAPO)框架，将偏好数据扩展为包含原始噪声的六元组；利用整流流的直线特性通过噪声-图像插值估计中间状态；引入基于奖励差距和训练进度的动态正则化策略。
AI.result: 在先进的整流流文生图骨干网络上，PNAPO在提升偏好指标的同时，显著降低了训练所需的计算资源。
AI.conclusion: PNAPO通过引入噪声感知偏好数据和动态正则化策略，有效提升了整流流模型的偏好对齐效果与计算效率，证明了利用整流流轨迹直线性特征进行优化的优越性。
AI.translation: 现有的文生图模型偏好数据集通常仅存储最终的胜出/失败图像。这种表示对于整流流（RF）模型来说是不够的，因为整流流的生成过程自然地由特定的先验噪声样本索引，并遵循近乎直线的去噪轨迹。相比之下，先前用于扩散模型的DPO风格对齐通常使用独立的向前加噪过程来估计轨迹，这可能与真实的逆向动力学不匹配，并引入不必要的方差。我们提出了先验噪声感知偏好优化（PNAPO），这是一种专门针对整流流的离线对齐框架。PNAPO通过保留用于生成每个胜出/失败图像的配对先验噪声来增强偏好数据，将标准的（提示词、胜出者、失败者）三元组转化为六元组。利用RF的直线特性，我们通过噪声-图像插值估计中间状态，这约束了轨迹估计空间并为偏好优化产生了更紧凑的代理目标。此外，我们引入了一种动态正则化策略，根据（i）胜出者和失败者之间的奖励差距以及（ii）训练进度来调整DPO正则化，从而提高了稳定性和样本效率。在最先进的RF T2I骨干网络上的实验表明，PNAPO在显著减少训练计算量的同时，持续提升了偏好指标。
AI.summary: 本文针对整流流模型提出了PNAPO框架，通过在偏好数据中保留先验噪声并利用直线轨迹特性进行中间状态估计，构建了更精确的优化目标。结合动态正则化策略，该方法在提高模型偏好对齐效果的同时，大幅降低了训练成本。
AI.keywords: 整流流, 偏好优化, 文生图模型, 轨迹估计, 离线对齐
AI.comments: 该论文针对整流流（Rectified Flow）模型提出了一种创新的对齐框架。其核心贡献在于利用了整流流轨迹的直线特性，通过保留原始噪声对（prior noise pairs）来消除传统DPO方法中轨迹估计的不确定性。这种方法不仅提高了对齐的精度，还显著提升了训练效率，为文生图模型的偏好优化提供了新的思路。

title: PoHAR: Understanding Hyperlocal Human Activities with Pollution Sensor Networks
comments: 8 pages, 8 figures, accepted to IEEE DCOSS-IoT 2026
summary: Low-cost air quality sensors are becoming ubiquitous in our daily lives as public awareness of air pollution continues to grow, and people take measures to monitor and improve the air they breathe indoors. Besides the standard operation of these sensors, fluctuations in environmental parameters can be leveraged to understand human behavior and activities in indoor spaces. Unlike traditional audio-visual, Radio Frequency, and inertial sensors, air quality sensors are easily scalable to a household, are privacy-preserving, and more economical. Such distributed sensor networks must jointly make decisions to monitor indoor occupants for downstream smart home and healthcare applications. However, due to low processing power, memory, and energy, they often struggle to maintain distributed data consensus and identify activity-affected sensor groups for accurate on-device inference. In this paper, we propose PoHAR framework that implements: (i) a conflict-free replicated data primitive for data sharing, (ii) a hierarchical clustering for ESP32 to detect activity-affected sensor groups with a self-supervised distance metric, and (iii) a leader-based group inference with off-the-shelf ML classifiers, enabling the sensor network to collaboratively detect hyperlocal indoor activities. Our extensive experiments demonstrated on-device activity detection, achieving 97.41% accuracy for indoor activity and 99.68% for cooking activity, using off-the-shelf ML models with latency below 34 microseconds.
comment: 8 pages, 8 figures, accepted to IEEE DCOSS-IoT 2026

AI.title_translation: PoHAR：利用污染传感器网络理解超本地人类活动
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了PoHAR框架，利用低成本空气质量传感器网络，通过无冲突复制数据原语、分层聚类和基于领导者的组推理，实现对超本地室内活动的准确检测，并实现了高精度的活动识别。
AI.motivation: 随着公众对空气污染意识的提高，低成本空气质量传感器日益普及。除了监测空气质量，这些传感器还可以被用来理解室内人类行为。然而，由于处理能力、内存和能源有限，分布式传感器网络在数据共识和活动识别方面存在挑战。
AI.method: 提出PoHAR框架，包括：(i) 用于数据共享的无冲突复制数据原语；(ii) 利用ESP32进行分层聚类，并使用自监督距离度量来检测受活动影响的传感器组；(iii) 采用基于领导者的组推理和现成的机器学习分类器，实现传感器网络的协同活动检测。
AI.result: 实验证明，PoHAR框架能够在设备上进行活动检测，使用现成的机器学习模型，室内活动准确率达到97.41%，烹饪活动准确率达到99.68%，延迟低于34微秒。
AI.conclusion: PoHAR框架能够有效地利用低成本空气质量传感器网络，克服资源限制，实现对超本地室内人类活动的准确、低延迟检测，为智能家居和医疗保健应用提供了支持。
AI.translation: 低成本空气质量传感器随着公众对空气污染意识的提高，已成为我们日常生活的一部分，人们采取措施监测和改善室内空气质量。除了这些传感器的标准操作外，环境参数的波动还可以被用来理解室内人类行为和活动。与传统的视听、射频和惯性传感器不同，空气质量传感器易于扩展到家庭，具有隐私保护性，并且更经济。这种分布式传感器网络必须联合做出决策，以监测室内占用者，用于下游的智能家居和医疗保健应用。然而，由于处理能力、内存和能源有限，它们常常难以维持分布式数据共识和识别活动影响的传感器组，以进行准确的设备上推理。在本研究中，我们提出了PoHAR框架，它实现了：(i) 用于数据共享的无冲突复制数据原语，(ii) 用于ESP32进行分层聚类，以使用自监督距离度量检测受活动影响的传感器组，以及(iii) 采用基于领导者的组推理和现成的机器学习分类器，使传感器网络能够协同检测超本地室内活动。我们通过大量实验证明了设备上活动检测的能力，使用现成的机器学习模型，室内活动准确率达到97.41%，烹饪活动准确率达到99.68%，延迟低于34微秒。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了PoHAR框架，旨在利用普遍存在的低成本空气质量传感器网络来理解室内人类活动。该框架通过引入无冲突复制数据原语、利用ESP32进行分层聚类以及采用基于领导者的组推理，克服了分布式传感器网络在处理能力和内存限制下的挑战。实验结果表明，PoHAR能够实现高精度的室内活动和烹饪活动检测，且延迟极低，为隐私保护且经济的智能家居和医疗保健应用提供了新的解决方案。
AI.keywords: 空气质量传感器,人类活动识别,分布式传感器网络,超本地活动,PoHAR
AI.comments: 该研究巧妙地利用了低成本空气质量传感器这一新兴且普遍存在的设备，将其应用从单纯的环境监测扩展到室内人类活动识别，具有重要的创新意义。框架提出的无冲突复制数据原语、分层聚类和基于领导者的组推理方法，有效解决了分布式传感器网络在资源受限情况下的挑战。实验结果令人印象深刻，高准确率和低延迟证明了该方法的实用性。然而，该研究主要关注室内活动，未来可以进一步探索其在室外或更复杂环境中的应用潜力。此外，对于不同类型的活动，其识别的鲁棒性和对传感器部署的敏感性也值得进一步研究。

title: Star Complexity of Parikh Images of Languages over Infinite Alphabets
summary: It has been conjectured that the Parikh (commutative) image of every language over an infinite alphabet recognized by an automaton with registers is defined by a rational expression. This conjecture is known to hold for all languages recognized by one-register automata. We refine this result by proving that the star-height of the Parikh image of any language recognized by a one-register automaton is universally bounded by two. Furthermore, we show that one-register context-free languages have rational commutative images of arbitrarily high star height. We then disprove the conjecture for multiple registers, as well as disprove the equivalence of commutative expressive power between context-free grammars and automata over infinite alphabets. In other words, we show that Parikh's theorem fails for infinite alphabets.

AI.title_translation: 无限字母表上语言Parikh像的星复杂性
AI.tldr: 本文证明了Parikh定理在无限字母表上失效，否定了寄存器自动机语言的交换像一定是理性的猜想，并界定了单寄存器自动机语言的星高度。
AI.motivation: 探究无限字母表上的语言被寄存器自动机识别后，其Parikh（交换）像是否具有理性表达的猜想，并考察其星高度的复杂性。
AI.method: 通过对单寄存器自动机语言的星高度进行界定，并利用反例证明多寄存器自动机语言的Parikh像不满足理性要求。
AI.result: 证明了单寄存器自动机语言的Parikh像星高度至多为2；证明了单寄存器上下文无关语言可具有任意高的星高度；反驳了多寄存器自动机语言Parikh像为理性的猜想；证明了上下文无关文法与自动机在无限字母表上的交换表达能力不等价。
AI.conclusion: Parikh定理在无限字母表上不成立，多寄存器自动机语言的Parikh像未必是理性的，且上下文无关文法与自动机在无限字母表上的交换表达能力并不等价。
AI.translation: 人们曾猜想，由寄存器自动机识别的无限字母表上的每种语言的Parikh（交换）像都由理性表达式定义。这一猜想在单寄存器自动机识别的所有语言中均成立。我们通过证明任何由单寄存器自动机识别的语言的Parikh像的星高度被普遍限制在2以内，从而细化了这一结果。此外，我们证明了单寄存器上下文无关语言具有任意高星高度的理性交换像。随后，我们反驳了多寄存器情况下的该猜想，并反驳了上下文无关文法与无限字母表上的自动机之间交换表达能力的等价性。换句话说，我们证明了Parikh定理在无限字母表上是不成立的。
AI.summary: 本文研究了无限字母表上语言的Parikh像，界定了单寄存器自动机语言的星高度，并证明了Parikh定理在无限字母表上不适用，否定了关于寄存器自动机语言交换像理性的猜想。
AI.keywords: 无限字母表, Parikh像, 寄存器自动机, 星高度, 交换表达能力
AI.comments: 该研究对无限字母表上的语言理论做出了重要贡献，通过反例否定了关于Parikh像的经典猜想，并细化了单寄存器自动机的复杂性边界，在理论计算机科学领域具有重要的分类学意义。

title: fmxcoders: Factorized Masked Crosscoders for Cross-Layer Feature Discovery
summary: Many features in pretrained Transformers span multiple layers: they emerge through stages of inference, persist in the residual stream, or are built jointly by parallel MLPs. Crosscoders (namely, sparse dictionaries trained jointly across layers) aim to recover these cross-layer features in a single shared latent space. We show that standard crosscoders largely fail at this purpose. Although their decoder weight norms spread evenly across layers, a functional coherence metric we introduce reveals that each latent's activation is effectively driven by only one or two layers on average. While functionally coherent latents act as human-interpretable concept detectors (e.g., US states and cities), the layer-localized latents that crosscoders predominantly learn collapse onto surface-level patterns such as digit detectors. We trace this failure to two structural limitations: unconstrained cross-layer parameterization and unregularized cross-layer dependence. We address both by introducing fmxcoders, which (i) replace the encoder and decoder with low-rank tensor factorizations that draw every latent's per-layer weights from a shared cross-layer basis, and (ii) apply stochastic layer masking, a denoising regularizer along the layer axis that penalizes latents whose contribution collapses when a single layer is masked. Across GPT2-Small, Pythia-410M, Pythia-1.4B, and Gemma2-2B, fmxcoders lift mean probing F1 by 10-30 points, surpassing per-layer SAE baselines that standard crosscoders fail to reach, reduce reconstruction MSE by 25-50%, and roughly double mean functional coherence. An LLM-as-a-judge evaluation further shows that fmxcoders recover 3-13$\times$ more semantically coherent latents than standard crosscoders across all four base LLMs.

AI.title_translation: fmxcoders：用于跨层特征发现的因子化掩码交叉编码器
AI.tldr: 标准交叉编码器在跨层特征发现方面效果不佳，因为它们学习到的潜在表示主要受限于单层。 fmxcoders 通过引入低秩因子化和随机层掩码来解决这些限制，从而在多个模型上显著提高了特征探测性能、减少了重构误差，并发现了更多语义上连贯的潜在表示。
AI.motivation: 现有的交叉编码器在从预训练 Transformer 中恢复跨层特征方面效果不佳，它们倾向于学习与表面模式相关的、局部化的特征，而不是人类可解释的概念。
AI.method: fmxcoders 引入了两种改进：1）通过低秩张量分解来限制参数化，使每个潜在表示的层权重共享一个公共基础；2）通过随机层掩码进行正则化，以惩罚那些在掩码掉单层后贡献会显著下降的潜在表示。
AI.result: fmxcoders 在 GPT2-Small、Pythia-410M、Pythia-1.4B 和 Gemma2-2B 等模型上，将探测 F1 分数提高了 10-30 个百分点，重构 MSE 降低了 25-50%，并且功能连贯性大约提高了一倍。LLM 评估显示，fmxcoders 发现的语义连贯潜在表示比标准交叉编码器多 3-13 倍。
AI.conclusion: fmxcoders 通过解决标准交叉编码器的结构限制，在跨层特征发现方面取得了显著的改进，从而能够更有效地识别和恢复 Transformer 模型中跨越多层的、具有语义意义的特征。
AI.translation: 许多预训练 Transformer 中的特征跨越多个层：它们通过推理阶段出现，在残差流中持续存在，或由并行的多层感知机联合构建。交叉编码器（即跨层联合训练的稀疏字典）旨在在单个共享的潜在空间中恢复这些跨层特征。我们发现，标准的交叉编码器在这方面基本上是失败的。尽管它们的解码器权重范数在各层之间均匀分布，但我们引入的一个功能连贯性指标显示，每个潜在表示的激活实际上平均只由一到两层驱动。虽然功能连贯的潜在表示充当人类可解释的概念探测器（例如，美国各州和城市），但交叉编码器主要学习到的层局部化潜在表示会坍缩到表面模式，例如数字探测器。我们将这种失败追溯到两个结构限制：无约束的跨层参数化和无正则化的跨层依赖。我们通过引入 fmxcoders 来解决这两个问题，其中 (i) 使用低秩张量分解替换编码器和解码器，使每个潜在表示的层权重从共享的跨层基础中提取，并且 (ii) 应用随机层掩码，这是一种沿层轴的去噪正则化器，用于惩罚当单层被掩码时其贡献会坍缩的潜在表示。在 GPT2-Small、Pythia-410M、Pythia-1.4B 和 Gemma2-2B 上，fmxcoders 将平均探测 F1 分数提高了 10-30 个百分点，超过了标准交叉编码器无法达到的逐层 SAE 基线，将重构 MSE 降低了 25-50%，并且平均功能连贯性大约提高了一倍。LLM 作为评判的评估进一步表明，在所有四个基础 LLM 上，fmxcoders 恢复的语义连贯潜在表示比标准交叉编码器多 3-13 倍。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了 fmxcoders，一种用于 Transformer 模型跨层特征发现的新型交叉编码器。标准交叉编码器在识别跨越多个层的、具有语义意义的特征方面存在不足，往往会学习到与表面模式相关的局部化特征。fmxcoders 通过引入低秩张量分解来限制参数化，并结合随机层掩码进行正则化，解决了这些限制。实验结果表明，fmxcoders 在多个模型上显著提高了特征探测性能，降低了重构误差，并发现了更多语义上连贯的潜在表示，证明了其在理解和利用 Transformer 模型中复杂跨层特征方面的有效性。
AI.keywords: 交叉编码器, 跨层特征发现, 低秩分解, 随机层掩码, Transformer
AI.comments: 该研究提出的 fmxcoders 在解决标准交叉编码器在跨层特征发现方面的局限性方面取得了显著进展。低秩分解和随机层掩码的结合是一种新颖且有效的方法，能够更好地捕捉 Transformer 模型中跨越多个层的、具有语义意义的特征。然而，进一步的研究可以探索这些方法在更大、更复杂的模型上的可扩展性，以及它们对模型整体性能（例如，下游任务的准确性）的具体影响。

title: Inverse Design for Conditional Distribution Matching
summary: Generative models are powerful tools for sampling from a learned distribution $\mathcal{P}(Y \mid X)$, and inverse-design methods invert this map to find an input $x$ that produces a desired point output $y^*$. However, many design goals are naturally distributional rather than pointwise, incorporating the inherent uncertainty of $Y$ and targeting a specific form for it, a task not addressed by standard inverse design. To address this issue we introduce Conditional Distribution Matching (CDM), a new inverse-design problem class in generative modeling: given a joint distribution $\mathcal{P}(X, Y)$ and a target distribution $\mathcal{G}(Y)$, find an input $x^*$ whose induced conditional distribution $\mathcal{P}(Y \mid X = x^*)$ matches $\mathcal{G}$. We formally define two variants: Conditional Distribution Matching Sampling (CDMS) and Conditional Distribution Matching Optimization (CDMO). To solve these problems, we propose MLGD-F (Matching-Loss Guided Diffusion with a Fast inner sampler), a plug-and-play inference-time algorithm that combines a pretrained score-based diffusion model with a pretrained fast conditional sampler, requiring no additional training or fine-tuning. By leveraging single-step conditional sampling, MLGD-F enables tractable gradient computation, making the estimation of $\mathcal{P}(Y \mid X)$ both memory-efficient and computationally lightweight. We validate MLGD-F on synthetic benchmarks, structured image transformations, and generative editing optimization, demonstrating reliable recovery of inputs whose conditional distributions match diverse user-specified targets, including discrete mixtures and continuous low-rank supports.

AI.title_translation: 用于条件分布匹配的逆向设计
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为条件分布匹配（CDM）的新型逆向设计方法，并引入MLGD-F算法，无需额外训练即可让生成模型按用户指定的分布要求产生输出。
AI.motivation: 现有的逆向设计方法主要针对点对点映射（即找到特定的x以产生y*），无法处理更符合实际需求的分布级设计目标（即找到x使得条件分布P(Y|X=x)匹配目标分布G）。
AI.method: 提出了条件分布匹配（CDM）框架，并定义了CDMS和CDMO两个变体；设计了MLGD-F（Matching-Loss Guided Diffusion with a Fast inner sampler）算法，结合预训练的基于分数的扩散模型和快速条件采样器，通过单步条件采样进行梯度计算，实现高效推理。
AI.result: 在合成基准测试、结构化图像转换和生成式编辑优化任务中，MLGD-F算法能够可靠地恢复出使得条件分布符合用户指定目标（包括离散混合和连续低秩支持）的输入，且具有内存高效和计算轻量的特点。
AI.conclusion: 该研究通过引入条件分布匹配（CDM）框架及MLGD-F算法，成功解决了生成模型中分布级逆向设计的问题，为实现特定条件分布控制提供了高效、灵活的解决方案。
AI.translation: 生成模型是学习分布 P(Y|X) 并从中采样的强大工具，逆向设计方法通过反转该映射来寻找产生期望点输出 y* 的输入 x。然而，许多设计目标本质上是分布式的而非点式的，它们包含了 Y 的固有不确定性并针对其特定形式，这是标准逆向设计未解决的任务。为了解决这个问题，我们在生成模型中引入了一个新的逆向设计问题类别：条件分布匹配（CDM）。给定联合分布 P(X, Y) 和目标分布 G(Y)，寻找一个输入 x*，使其诱导的条件分布 P(Y|X=x*) 与 G 匹配。我们正式定义了两个变体：条件分布匹配采样（CDMS）和条件分布匹配优化（CDMO）。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了 MLGD-F（具有快速内部采样器的匹配损失引导扩散），这是一种即插即用的推理时算法，它将预训练的基于分数的扩散模型与预训练的快速条件采样器相结合，无需额外的训练或微调。通过利用单步条件采样，MLGD-F 实现了可处理的梯度计算，使得 P(Y|X) 的估计既节省内存又计算轻量。我们在合成基准、结构化图像转换和生成式编辑优化上验证了 MLGD-F，证明了它能可靠地恢复出其条件分布与用户指定目标（包括离散混合和连续低秩支持）相匹配的输入。
AI.summary: 本文针对传统生成模型逆向设计仅支持点对点映射的局限，提出了条件分布匹配（CDM）框架，旨在寻找使条件分布P(Y|X=x)匹配目标分布的输入。为此，作者开发了MLGD-F算法，该算法利用预训练的扩散模型和快速条件采样器，无需再训练即可实现高效的梯度估计与分布匹配，实验验证了其在多种任务中的有效性。
AI.keywords: 条件分布匹配, 生成模型, 扩散模型, 逆向设计, 推理算法
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的逆向设计范式，将目标从“点对点”映射提升到了“分布对分布”的匹配，具有很强的应用潜力。其优势在于无需对生成模型进行额外训练或微调即可实现推理，具备良好的即插即用性。其局限性在于依赖预训练的条件采样器，采样器的质量直接影响匹配效果。

title: Key Coverage Matters: Semi-Structured Extraction of OCR Clinical Reports
summary: Clinical reports are often fragmented across healthcare institutions because privacy regulations and data silos limit direct information sharing. When patients seek care at a different hospital, they often carry paper or scanned reports from prior visits. This hinders EHR integration and longitudinal review, and downstream applications that depend on more complete patient records, such as patient management, follow-up care, real-world studies, and clinical-trial matching. Although OCR can digitize such reports, reliable extraction remains challenging because clinical documents are heterogeneous, OCR text is noisy, and many healthcare settings require low-cost on-premise deployment. We formulate this problem as canonical key-conditioned extractive question answering over OCR-derived clinical reports. Because the key fields are neither fixed nor known in advance, the key space is open. We maintain a canonical key inventory through iterative key mining, normalization, clustering, and lightweight human verification, and introduce key coverage as a metric to quantify inventory completeness. Using a 0.2B BERT-based model, experiments on real-world reports from more than 20 hospitals show performance improves monotonically with key coverage. The model achieves F1 scores of 0.839 and 0.893 under exact match and boundary-tolerant matching, respectively, once the Top-90 canonical keys are covered. These results show that key coverage is a dominant factor for end-to-end performance. At Top-90 coverage, our model outperforms a fine-tuned Qwen3-0.6B baseline under exact match. Although our annotated corpus is Chinese, the method relies on the language-agnostic key-value organization of semi-structured clinical reports and can be adapted to other settings given an appropriate canonical key inventory and alias mapping.

AI.title_translation: 关键覆盖率至关重要：OCR临床报告的半结构化提取
AI.tldr: 该研究提出通过迭代构建关键库来提升临床OCR报告的信息提取准确率，证明了关键覆盖率是实现高性能提取的关键因素，且在小参数模型下表现优异。
AI.motivation: 临床报告在不同医疗机构间高度碎片化，OCR处理后的文本存在噪声且格式异构，现有方法难以有效提取关键信息以支持电子健康记录（EHR）集成及后续临床应用。
AI.method: 将问题定义为基于规范关键条件的提取式问答。通过迭代挖掘、归一化、聚类和轻量级人工验证构建规范关键库（Canonical Key Inventory），并使用0.2B的BERT模型进行提取训练。
AI.result: 在Top-90关键覆盖率下，该模型在真实临床报告上达到0.839（精确匹配）和0.893（边界容忍匹配）的F1分数，性能优于Qwen3-0.6B基线模型，且证明了性能随关键覆盖率的增加而单调提升。
AI.conclusion: 研究证实了关键覆盖率是影响端到端提取性能的核心因素。通过迭代挖掘构建的关键库，结合轻量级BERT模型，能够在低资源环境下实现高精度的临床数据提取，优于部分大参数基线模型。
