To support diverse deployment needs, we propose two complementary mechanisms: training-free Stochastic Trajectory Ensemble Guidance (STEG) that computes gradients on-the-fly for zero-shot adaptation, and training-based Conditional Critic Guidance (CCG) for amortized inference. Empirical evaluations demonstrate that our guided streaming approach significantly outperforms conventional chunk-based policies in reactivity and provides superior, physically valid guidance for dynamic, unstructured environments.
comment: Accepted to Robotics: Science and Systems (RSS) 2026. The first two authors contributed equally

title: Swarm Skills: A Portable, Self-Evolving Multi-Agent System Specification for Coordination Engineering
summary: As artificial intelligence engineering paradigms shift from single-agent Prompt and Context Engineering toward multi-agent \textbf{Coordination Engineering}, the ability to codify and systematically improve how multiple agents collaborate has emerged as a critical bottleneck. While single-agent skills can now be distributed as portable assets, multi-agent coordination protocols remain locked within framework-internal code or static configurations, preventing them from being shared across systems or autonomously improved over time. We propose \textbf{Swarm Skills}, a portable specification that extends the Anthropic Skills standard with multi-agent semantics. Swarm Skills turns multi-agent workflows into first-class, distributable assets that consist of roles, workflows, execution bounds, and a built-in semantic structure for self-evolution. To operationalize the specification's evolving nature, we present a companion self-evolution algorithm that automatically distills successful execution trajectories into new Swarm Skills and continuously patches existing ones based on multi-dimensional scoring (Effectiveness, Utilization, and Freshness), eliminating the need for human-in-the-loop oversight during the refinement process. Through an architectural compatibility analysis and a comprehensive qualitative case study using the open-source JiuwenSwarm reference implementation, we demonstrate how Swarm Skills achieves zero-adapter cross-agent portability via progressive disclosure, enabling agent teams to self-evolve their coordination strategies without framework lock-in.

title: Explanation-Aware Learning for Enhanced Interpretability in Biomedical Imaging
comments: Under review at IEEE Journal of Biomedical and Health Informatics (JBHI)
summary: Deep neural networks for medical image diagnosis often achieve high predictive accuracy while relying on spurious or clinically irrelevant visual cues, limiting their trustworthiness in practice. Post-hoc explanation methods are widely used to visualize model decisions in the form of saliency maps; however, these explanations do not influence how models learn during training, allowing non-causal or confounding features to persist. This motivates the incorporation of explanation supervision directly into the training objective to guide model attention toward clinically meaningful regions and promote clinically grounded decision-making. This paper presents a systematic approach to integrate explanation loss into model training and analyzes how different explanation loss designs and supervision strengths influence both predictive performance and spatial faithfulness of explanations. To quantitatively assess interpretability, two complementary explanation performance metrics-annotation coverage and saliency precision-are introduced, enabling rigorous evaluation beyond qualitative visualization. Our experimental results reveal a clear trade-off between explanation quality and explanation loss coefficients. Furthermore, quantitative statistical analysis yields consistently improved explanation alignment while maintaining comparable accuracy. Experiments were conducted on annotated chest X-ray datasets; however, the proposed framework is applicable to a broad range of annotated biomedical imaging modalities. Overall, these findings demonstrate that explanation supervision is not a monolithic design choice and provide practical guidance for incorporating explanation loss into training objectives under noisy clinical annotations.
comment: Under review at IEEE Journal of Biomedical and Health Informatics (JBHI)

title: Edge-Cloud Collaborative Pothole Detection via Onboard Event Screening and Federated Temporal Segmentation
summary: Road potholes threaten driving safety and increase infrastructure maintenance costs, while large-scale and timely pothole detection remains challenging in urban road networks. Vehicle-mounted vibration sensing offers a low-cost and scalable solution, however, continuous transmission of raw acceleration streams causes high communication overhead. Also, vibration patterns induced by potholes are often confused with those caused by manholes, speed bumps, and other local road structures. To address these challenges, this paper proposes an edge-cloud collaborative pothole detection framework based on onboard vibration event screening and federated temporal segmentation. At the vehicle side, a Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM)-based module adaptively models background vibration and screens candidate abnormal events from continuous acceleration streams. The onboard module acts as a lightweight high-recall filter and uploads only compact candidate event segments with their contextual information. At the server side, pothole detection is formulated as a point-wise temporal segmentation task. A 1D Attention U-Net is developed to distinguish potholes from vibration-similar road events by capturing multi-scale temporal features and preserving event boundary information. Furthermore, the model is trained under a federated learning framework to exploit distributed multi-vehicle data while accommodating non-IID vehicle data distributions. Experiments on multi-vehicle vibration sensing data show that the proposed framework reduces unnecessary data transmission from smooth road segments and improves fine-grained pothole detection under both centralized and federated settings.

title: Hardness Amplification for (Sparse) LPN
summary:
We prove new hardness amplification results for Learning Parity with Noise ($\mathsf{LPN}$) and its sparse variants. In $\mathsf{LPN}_{η,n,m}$, the goal is to recover a secret $\vec s\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$ from $m$ noisy linear samples $(\vec a,b)$, where $\vec a\leftarrow \mathbb{F}_2^n$ is uniform and $b=\langle \vec a,\vec s\rangle + e$ with $e\leftarrow \mathrm{Ber}(η)$.
  Building on the direct-product framework introduced by Hirahara and Shimizu [HS23], we show an 'instance-fraction amplification' theorem: for any $\varepsilon,δ>0$, any algorithm that solves $\mathsf{LPN}_{η,n,m}$ with success probability $\varepsilon$ can be transformed into an algorithm that succeeds with probability $1-δ$ on a related \textsf{LPN} distribution with scaled parameters $\mathsf{LPN}_{η/k,\;n/k,\;m}$, where $ k=Θ\!\left(\frac{1}δ\log\frac{1}{\varepsilon}\right). $ Equivalently, an algorithm that solves $\mathsf{LPN}$ on a 'small fraction of instances' can be converted into an algorithm that solves $\mathsf{LPN}$ on 'almost all instances', yielding a self-amplification for a wide range of parameters.
  We extend the same amplification approach to $\mathsf{LPN}$ over $\mathbb{F}_q$ and to Sparse-$\mathsf{LPN}$, where each query vector $\vec a$ has exactly $σ$ nonzero entries. Together, these results establish hardness self-amplification for a broad family of $\mathsf{LPN}$-type problems, strengthening the foundations for assuming the average-case hardness of $\mathsf{LPN}$ and its sparse variants.

title: Route by State, Recover from Trace: STAR with Failure-Aware Markov Routing for Multi-Agent Spatiotemporal Reasoning
summary: Compositional spatiotemporal reasoning often requires a system to invoke multiple heterogeneous specialists, such as geometric, temporal, topological, and trajectory agents. A central question is how such a system should route among specialists when execution does not simply succeed or fail, but fails in qualitatively different ways. Existing tool-augmented and multi-agent LLM systems typically leave this routing decision implicit in language generation, making recovery ad hoc, difficult to interpret, and hard to optimize. This paper presents STAR (Spatio-Temporal Agent Router), a failure-aware routing framework that externalizes inter-agent control as a state-conditioned transition policy over the current agent, task type, and typed execution status. At the center of STARis an agent routing matrix that combines expert-specified nominal routes with recovery transitions learned from execution traces. Because the matrix conditions on distinct failure states, the router can respond differently to malformed outputs, missing dependencies, and tool--query mismatches, rather than collapsing them into a generic retry signal. Specialists execute through a tool-grounded extract--compute--deposit protocol and write intermediate results to a shared blackboard for downstream fusion. Results prove that retaining unsuccessful traces during training enlarges the support of the routing policy on error states, enabling recovery transitions that success-only training cannot represent. Across three spatiotemporal benchmarks and eight backbone LLMs, STAR improves over multiple baselines with the clearest gains on queries whose execution deviates from the nominal routing path. Router-specific ablations and recovery analyses further show that typed failure-aware routing, rather than specialist composition alone, is a key factor for these improvements.

title: An Approximation Algorithm for 2-Vertex-Connectivity via Cycle-Restricted 2-Edge-Covers
summary: In the 2-Vertex-Connected Spanning Subgraph problem (2-VCSS), we are given an undirected graph $G$, and the objective is to find a 2-vertex-connected spanning subgraph $S$ of $G$ with the minimum number of edges. In the context of survivable network design, 2-VCSS is one of the most fundamental and well-studied problems. There has been active research on improving the approximation ratio of algorithms, and the current best ratio is $\frac{4}{3}$, achieved by Bosch-Calvo, Grandoni, and Jabal Ameli. In this paper, we improve the approximation ratio to $\frac{95}{72}+\varepsilon$ ($<1.32$). The key idea in our algorithm is to introduce a 2-edge-cover without certain cycle components, and use it as an initial solution.

title: Strategic Exploitation in LLM Agent Markets: A Simulation Framework for E-Commerce Trust
summary: Agent-based modeling (ABM) has long been used in economics to study human behavior, and large language model (LLM) agents now enable new forms of social and economic simulation. While prior work has discovered strategic deception by LLM agents in financial trading and auction markets, e-commerce remains underexplored despite its distinctive information asymmetry: sellers privately observe product quality, whereas buyers rely on advertised claims and reputation signals. We introduce TruthMarketTwin, a controlled simulation framework for studying LLM-agent behavior in e-commerce markets. The framework is one of the first to model bilateral trade under asymmetric information sharing, where agents make strategic listing, purchasing, rating, and recourse-related decisions to optimize seller profit and buyer utility. We find that LLM agents released into traditional markets autonomously exploit weaknesses in reputation-based governance, while warrant enforcement reduces deception and reshapes strategic reasoning. Our results position LLM-agent simulation as a tool for studying institution-governed autonomous markets.

title: Not-So-Strange Love: Language Models and Generative Linguistic Theories are More Compatible than They Appear
comments: Accepted to Behavioral and Brain Sciences; 4 pages; Commentary on "How Linguistics Learned to Stop Worrying and Love the Language Models" by Richard Futrell and Kyle Mahowald
summary: Futrell and Mahowald (2025) frame the success of neural language models (LMs) as supporting gradient, usage-based linguistic theories. I argue that LMs can also instantiate theories based on formal structures - the types of theories seen in the generative tradition. This argument expands the space of theories that can be tested with LMs, potentially enabling reconciliations between usage-based and generative accounts.
comment: Accepted to Behavioral and Brain Sciences; 4 pages; Commentary on "How Linguistics Learned to Stop Worrying and Love the Language Models" by Richard Futrell and Kyle Mahowald

title: GenioSim: A Novel Simulation Platform for Edge Computing over Optical Networks
summary: The convergence of Passive Optical Networks (PONs) and edge computing creates new opportunities: Optical Line Terminals (OLTs) and Optical Network Terminals (ONTs) can be repurposed as low-latency edge compute nodes for offloading workloads. However, exploring such design options early in the development cycle is costly and time-consuming, as prototyping requires specialized hardware and realistic traffic conditions. Simulation becomes essential, yet current tools are unable to accurately model this emerging class of systems. To address these gaps, we introduce GenioSim, a simulation platform for hierarchical PON-enabled edge infrastructures. It models OLTs and ONTs with realistic PON behavior, supports hybrid container- and VM-based virtualization, and provides multiple service and execution models. These capabilities enable the evaluation of resource management policies under complex, heterogeneous conditions. We present experiments in the context of use cases of industrial relevance, to show GenioSim can provide insights for capacity planning and for the choice of policies for container placement and task offloading in PON-enabled edge infrastructures.

title: EFGCL: Learning Dynamic Motion through Spotting-Inspired External Force Guided Curriculum Learning
comments: Accepted at RA-L 2026, website - https://keitayoneda.github.io/kleiyn-efgcl/, YouTube - https://youtu.be/sFK00hm14No/
summary: Learning dynamic whole-body motions for legged robots through reinforcement learning (RL) remains challenging due to the high risk of failure, which makes efficient exploration difficult and often leads to unstable learning. In this paper, we propose External Force Guided Curriculum Learning (EFGCL), a guided RL approach based on the principle of physical guidance, in which external assistive forces are introduced during training. Inspired by spotting in artistic gymnastics, EFGCL enables agents to physically experience successful motion executions without relying on task-specific reward shaping or reference trajectories. Experiments on a quadrupedal robot performing Jump, Backflip, and Lateral-Flip tasks demonstrate that EFGCL accelerates learning of the Jump task by approximately a factor of two and enables the acquisition of complex whole body motions that conventional RL methods fail to learn. We further show that the learned policies can be deployed on real robot, reproducing motions consistent with those observed in simulation. These results indicate that physically guided exploration, which allows agents to experience success early in training, is an effective and general strategy for improving learning efficiency in dynamic whole-body motion tasks.
comment: Accepted at RA-L 2026, website - https://keitayoneda.github.io/kleiyn-efgcl/, YouTube - https://youtu.be/sFK00hm14No/

title: MAGE: Multi-Agent Self-Evolution with Co-Evolutionary Knowledge Graphs
summary: Self-evolving language-model agents must decide what to learn next and how to preserve what they have learned across iterations. Existing systems typically carry this cross-iteration knowledge as natural-language feedback, flat episodic memory, or implicit reinforcement signals, none of which cleanly supports a frozen weak backbone at inference time. This paper introduces MAGE (Multi-Agent Graph-guided Evolution), a framework that externalizes self-knowledge into a four-subgraph co-evolutionary knowledge graph. Its experience subgraph stores both teacher-written failure corrections and the learner's own past correct reasoning traces, which are retrieved as task-conditioned guidance for a frozen execution model. During evolution, the graph, a task-level search bandit, and a skill-level routing bandit are updated from the same reward stream, while the learner's backbone remains unchanged. We further provide structural analysis showing how append-only memory growth, bounded curriculum coverage, and task-filtered retrieval together support stable improvement of the retrieval substrate for frozen-learner evolution. Across nine benchmarks spanning mathematical reasoning, multi-hop and open-domain question answering, spatio-temporal analysis, financial numerical reasoning, medical multiple-choice, an open-world survival game, and web navigation, MAGE achieves strong performance against prompt-based frozen-backbone baselines. Ablations show that self-harvested success traces and teacher-written corrections are complementary, with success memories contributing most on reasoning-template-heavy tasks and corrective memories supporting harder composition and interaction settings.

AI.title_translation: MAGE：基于协同演化知识图谱的多智能体自演化
AI.tldr: MAGE是一个多智能体框架，通过协同演化知识图谱外部化自知识，为冻结的语言模型骨干提供任务条件指导，实现稳定的自演化，并在广泛任务上超越基线。
AI.motivation: 现有自演化语言模型智能体在跨迭代知识保存方面存在局限，特别是无法清晰支持推理时使用冻结的弱骨干模型，因为它们通常以自然语言反馈、扁平的片段记忆或隐式强化信号来承载知识。
AI.method: 本文提出了MAGE（Multi-Agent Graph-guided Evolution）框架，它将自知识外部化到一个包含四个子图的协同演化知识图谱中。其经验子图存储教师编写的错误修正和学习者过去的正确推理轨迹，这些作为任务条件指导被检索用于冻结的执行模型。在演化过程中，知识图谱、任务级搜索bandit和技能级路由bandit从同一奖励流更新，而学习者的骨干模型保持不变。结构分析表明，仅追加记忆增长、有界课程覆盖和任务过滤检索共同支持冻结学习者演化中检索基底的稳定改进。
AI.result: MAGE在数学推理、多跳和开放域问答、时空分析、金融数值推理、医学选择题、开放世界生存游戏和网络导航等九个基准测试中，相对于基于提示的冻结骨干基线，取得了强大的性能。消融实验表明，自收集的成功轨迹和教师编写的修正互补，其中成功记忆主要在推理模板密集型任务上贡献最大，而修正记忆支持更复杂的组合和交互设置。
AI.conclusion: MGE通过其独特的协同演化知识图谱和演化机制，有效解决了冻结骨干模型在自演化中的知识保留和学习挑战，并在广泛的任务中展现出优越性和鲁棒性，证明了外部化自知识和图谱引导演化的有效性。
AI.translation: 自演化语言模型智能体必须决定接下来学习什么以及如何在迭代中保留所学知识。现有系统通常以自然语言反馈、扁平的片段记忆或隐式强化信号来承载这种跨迭代知识，但这些都不能清晰地支持在推理时使用冻结的弱骨干模型。本文介绍了MAGE（Multi-Agent Graph-guided Evolution），一个将自知识外部化到包含四个子图的协同演化知识图谱中的框架。其经验子图存储教师编写的错误修正和学习者过去的正确推理轨迹，这些作为任务条件指导被检索用于冻结的执行模型。在演化过程中，知识图谱、任务级搜索bandit和技能级路由bandit从同一奖励流更新，而学习者的骨干模型保持不变。我们进一步提供了结构分析，展示了仅追加记忆增长、有界课程覆盖和任务过滤检索如何共同支持冻结学习者演化中检索基底的稳定改进。在涵盖数学推理、多跳和开放域问答、时空分析、金融数值推理、医学选择题、开放世界生存游戏和网络导航的九个基准测试中，MAGE相对于基于提示的冻结骨干基线取得了强大的性能。消融实验表明，自收集的成功轨迹和教师编写的修正互补，其中成功记忆主要在推理模板密集型任务上贡献最大，而修正记忆支持更复杂的组合和交互设置。
AI.summary: MAGE是一个多智能体框架，旨在解决自演化语言模型智能体在知识保留和冻结骨干模型支持方面的挑战。它通过一个包含四个子图的协同演化知识图谱外部化自知识，其中经验子图存储错误修正和成功推理轨迹，作为冻结执行模型的任务条件指导。在演化过程中，MAGE利用知识图谱和两种bandit（任务级搜索和技能级路由）从统一奖励流更新，同时保持学习者骨干不变。该方法通过结构分析证明了其稳定改进能力，并在九个不同领域的基准测试中，相比基于提示的冻结骨干基线，展现出卓越性能。消融实验强调了自收集成功轨迹和教师修正的互补性，分别在不同类型的任务中发挥关键作用。
AI.keywords: 多智能体, 自演化, 知识图谱, 语言模型, 冻结骨干
AI.comments: MAGE的创新之处在于其将智能体的自知识外部化为协同演化知识图谱，并采用冻结骨干模型进行推理。这种设计允许智能体在不修改核心模型参数的情况下，通过外部知识图谱进行高效且稳定的自演化。其结合教师修正和自收集成功轨迹的经验子图设计，有效平衡了纠错和经验积累，使其在多领域任务中表现出色。该方法对于构建更鲁棒、更具可解释性的自演化智能体具有重要意义。

title: NCO: A Versatile Plug-in for Handling Negative Constraints in Decoding
summary: Controlling Large Language Models (LLMs) to prevent the generation of undesirable content, such as profanity and personally identifiable information (PII), has become increasingly critical. While earlier approaches relied on post-processing or resampling, recent research has shifted towards constrained decoding methods that control outputs during generation to mitigate high computational costs and quality degradation. However, preventing multiple forbidden hard constraints or regex constraints from appearing anywhere in the output is computationally challenging. A straightforward solution is to convert these constraints into a single automaton that tracks all forbidden patterns during decoding, but this often becomes impractically large. Standard regex engines also do not readily support the operations needed to build such a constraint, such as complement and intersection. In order to address these limitations, we propose NCO, a decoding strategy that performs online pattern matching over finite hard constraints and regex constraints, reducing computational overhead without inducing state explosion. NCO is fully compatible with standard inference strategies, including various sampling methods and beam search, while also supporting soft masking for probabilistic suppression. We empirically demonstrate its effectiveness across practical tasks, including PII and profanity suppression. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/hyundong98/NCO-Decoding.git .

AI.title_translation: NCO：一种用于处理解码中负面约束的多功能插件
AI.tldr: NCO是一种解码策略，通过在线模式匹配有效处理LLM中的负面硬约束和正则表达式约束，避免计算开销和状态爆炸，且兼容标准推理策略。
AI.motivation: 控制大型语言模型生成不良内容（如脏话、PII）至关重要。现有约束解码方法在处理多个复杂的负面硬约束或正则表达式约束时面临计算挑战，因为将它们转换为单个自动机可能过大，且标准正则表达式引擎不支持所需操作。
AI.method: 提出NCO，一种解码策略，通过对有限硬约束和正则表达式约束执行在线模式匹配来减少计算开销，避免状态爆炸。它与标准推理策略（包括各种采样方法和束搜索）完全兼容，并支持概率抑制的软掩码。
AI.result: 经验证明NCO在实际任务中（包括PII和脏话抑制）有效。
AI.conclusion: NCO提供了一种高效、兼容的解决方案，用于在解码过程中处理大型语言模型中的负面约束，有效抑制不良内容生成。
AI.translation: 控制大型语言模型（LLM）以防止生成不良内容，例如脏话和个人身份信息（PII），变得越来越重要。虽然早期的方法依赖于后处理或重采样，但最近的研究已转向约束解码方法，这些方法在生成过程中控制输出，以减轻高计算成本和质量下降。然而，防止多个禁止的硬约束或正则表达式约束出现在输出的任何地方在计算上具有挑战性。一个直接的解决方案是将这些约束转换为一个单一的自动机，在解码过程中跟踪所有禁止模式，但这通常会变得不切实际地大。标准正则表达式引擎也不容易支持构建此类约束所需的操作，例如补集和交集。为了解决这些限制，我们提出了NCO，这是一种解码策略，它对有限的硬约束和正则表达式约束执行在线模式匹配，从而在不引起状态爆炸的情况下减少计算开销。NCO与标准推理策略完全兼容，包括各种采样方法和束搜索，同时还支持用于概率抑制的软掩码。我们通过经验证明了它在实际任务中的有效性，包括PII和脏话抑制。我们的实现可在 https://github.com/hyundong98/NCO-Decoding.git 获取。
AI.summary: NCO是一种新颖的解码策略，旨在高效处理大型语言模型中的负面约束（如硬约束和正则表达式约束），以防止生成不良内容。它通过在线模式匹配来避免传统方法中计算开销大和状态爆炸的问题，并与现有的推理策略完全兼容，同时支持软掩码进行概率抑制。实验证明NCO在PII和脏话抑制等任务中表现出有效性。
AI.keywords: 负面约束, 大型语言模型, 解码策略, 在线模式匹配, PII抑制
AI.comments: NCO的创新之处在于其在线模式匹配方法，有效解决了传统约束解码在处理复杂负面约束时面临的计算效率和状态爆炸问题。作为一个“插件”，它具有高度的兼容性和灵活性，能够与多种标准推理策略结合，并支持软掩码，这对于LLM的安全和负责任部署具有重要意义。

title: Metis: Learning to Jailbreak LLMs via Self-Evolving Metacognitive Policy Optimization
comments: Accepted to the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
summary: Red teaming is critical for uncovering vulnerabilities in Large Language Models (LLMs). While automated methods have improved scalability, existing approaches often rely on static heuristics or stochastic search, rendering them brittle against advanced safety alignment. To address this, we introduce Metis, a framework that reformulates jailbreaking as inference-time policy optimization within an adversarial Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (POMDP). Metis employs a self-evolving metacognitive loop to perform causal diagnosis of a target's defense logic and leverages structured feedback as a semantic gradient to refine its policy, offering enhanced interpretability through transparent reasoning traces. Extensive evaluations across 10 diverse models demonstrate that Metis achieves the strongest average Attack Success Rate (ASR) among compared methods at 89.2%, maintaining high efficacy on resilient frontier models (e.g., 76.0% on O1 and 78.0% on GPT-5-chat) where traditional baselines exhibit substantial performance degradation. By replacing redundant exploration with directed optimization, Metis reduces token costs by an average of 8.2x and up to 11.4x. Our analysis reveals that current defenses remain vulnerable to internally-steered, closed-loop reasoning trajectories under the tested settings, highlighting a critical need for next-generation defenses capable of reasoning about safety dynamically during inference.
comment: Accepted to the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)

AI.title_translation: Metis：通过自进化元认知策略优化学习越狱LLMs
AI.tldr: Metis是一个通过自进化元认知策略优化来越狱LLMs的框架，它在多种模型上实现了高攻击成功率，并显著降低了token成本，揭示了当前LLM防御的脆弱性。
AI.motivation: 现有的自动化红队方法在对抗高级安全对齐时表现脆弱，因为它们依赖静态启发式或随机搜索。需要一种更有效、可扩展的方法来发现LLM漏洞。
AI.method: Metis将越狱重构为对抗性部分可观察马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP）中的推理时间策略优化。它采用自进化的元认知循环来诊断目标防御逻辑，并利用结构化反馈作为语义梯度来优化其策略，通过透明的推理轨迹提高可解释性。
AI.result: 在10个不同模型上的平均攻击成功率（ASR）达到89.2%，是所有对比方法中最高的。在弹性前沿模型（如O1上76.0%，GPT-5-chat上78.0%）上保持高效，而传统基线性能大幅下降。通过定向优化减少了冗余探索，平均降低了8.2倍的token成本，最高达11.4倍。分析表明，在测试环境下，当前的防御措施仍然容易受到内部引导、闭环推理轨迹的攻击。
AI.conclusion: 当前的LLM防御对内部引导的闭环推理轨迹仍然脆弱，迫切需要能够进行动态安全推理的下一代防御机制。
AI.translation: 红队测试对于发现大型语言模型（LLM）中的漏洞至关重要。虽然自动化方法提高了可扩展性，但现有方法通常依赖静态启发式或随机搜索，这使得它们在对抗高级安全对齐时表现脆弱。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了Metis，一个将越狱重构为对抗性部分可观察马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP）中的推理时间策略优化的框架。Metis采用自进化的元认知循环来对目标防御逻辑进行因果诊断，并利用结构化反馈作为语义梯度来优化其策略，通过透明的推理轨迹提供增强的可解释性。在10个不同模型上进行的广泛评估表明，Metis在所有对比方法中实现了最高的平均攻击成功率（ASR），达到89.2%，并在传统基线性能大幅下降的弹性前沿模型（例如，在O1上为76.0%，在GPT-5-chat上为78.0%）上保持了高效性。通过用定向优化取代冗余探索，Metis平均将token成本降低了8.2倍，最高达11.4倍。我们的分析揭示，在测试设置下，当前的防御措施仍然容易受到内部引导、闭环推理轨迹的攻击，这凸显了对能够在推理过程中动态推理安全性的下一代防御机制的迫切需求。
AI.summary: Metis是一个创新的框架，它将越狱LLM重新定义为对抗性POMDP中的推理时间策略优化问题。通过自进化的元认知循环和语义梯度反馈，Metis能够诊断LLM防御逻辑并高效地生成越狱策略。实验证明，Metis在多种LLM上实现了89.2%的平均攻击成功率，甚至对前沿模型也有效，同时显著降低了token成本。研究结果强调了当前LLM防御的脆弱性，并呼吁开发更强大的动态安全推理防御系统。
AI.keywords: LLM越狱, 元认知策略优化, 红队测试, 漏洞发现, 策略优化
AI.comments: Metis的创新之处在于将越狱问题框架化为POMDP中的策略优化，并引入了自进化的元认知循环和语义梯度，这使其比传统的静态启发式或随机搜索方法更具适应性和效率。其透明的推理轨迹也增强了可解释性。这项工作的重要性在于揭示了当前LLM安全防御的深层漏洞，特别是在面对闭环推理攻击时的脆弱性，为未来LLM安全防御的研发指明了方向。

title: In-Network Artificial Computing Enhanced Light Model-Switching for Emergency Communications Networks
summary: Emergency communications networks require in-network intelligence for timely traffic handling under dynamic demands and runtime constraints. In these environments, packets may need different inference behaviors, and conventional model replacement via control-plane updates is too slow for responsive operation. We propose an in-network artificial computing framework with lightweight model-switching, where multiple Binary Neural Network (BNN) models are kept resident within a shared execution framework. Packet metadata selects the active model at packet granularity with O(1) selection cost. A fixed 1024-byte payload is aligned with x86 AVX-512, enabling efficient memory access. The framework is realized on an eBPF/XDP + AF_XDP stack. Experimental results show that the system sustains 1.894 Mpps with a 0.528 us inference latency, while model selection adds only 0.005 us. Our results demonstrate that different resident models induce distinct packet-processing behaviors, that scaling to 16 slots preserves low switching overhead, and that online model switching completes without wrong-verdict packets. These results show the practicality of lightweight in-network artificial computing on commodity hardware.

AI.title_translation: 增强型网络内人工智能计算轻量级模型切换用于应急通信网络
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种用于应急通信网络的网络内人工智能计算框架，通过轻量级模型切换实现快速、动态的包处理，解决了传统控制平面更新慢的问题，并在商用硬件上实现了高吞吐量和低延迟。
AI.motivation: 应急通信网络需要在动态需求和运行时限制下进行及时的流量处理，要求网络内智能。传统通过控制平面更新的模型替换速度太慢，无法对需要不同推理行为的数据包做出响应。
AI.method: 提出了一种具有轻量级模型切换的网络内人工智能计算框架。该框架在共享执行框架内驻留多个二值神经网络（BNN）模型。数据包元数据以数据包粒度选择活动模型，选择成本为O(1)。固定1024字节的有效载荷与x86 AVX-512对齐，实现高效内存访问。该框架在eBPF/XDP + AF_XDP堆栈上实现。
AI.result: 系统可维持1.894 Mpps的吞吐量，推理延迟为0.528微秒。模型选择仅增加0.005微秒。不同的驻留模型会产生不同的数据包处理行为。扩展到16个槽位仍能保持较低的切换开销。在线模型切换完成时没有错误判决的数据包。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果表明，在商用硬件上实现轻量级网络内人工智能计算是可行的。
AI.translation: 应急通信网络需要在动态需求和运行时限制下进行及时的流量处理，要求网络内智能。在这些环境中，数据包可能需要不同的推理行为，而通过控制平面更新的传统模型替换对于响应式操作来说太慢。我们提出了一种具有轻量级模型切换的网络内人工智能计算框架，其中多个二值神经网络（BNN）模型驻留在共享执行框架内。数据包元数据以数据包粒度选择活动模型，选择成本为O(1)。固定的1024字节有效载荷与x86 AVX-512对齐，实现高效内存访问。该框架在eBPF/XDP + AF_XDP堆栈上实现。实验结果表明，该系统可维持1.894 Mpps的吞吐量，推理延迟为0.528微秒，而模型选择仅增加0.005微秒。我们的结果表明，不同的驻留模型会产生不同的数据包处理行为，扩展到16个槽位仍能保持较低的切换开销，并且在线模型切换完成时没有错误判决的数据包。这些结果表明，在商用硬件上实现轻量级网络内人工智能计算是可行的。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一种用于应急通信网络的网络内人工智能计算框架，旨在通过轻量级模型切换解决传统模型更新慢的问题。该框架将多个二值神经网络模型驻留在共享执行环境中，通过数据包元数据以O(1)成本进行模型选择。通过eBPF/XDP + AF_XDP堆栈实现，实验结果显示系统能达到1.894 Mpps的吞吐量和0.528微秒的推理延迟，模型切换开销极低，并验证了其在商用硬件上的实用性。
AI.keywords: 网络内计算, 模型切换, 应急通信, 二值神经网络, eBPF/XDP
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了一个轻量级的网络内AI计算框架，通过在网络边缘直接进行模型切换，显著提升了应急通信网络的响应速度和处理效率。利用BNN和eBPF/XDP技术栈，在商用硬件上实现了高性能，展示了在资源受限和时间敏感场景下的巨大潜力。

title: MFVLR: Multi-domain Fine-grained Vision-Language Reconstruction for Generalizable Diffusion Face Forgery Detection and Localization
summary: The swift advancement in photo-realistic face generation technology has sparked considerable concerns across society and academia, emphasizing the requirement of generalizable face forgery detection and localization methods. Prior works tend to capture face forgery patterns across multiple domains using image modality, other modalities like fine-grained texts are not comprehensively investigated, which restricts the generalization capability of models. Besides, they usually analyze facial images created by GAN, but struggle to identify and localize those synthesized by diffusion. To solve the problems, in this paper, we devise a novel multi-domain fine-grained vision-language reconstruction (MFVLR) model, which explores comprehensive and diverse visual forgery traces via language-guided face forgery representation learning, to achieve generalizable diffusion-synthesized face forgery detection and localization (DFFDL). Specifically, we devise a fine-grained language transformer that studies general fine-grained language embeddings using language reconstruction. We propose a multi-domain vision encoder to capture general and complementary visual forgery patterns across the image and residual domains. A vision decoder is designed to reconstruct image appearance and achieve forgery localization. Besides, we propose an innovative plug-and-play vision injection module to enhance the interaction between the vision and language embeddings. Extensive experiments and visualizations demonstrate that our network outperforms the state of the art on different settings like cross-generator, cross-forgery, and cross-dataset evaluations.

AI.title_translation: 多域细粒度视觉-语言重建用于可泛化扩散人脸伪造检测与定位
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为MFVLR的多域细粒度视觉-语言重建模型，用于检测和定位扩散模型生成的人脸伪造图像。该模型结合了图像和文本信息，通过语言重建学习细粒度语言嵌入，并使用多域视觉编码器捕捉不同来源的伪造模式，有效提升了跨生成器、跨伪造类型和跨数据集的检测和定位泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的人脸伪造检测方法主要依赖图像信息，未能充分利用细粒度文本信息，限制了模型的泛化能力。此外，现有方法在检测和定位扩散模型生成的伪造人脸方面存在困难。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为MFVLR（Multi-domain Fine-grained Vision-Language Reconstruction）的多域细粒度视觉-语言重建模型。该模型包含一个细粒度语言Transformer，通过语言重建学习通用细粒度语言嵌入；一个多域视觉编码器，用于捕捉图像和残差域中的通用且互补的视觉伪造模式；一个视觉解码器，用于重建图像外观并实现伪造定位；以及一个即插即用的视觉注入模块，增强视觉和语言嵌入之间的交互。
AI.result: 在跨生成器、跨伪造类型和跨数据集的评估中，该模型均优于现有技术水平，并通过可视化验证了其有效性。
AI.conclusion: MFVLR模型通过融合多域视觉信息和细粒度语言表示，能够有效检测和定位扩散模型生成的人脸伪造图像，并在多种设置下展现出优越的泛化能力。
AI.translation: 照片般逼真的面部生成技术的快速发展引起了社会和学术界的广泛关注，强调了对可泛化的人脸伪造检测和定位方法的需求。以往的研究倾向于利用图像模态跨多个域捕获人脸伪造模式，而像细粒度文本这样的其他模态则没有得到全面的研究，这限制了模型的泛化能力。此外，它们通常分析由GAN生成的人脸图像，但难以识别和定位由扩散模型合成的人脸。为了解决这些问题，本文设计了一种新颖的多域细粒度视觉-语言重建（MFVLR）模型，通过语言引导的人脸伪造表示学习来探索全面多样的视觉伪造痕迹，以实现可泛化的扩散合成人脸伪造检测和定位（DFFDL）。具体来说，我们设计了一个细粒度语言Transformer，通过语言重建来学习通用的细粒度语言嵌入。我们提出了一个多域视觉编码器来捕捉图像和残差域中的通用且互补的视觉伪造模式。设计了一个视觉解码器来重建图像外观并实现伪造定位。此外，我们提出了一个创新的即插即用视觉注入模块来增强视觉和语言嵌入之间的交互。大量的实验和可视化证明，我们的网络在不同的设置下，如跨生成器、跨伪造和跨数据集的评估中，均优于最先进的技术。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种名为MFVLR的多域细粒度视觉-语言重建模型，旨在解决当前人脸伪造检测和定位方法在泛化能力和处理扩散模型生成伪造方面存在的不足。MFVLR模型结合了图像和文本模态，通过语言重建学习细粒度语言表示，并利用多域视觉编码器捕捉不同来源的伪造模式。实验证明，该模型在跨不同生成器、伪造类型和数据集的评估中均表现出优越的性能和泛化能力。
AI.keywords: 人脸伪造检测, 扩散模型, 视觉-语言表示, 细粒度学习, 泛化能力
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种创新的多模态方法来解决人脸伪造检测的挑战，特别关注了扩散模型生成伪造的检测和定位。通过结合视觉和语言信息，并引入细粒度学习和多域编码，模型有望克服现有方法的局限性。该研究的亮点在于其对泛化能力的关注，并在多个基准测试中取得了优于现有技术的成果。未来的工作可以进一步探索不同模态的融合方式以及模型在更复杂场景下的鲁棒性。

title: PHAGE: Patent Heterogeneous Attention-Guided Graph Encoder for Representation Learning
summary: Patent claims form a directed dependency structure in which dependent claims inherit and refine the scope of earlier claims; however, existing patent encoders linearize claims as text and discard this hierarchy. Directly encoding this structure into self-attention poses two challenges: claim dependencies mix relation types that differ in semantics and extraction reliability, and the dependency graph is defined over claims while Transformers attend over tokens. PHAGE addresses the first challenge through a deterministic graph construction pipeline that separates near-deterministic legal citations from noisier rule-based technical relations, preserving type distinctions as heterogeneous edges. It addresses the second through a connectivity mask and learnable relation-aware biases that lift claim-level topology into token-level attention, allowing the encoder to differentially weight each relation type. A dual-granularity contrastive objective then aligns representations with both inter-patent taxonomy and intra-patent topology. PHAGE outperforms all baselines on classification, retrieval, and clustering, showing that intra-document claim topology is a stronger inductive bias than inter-document structure and that this bias persists in the encoder weights after training.

AI.title_translation: PHAGE：用于表示学习的专利异构注意力引导图编码器
AI.tldr: 现有专利编码器将权利要求线性化，忽略了权利要求之间的依赖关系。PHAGE通过构建异构图并使用连接掩码和关系感知偏差将权利要求级别的拓扑结构提升到token级别，从而解决了这个问题。它使用对比学习目标来对齐表示，并在分类、检索和聚类任务上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有专利编码器会线性化专利权利要求，从而丢失了权利要求之间的依赖关系层级信息。直接将这种结构编码到自注意力机制中存在挑战，因为权利要求依赖关系混合了不同语义和可靠性的关系类型，并且图结构是基于权利要求的，而Transformer关注的是token。
AI.method: PHAGE通过一个确定性的图构建流程来解决第一个挑战，该流程将近乎确定的法律引用与更嘈杂的基于规则的技术关系分开，并将类型区分保留为异构边。它通过连接掩码和可学习的关系感知偏差来解决第二个挑战，将权利要求级别的拓扑结构提升到token级别的注意力，允许编码器对每种关系类型进行差异化加权。然后，采用双粒度对比目标来对齐专利间的分类和专利内的拓扑结构表示。
AI.result: PHAGE在分类、检索和聚类任务上均优于所有基线方法，表明文档内的权利要求拓扑结构比文档间的结构具有更强的归纳偏置，并且这种偏置在训练后仍然保留在编码器权重中。
AI.conclusion: 文档内的权利要求拓扑结构比文档间的结构具有更强的归纳偏置，并且这种偏置在训练后仍然保留在编码器权重中。
AI.translation: 专利权利要求构成一个有向依赖结构，其中从属权利要求继承并完善了早期权利要求的范围；然而，现有的专利编码器将权利要求线性化为文本，并丢弃了这种层级结构。直接将这种结构编码到自注意力机制中存在两个挑战：权利要求依赖关系混合了语义不同且提取可靠性不同的关系类型，并且依赖图是针对权利要求定义的，而Transformer关注的是token。PHAGE通过一个确定性的图构建流程来解决第一个挑战，该流程将近乎确定的法律引用与更嘈杂的基于规则的技术关系分开，并将类型区分保留为异构边。它通过连接掩码和可学习的关系感知偏差来解决第二个挑战，将权利要求级别的拓扑结构提升到token级别的注意力，允许编码器对每种关系类型进行差异化加权。然后，采用双粒度对比目标来对齐专利间的分类和专利内的拓扑结构表示。PHAGE在分类、检索和聚类任务上均优于所有基线方法，表明文档内的权利要求拓扑结构比文档间的结构具有更强的归纳偏置，并且这种偏置在训练后仍然保留在编码器权重中。
AI.summary: PHAGE是一个创新的图编码器，用于处理专利文本中的层级结构。它通过构建异构图并引入连接掩码和关系感知偏差，有效地将权利要求之间的依赖关系融入到基于token的注意力机制中。通过双粒度对比学习，PHAGE能够学习到强大的表示，并在多项下游任务中取得优异表现，证明了文档内部结构信息的重要性。
AI.keywords: 图编码器, 专利分析, 异构图, 注意力机制, 表示学习
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种新颖的方法PHAGE，用于解决专利分析中现有编码器忽略权利要求层级依赖关系的问题。通过引入异构图和注意力机制，PHAGE能够有效地捕捉文档内部的结构信息，并在多项任务中取得显著成果。研究结果强调了文档内部结构信息的重要性，为专利分析领域提供了新的思路和工具。然而，对于不同类型技术关系提取的可靠性问题，以及如何进一步优化图构建流程以适应更复杂的情况，仍有待进一步研究。

title: Agentic Fuzzing: Opportunities and Challenges
summary:
Fuzzers and static analyzers find many bugs but struggle with logic bugs in mature codebases. Triggering such a bug often requires multi-step reasoning that produces no distinctive execution feedback, and variants can appear across implementations too different for a single pattern to match. Recent LLM-assisted approaches help, but they use LLMs as auxiliaries rather than as the reasoning engine.
  We propose agentic fuzzing, a bug-finding approach seeded by historical bugs in which deep agents perform the reasoning directly. Given a reference bug, the agent analyzes its root cause, hypothesizes new scenarios elsewhere in the codebase that may share that cause, and verifies each hypothesis by generating and running proof-of-concept code. This lets the agent find variants that differ completely in trigger path or code structure from the reference.
  We identify three practical challenges in implementing agentic fuzzing: harness engineering, redundant investigations across seeds with similar root causes, and scheduling seeds in a large corpus. We address these in AFuzz through a four-stage agent pipeline, scenario coverage that deduplicates previously explored scenarios, and a DPP-MAP scheduler that orders seeds by diversity. We ran AFuzz on the V8 JavaScript engine for about one month, finding 40 bugs (including three duplicates), receiving a total $35,000 bounty, and being assigned two CVEs. AFuzz also found 19 bugs (including one duplicate) in SpiderMonkey and JavaScriptCore using the seeds from V8. However, agentic fuzzing is in its early stages with several remaining open problems we discuss in the paper. Still, we think it points to a promising direction for finding logic bugs.

AI.tldr: Agentic fuzzing uses deep agents to reason about historical bugs and find new logic bugs by generating and running proof-of-concept code. An implementation called AFuzz addresses challenges like harness engineering and seed scheduling, finding 40 bugs in V8 and 19 bugs in other JavaScript engines.
AI.motivation: Traditional fuzzers and static analyzers struggle to find logic bugs in mature codebases, which often require multi-step reasoning with no distinctive execution feedback and can appear across implementations too different for a single pattern to match. LLM-assisted approaches have been limited by using LLMs as auxiliaries rather than reasoning engines.
AI.method: Agentic fuzzing is a bug-finding approach where deep agents analyze the root cause of historical bugs, hypothesize new scenarios in the codebase with similar causes, and verify these hypotheses by generating and running proof-of-concept code. The implementation AFuzz uses a four-stage agent pipeline, scenario coverage for deduplication, and a DPP-MAP scheduler for seed ordering.
AI.result: AFuzz found 40 bugs in the V8 JavaScript engine over one month, earning $35,000 in bug bounties and receiving two CVE assignments. It also found 19 bugs in SpiderMonkey and JavaScriptCore using seeds from V8.
AI.conclusion: Agentic fuzzing is a promising direction for finding logic bugs, despite being in its early stages with several open problems.
AI.translation:
模糊测试器和静态分析器可以发现许多错误，但在成熟的代码库中处理逻辑错误方面存在困难。触发此类错误通常需要多步推理，而这种推理不会产生独特的执行反馈，并且变体可能出现在对于单个模式来说过于不同的实现中。最近的 LLM 辅助方法有所帮助，但它们将 LLM 用作辅助工具，而不是推理引擎。
我们提出了 agentic fuzzing，一种以历史错误为种子的错误查找方法，其中深度代理直接执行推理。给定一个参考错误，代理会分析其根本原因，假设代码库中可能具有相同原因的新场景，并通过生成和运行概念验证代码来验证每个假设。这使得代理能够找到与参考错误在触发路径或代码结构上完全不同的变体。
我们确定了在实现 agentic fuzzing 方面面临的三个实际挑战：挂具工程、具有相似根本原因的种子之间的冗余调查以及在大型语料库中调度种子。我们在 AFuzz 中通过四阶段代理管道、对先前探索过的场景进行去重处理的场景覆盖以及按多样性对种子进行排序的 DPP-MAP 调度器来解决这些问题。我们在 V8 JavaScript 引擎上运行了 AFuzz 大约一个月，发现了 40 个错误（包括三个重复错误），获得了总计 35,000 美元的奖金，并被分配了两个 CVE。AFuzz 还使用 V8 的种子在 SpiderMonkey 和 JavaScriptCore 中发现了 19 个错误（包括一个重复错误）。然而，agentic fuzzing 仍处于早期阶段，存在一些尚未解决的问题，我们在论文中进行了讨论。尽管如此，我们认为它为查找逻辑错误指明了一个有前途的方向。
AI.summary: This paper introduces agentic fuzzing, a novel bug-finding approach that leverages deep agents to directly perform reasoning on historical bugs. Unlike previous methods that used LLMs as auxiliaries, agentic fuzzing employs agents to analyze bug root causes, hypothesize new scenarios, and generate proof-of-concept code to find variants that differ significantly from the original bug. The authors address practical implementation challenges through a structured pipeline and optimized scheduling in their AFuzz system, demonstrating its effectiveness by discovering numerous bugs in JavaScript engines and securing bug bounties and CVEs. While acknowledging the early stage of this approach and remaining open problems, the paper highlights agentic fuzzing as a promising direction for tackling complex logic bugs.
AI.keywords: Agentic Fuzzing, Logic Bugs, Deep Agents, LLM-assisted Fuzzing, Bug Finding
AI.comments: The paper presents a novel and promising approach to bug finding using 'agentic fuzzing,' which moves beyond traditional methods by employing deep agents for direct reasoning. The implementation, AFuzz, demonstrates significant practical success in finding bugs in complex software like the V8 JavaScript engine, evidenced by bug bounties and CVEs. The structured approach to addressing challenges like harness engineering and seed scheduling is commendable. However, the paper acknowledges that the field is nascent, and further research is needed to overcome remaining open problems, such as scaling and the complexity of agent training.

title: Active Testing of Large Language Models via Approximate Neyman Allocation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) require reliable evaluation from pre-training to test-time scaling, making evaluation a recurring rather than one-off cost. As model scales grow and target tasks increasingly demand expert annotators, both the compute and labeling costs needed for each evaluation rise rapidly. Active testing aims to alleviate this bottleneck by approximating the evaluation result from a small but informative subset of the evaluation pool. However, existing approaches primarily target classification and break down on generative tasks. We introduce a novel active testing algorithm tailored to generative tasks. Our method leverages semantic entropy from surrogate models to stratify the evaluation pool and then conducts approximate Neyman allocation based on signals extracted from these surrogates. Across multiple language and multimodal benchmarks and a range of surrogate-target model pairs, our method significantly improves on baselines and closely tracks Oracle-Neyman, delivering up to 28\% MSE reduction over Uniform Sampling and an average of 22.9\% budget savings.

AI.title_translation: 通过近似Neyman分配对大型语言模型进行主动测试
AI.tldr: 提出了一种针对大模型生成任务的主动测试算法，通过近似Neyman分配和语义熵分层，在显著降低评估成本的同时保证了评估精度。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型规模的扩大和评估任务复杂度的增加，传统的评估方法面临巨大的计算和标注成本瓶颈，且现有主动测试方法多局限于分类任务，不适用于生成式任务。
AI.method: 提出了一种针对生成式任务的主动测试算法。利用代理模型的语义熵对评估池进行分层，并基于代理模型提取的信号执行近似Neyman分配，从而选择最具信息量的子集进行评估。
AI.result: 在多个语言和多模态基准测试中，该方法显著优于现有基准，相较于均匀采样，MSE降低了高达28%，平均节省了22.9%的评估预算。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明了基于近似Neyman分配的主动测试方法能够显著降低大型语言模型在生成式任务中的评估成本，同时保持高精度的评估结果。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）从预训练到测试时扩展都需要可靠的评估，这使得评估成为一种持续性的而非一次性的成本。随着模型规模的增长和目标任务对专家标注者需求的增加，每次评估所需的计算和标注成本迅速上升。主动测试旨在通过从一个较小但信息量大的评估子集来近似评估结果，从而缓解这一瓶颈。然而，现有方法主要针对分类任务，在生成式任务上表现不佳。我们引入了一种专为生成式任务量身定制的新型主动测试算法。我们的方法利用来自代理模型的语义熵对评估池进行分层，然后根据从这些代理中提取的信号进行近似Neyman分配。在多个语言和多模态基准测试以及一系列代理-目标模型对上，我们的方法显著优于基准，并紧密追踪Oracle-Neyman的效果，相较于均匀采样，MSE降低了高达28%，平均节省了22.9%的预算。
AI.summary: 本文针对大语言模型在生成式任务中评估成本高昂的问题，提出了一种基于近似Neyman分配的主动测试算法。该算法通过代理模型的语义熵对数据进行分层采样，大幅提升了评估效率和准确性。
AI.keywords: 主动测试, 大语言模型, Neyman分配, 生成式任务, 语义熵
AI.comments: 该论文通过将统计学中的Neyman分配方法引入到生成式任务的主动测试中，有效地解决了在大模型评估中高昂的计算和标注成本问题。其创新点在于利用代理模型的语义熵进行分层，并在生成式任务中实现了高效的样本分配，具有很强的实用价值和理论意义。

title: Scalable Design of Attack-Resilient Controllers for Positive Systems
comments: 3 figures, submitted to L-CSS and CDC 2026
summary: This paper proposes a framework for secure and resilient controller design for positive systems against cyber-attacks. In particular, we consider a network-controlled system where an adversary injects false data into the actuator channels to increase the control cost (performance measure) while penalizing the attack effort and subject to state-dependent constraints. Using a minimax formulation, we analyze the worst-case performance loss caused by such adversaries, which is given by the solution of a difference equation, and an algebraic equation when the time horizon is infinite. We show that the optimal attack policy, among possible nonlinear policies, is linear. Despite the lack of explicit stealthiness constraints, we also show that when the measured output has an unstable zero which is not an unstable zero of the performance measure, the attacks can induce unbounded performance degradation. The proposed framework is also extended to systems with model uncertainty. Numerical examples illustrate the results and demonstrate how tools from positive systems and linear regulator theory can be used to mitigate cyber-attacks with low computational effort.
comment: 3 figures, submitted to L-CSS and CDC 2026

AI.title_translation: 面向正系统的可扩展攻击弹性控制器设计
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种用于正系统抵抗网络攻击的安全弹性控制器设计框架，通过最小极大化方法分析攻击者造成的最坏情况性能损失，并证明了最优攻击策略是线性的。研究还扩展到具有模型不确定性的系统，并通过数值示例说明了如何利用正系统和线性调节器理论来低成本地缓解网络攻击。
AI.motivation: 设计用于正系统的、能够抵抗网络攻击的安全且有弹性的控制器。
AI.method: 采用最小极大化（minimax）方法，分析了网络攻击者注入虚假数据到执行器通道以增加控制成本（性能度量）并惩罚攻击努力，同时受到状态依赖约束的影响时的最坏情况性能损失。该损失由差分方程的解给出，对于无限时间范围则由代数方程给出。研究还证明了最优攻击策略是线性的，并探讨了在没有明确隐蔽性约束的情况下，攻击如何导致无限的性能下降（当测量输出具有不稳定的零且该零不是性能度量的所有者时）。框架被扩展到包含模型不确定性的系统。
AI.result: 最优攻击策略是线性的。当测量输出具有不稳定的零且该零不是性能度量的所有者时，攻击可以导致无限的性能下降。该框架被成功扩展到具有模型不确定性的系统。数值示例证明了该框架的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该论文提出了一种新颖的框架，用于设计抵抗网络攻击的正系统控制器。该框架利用最小极大化方法，并能有效处理模型不确定性。研究结果表明，正系统和线性调节器理论的工具可以用于低计算成本地缓解网络攻击。
AI.translation: 本文提出了一个用于正系统的安全弹性控制器设计框架，以抵抗网络攻击。特别地，我们考虑了一个网络控制系统，其中一个对手向执行器通道注入虚假数据，以增加控制成本（性能度量），同时惩罚攻击的努力，并受到状态依赖约束的约束。使用最小极大化（minimax）方法，我们分析了此类对手造成的最坏情况性能损失，该损失由差分方程的解给出，当时间范围为无限时，则由代数方程给出。我们证明了，在可能的非线性策略中，最优攻击策略是线性的。尽管缺乏明确的隐蔽性约束，但我们也表明，当测量输出具有不稳定的零且该零不是性能度量的所有者时，攻击会导致无限的性能下降。所提出的框架也被扩展到具有模型不确定性的系统。数值示例说明了结果，并证明了如何使用正系统和线性调节器理论的工具来以较低的计算成本缓解网络攻击。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种针对正系统在网络攻击下的安全弹性控制器设计框架。该框架采用最小极大化方法，分析了攻击者注入虚假数据造成的最坏情况性能损失，并证明了最优攻击策略是线性的。此外，研究还将该框架扩展至包含模型不确定性的系统，并通过数值示例展示了如何利用正系统和线性调节器理论的工具，以较低的计算成本有效缓解网络攻击。
AI.keywords: 正系统, 弹性控制器, 网络攻击, 最小极大化, 模型不确定性
AI.comments: 该研究在网络安全和控制理论交叉领域做出了重要贡献，提出了一种新颖的框架来应对正系统面临的网络攻击挑战。其亮点在于利用了正系统理论的特性，并结合了最小极大化方法来分析和设计鲁棒控制器。研究结果表明，即使在没有明确隐蔽性约束的情况下，攻击也可能导致严重的性能下降，这强调了设计弹性控制器的必要性。此外，将框架扩展到模型不确定性系统以及利用低计算成本的工具来缓解攻击，增加了该研究的实用价值。然而，论文可能可以进一步探讨不同类型攻击的普适性，以及在更复杂的系统模型下的性能表现。

title: SocialDirector: Training-Free Social Interaction Control for Multi-Person Video Generation
summary: Video generation has advanced rapidly, producing photorealistic videos from text or image prompts. Meanwhile, film production and social robotics increasingly demand multi-person videos with rich social interactions, including conversations, gestures, and coordinated actions. However, existing models offer no explicit control over interactions, such as who performs which action, when it occurs, and toward whom it is directed. This often results in wrong person performing unintended actions (actor-action mismatch), disordered social dynamics, and wrong action targets. To address these challenges, we present SocialDirector, a training-free interaction controller that enhances the generation model by modulating cross-attention maps. SocialDirector contains two modules: Social Actor Masking and Directional Reweighting. Social Actor Masking constrains each person's visual tokens to attend only to their own textual descriptions via a spatiotemporal mask, avoiding actor-action mismatch and disordered social dynamics. Directional Reweighting amplifies attention to directional words (e.g., "leftward", "right"), leading each action towards its intended target. To evaluate generated social interactions, we annotate existing datasets with interaction descriptions and build a fully automated evaluation pipeline powered by open-source VLMs. Experiments on different video generation models show that SocialDirector significantly improves interaction fidelity and approaches the upper bound set by real videos.

AI.title_translation: 社交总监：视频生成中无需训练的社交互动控制
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了SocialDirector，一种无需训练的控制器，用于增强多人物视频生成中的社交互动控制，解决了动作主体-动作不匹配、社交动态混乱和目标错误等问题，通过社交演员遮蔽和定向重加权模块实现，并在评估中表现出色。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成模型在控制多人物视频中的社交互动方面存在不足，例如动作主体-动作不匹配、社交动态混乱和目标错误。
AI.method: SocialDirector通过调制交叉注意力图来增强生成模型，包含两个模块：社交演员遮蔽（通过时空遮蔽限制个体视觉标记仅关注自身文本描述）和定向重加权（放大对方向性词语的注意力，使动作指向目标）。
AI.result: SocialDirector显著提高了互动保真度，并且在不同视频生成模型上的实验结果表明其效果接近真实视频的上限。
AI.conclusion: SocialDirector能够有效控制多人物视频中的社交互动，解决了现有模型存在的痛点，并在实验中得到了验证。
AI.translation: 视频生成发展迅速，能够根据文本或图像提示生成逼真的视频。与此同时，影视制作和社交机器人领域对具有丰富社交互动（包括对话、手势和协调动作）的多人物视频的需求日益增长。然而，现有模型无法对互动进行显式控制，例如谁执行哪个动作、何时发生以及指向谁。这常常导致错误的人执行非预期的动作（演员-动作不匹配）、混乱的社交动态以及错误的动作目标。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了SocialDirector，一种无需训练的互动控制器，通过调制交叉注意力图来增强生成模型。SocialDirector包含两个模块：社交演员遮蔽和定向重加权。社交演员遮蔽通过时空遮蔽，将每个人的视觉标记限制为仅关注他们自己的文本描述，从而避免演员-动作不匹配和混乱的社交动态。定向重加权则放大了对方向性词语（例如，“向左”，“向右”）的注意力，使每个动作都指向其预期的目标。为了评估生成的社交互动，我们为现有数据集添加了互动描述，并构建了一个由开源VLM驱动的全自动化评估流程。在不同视频生成模型上的实验表明，SocialDirector显著提高了互动保真度，并且效果接近真实视频设定的上限。
AI.summary: SocialDirector是一种新颖的、无需训练的控制器，用于增强多人物视频生成中的社交互动。它通过社交演员遮蔽来防止演员-动作不匹配和混乱的社交动态，并通过定向重加权来确保动作指向正确的对象。通过这些方法，SocialDirector显著提高了生成视频中社交互动的真实性和准确性。
AI.keywords: 社交互动控制, 视频生成, 交叉注意力, 社交演员遮蔽, 定向重加权
AI.comments: 该研究提出的SocialDirector在解决多人物视频生成中社交互动控制的难题方面具有重要意义。其“无需训练”的特性和创新的模块设计（社交演员遮蔽和定向重加权）使其具有广泛的应用前景和潜力。然而，对于其在复杂场景和多样化互动类型下的泛化能力，以及对计算资源的需求，还需要进一步的探讨。

title: Delay-Robust Secondary Frequency Control via Passive Interconnection and Randomized Block Updates
summary: This paper studies secondary frequency control in transmission networks subject to communication delays at the cyber-physical interface and limited per-update computation at the control center. The regulation objective is formulated as a constrained economic dispatch problem incorporating generation capacity constraints, nodal power balance, transmission-flow limits, and scheduled tie-line power exchanges. Based on this formulation, we develop a passivity-based control framework in which an augmented projected primal-dual controller restores nominal frequency and drives the closed-loop system to the solution set of the constrained economic dispatch problem. Two-way communication delays between the physical network and the control center are modeled as scattering-based passive channels for the measurement uplink and the control-command downlink. This construction preserves the target equilibrium and enables a delay-robust passivity analysis of the delayed closed loop. To reduce the computational burden at the control center, we develop a randomized block-coordinate implementation of the augmented projected primal-dual controller. The resulting sampled-data closed loop preserves the target solution set and achieves local mean-square geometric convergence under suitable step-size and regularity conditions. Finally, a multivariable wave-domain interface filter is introduced to inject additional dissipation and improve the damping of the delayed interface without altering the steady-state interconnection. Simulations on the IEEE 14-bus system indicate that the proposed digital implementation accurately reproduces the delayed closed-loop behavior while reducing the per-update computational cost.

AI.title_translation: 基于无源互联和随机块更新的延迟鲁棒二次频率控制
AI.tldr: 提出了一种结合无源控制与随机块更新的方法，有效解决了电力系统在通信延迟下的二次频率控制难题，并降低了计算需求。
AI.motivation: 在传输网络中，二次频率控制面临通信延迟和控制中心计算能力受限的问题，需要一种既能保持系统稳定又能降低计算复杂度的控制策略。
AI.method: 构建了一个增广投影原对偶控制器，采用基于散射的无源通道处理通信延迟，并利用随机块坐标更新降低控制中心的计算负担，同时引入波域接口滤波器增强阻尼。
AI.result: 仿真结果表明，所提方法在IEEE 14节点系统上能够准确实现频率恢复和经济调度目标，同时显著降低了每次更新的计算成本，并证明了其在局部均方意义下的几何收敛性。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的基于无源互联和随机块更新的控制框架，在存在通信延迟和计算约束的情况下，能有效实现频率恢复和经济调度，且具有良好的收敛性和计算效率。
AI.translation: 本文研究了存在网络物理接口通信延迟和控制中心单次更新计算量受限情况下的传输网络二次频率控制问题。调节目标被表述为包含发电容量约束、节点功率平衡、传输流量限制和预定联络线功率交换的约束经济调度问题。基于此表述，我们开发了一个基于无源性的控制框架，其中增广投影原对偶控制器可恢复标称频率并将闭环系统驱动至约束经济调度问题的解集。物理网络与控制中心之间的双向通信延迟被建模为测量上行链路和控制命令下行链路的基于散射的无源通道。这种构造保留了目标平衡点，并实现了延迟闭环的延迟鲁棒无源性分析。为了减少控制中心的计算负担，我们开发了增广投影原对偶控制器的随机块坐标实现。所得采样数据闭环保留了目标解集，并在合适的步长和正则性条件下实现了局部均方几何收敛。最后，引入了一个多变量波域接口滤波器来注入额外的耗散并改善延迟接口的阻尼，而不改变稳态互联。在IEEE 14节点系统上的仿真表明，所提出的数字实现准确地再现了延迟闭环行为，同时降低了单次更新的计算成本。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种针对传输网络二次频率控制的鲁棒方案，通过无源性框架处理通信延迟，并利用随机块坐标更新技术减轻计算压力，实现了在延迟环境下频率的稳定控制与经济调度。
AI.keywords: 二次频率控制, 通信延迟, 无源性, 随机块坐标更新, 经济调度
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于将无源性分析与随机块坐标更新相结合，有效解决了电力系统中通信延迟和计算资源受限的双重挑战。通过引入波域接口滤波器进一步提升了系统的稳定性，具有很高的实际应用价值。

title: FERA: Uncertainty-Aware Federated Reasoning for Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit strong reasoning capabilities when guided by high-quality demonstrations, yet such data is often distributed across organizations that cannot centralize it due to regulatory, proprietary, or institutional constraints. We study federated reasoning, where a server improves multi-step reasoning by coordinating with heterogeneous clients holding private demonstrations, without centralized training or raw data sharing. The key challenge is that client reliability is query-dependent, while the server cannot inspect client data to determine which contributions are trustworthy. To address this, we propose Uncertainty-Aware Federated Reasoning (FERA), a training-free framework based on iterative server-client co-refinement. Across communication rounds, clients generate reasoning traces with lightweight uncertainty estimates, and the server synthesizes them into improved reasoning that is redistributed as context for the next round, progressively improving both server outputs and client-side reasoning. Within each round, Uncertainty-Aware Self-Critique Aggregation (UA-SCA) resolves conflicts among heterogeneous client traces through query-dependent trust weighting and structured cross-client verification. Rather than simply discarding low-quality traces, UA-SCA revises flawed reasoning steps to recover useful information. We provide theoretical guarantees showing that the proposed iterative protocol converges and that uncertainty-aware weighting accelerates convergence. Experiments on multiple reasoning benchmarks show that FERA consistently outperforms both federated training and training-free baselines, achieving progressively higher accuracy across rounds while maintaining communication and computational efficiency.

AI.title_translation: FERA：面向大型语言模型的不确定性感知联邦推理
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为FERA（不确定性感知联邦推理）的框架，用于在不共享原始数据的情况下，通过服务器与多个客户端协作来提升大型语言模型的推理能力。FERA通过迭代式的服务器-客户端协同细化过程，利用客户端提供的带有不确定性估计的推理过程，并由服务器进行整合，逐步改进推理的准确性。其核心在于UA-SCA机制，能够根据查询动态调整客户端的可信度，并通过跨客户端验证来解决冲突，甚至能修正错误推理。理论分析和实验均表明FERA能够有效收敛并优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在有高质量示例指导时表现出强大的推理能力，但这些数据通常分散在不同组织，由于监管、专有或机构限制无法集中。因此，需要在不集中训练或共享原始数据的情况下，研究如何通过联邦推理来提升多步推理能力。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为FERA（不确定性感知联邦推理）的训练无关框架，该框架基于迭代的服务器-客户端协同细化。客户端生成带有轻量级不确定性估计的推理过程，服务器将其综合成改进的推理结果，并作为下一轮的上下文重新分发。在每一轮中，UA-SCA（不确定性感知自我批评聚合）通过查询依赖的信任加权和结构化跨客户端验证来解决异构客户端推理过程中的冲突，并修正错误的推理步骤以恢复有用信息。
AI.result: 实验表明，FERA在多个推理基准上持续优于联邦训练和训练无关的基线方法，并且随着通信轮次的增加，准确性逐步提高，同时保持了通信和计算效率。理论分析也证明了该迭代协议的收敛性以及不确定性感知加权能够加速收敛。
AI.conclusion: FERA框架通过不确定性感知和迭代协同细化，有效地解决了联邦推理中的挑战，能够在不共享原始数据的情况下，提升大型语言模型的推理能力，并展现出良好的收敛性和效率。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在有高质量示例指导时展现出强大的推理能力，但这类数据通常分布在各个组织中，由于监管、专有或机构限制，这些组织无法将数据集中起来。我们研究联邦推理，其中服务器通过与拥有私有示例的异构客户端进行协调来改进多步推理，而无需集中训练或原始数据共享。关键挑战在于客户端的可靠性是依赖于查询的，而服务器无法检查客户端数据来确定哪些贡献是可信的。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了不确定性感知联邦推理（FERA），一个基于迭代服务器-客户端协同细化的训练无关框架。在通信轮次之间，客户端生成带有轻量级不确定性估计的推理过程，服务器将它们综合成改进的推理，并作为下一轮的上下文重新分发，逐步改进服务器输出和客户端推理。在每一轮中，不确定性感知自我批评聚合（UA-SCA）通过依赖查询的信任加权和结构化的跨客户端验证来解决异构客户端推理过程中的冲突。UA-SCA不只是丢弃低质量的推理过程，而是修正错误的推理步骤以恢复有用信息。我们提供了理论保证，表明所提出的迭代协议能够收敛，并且不确定性感知加权能够加速收敛。在多个推理基准上的实验表明，FERA持续优于联邦训练和训练无关的基线方法，在通信和计算效率的同时，准确性随着轮次的增加而逐步提高。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种名为FERA（不确定性感知联邦推理）的框架，旨在解决大型语言模型（LLMs）在数据隐私限制下进行联邦推理的挑战。FERA通过迭代的服务器-客户端协同细化过程，利用客户端提供的带有不确定性估计的推理过程，并由服务器进行整合，逐步提升推理的准确性。该框架的核心是UA-SCA机制，它能够根据查询动态地评估客户端的可信度，并通过跨客户端验证来解决和修正推理过程中的冲突和错误，从而在不共享原始数据的情况下实现高效且准确的推理。
AI.keywords: 联邦推理, 大型语言模型, 不确定性感知, 协同细化, UA-SCA
AI.comments: FERA框架通过引入不确定性估计和创新的UA-SCA机制，有效地解决了联邦学习中客户端异构性和数据隐私的问题，为在分布式环境下提升LLMs的推理能力提供了一个新颖且实用的解决方案。其训练无关的特性和理论保证进一步增强了该方法的吸引力。然而，实际应用中不确定性估计的准确性和UA-SCA机制在处理极端异构性时的鲁棒性值得进一步探讨。

title: Unlocking air traffic flow prediction through microscopic aircraft-state modeling
summary: Short-term air traffic flow prediction in terminal airspace is essential for proactive air traffic management. Existing approaches predominantly model traffic flow as aggregated time series, despite traffic dynamics being governed by aircraft states and interactions in continuous airspace. Such aggregation obscures fine-grained information including aircraft kinematics, boundary interactions, and control intent. Here we present AeroSense, a state-to-flow modeling framework that predicts future traffic flow directly from instantaneous airspace situations represented as dynamic sets of aircraft states derived from ADS-B trajectories. By establishing an end-to-end mapping from microscopic aircraft states to future regional traffic flow, AeroSense preserves aircraft-level dynamics while naturally accommodating varying traffic density without relying on historical look-back windows. Experiments on a large-scale real-world dataset show that AeroSense consistently improves predictive accuracy over aggregation-based forecasting approaches, particularly during high-density traffic periods. These findings suggest that instantaneous airspace situations provide an effective alternative to conventional time-series-based traffic forecasting paradigms.

AI.title_translation: 通过微观飞机状态建模解锁空中交通流预测
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为AeroSense的新框架，通过模拟单个飞机的状态来预测空域内的交通流量，解决了传统基于聚合时间序列的方法在处理高密度交通时的不足。
AI.motivation: 现有空中交通流预测方法主要将交通流视为聚合时间序列，忽略了飞机状态和相互作用在连续空域中的动态影响，导致丢失了精细信息。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为AeroSense的端到端建模框架，直接从代表瞬时空域状况的飞机状态动态集合（源自ADS-B轨迹）来预测未来的交通流量，保留了飞机级别的动态，并能适应不同的交通密度，无需历史回溯。
AI.result: 在包含大量真实世界数据的实验中，AeroSense在预测精度上持续优于基于聚合的方法，尤其是在高密度交通时段。
AI.conclusion: 瞬时空域状况可以作为一种有效的替代方法，用于替代传统的基于时间序列的交通预测范式。
AI.translation: 短期空域交通流量预测对于主动空中交通管理至关重要。现有方法主要将交通流量建模为聚合时间序列，尽管交通动态受连续空域中飞机状态和相互作用的控制。这种聚合掩盖了包括飞机运动学、边界交互和控制意图在内的细粒度信息。在这里，我们提出了AeroSense，一个状态到流量的建模框架，直接从代表瞬时空域状况的飞机状态动态集合（源自ADS-B轨迹）来预测未来交通流量。通过建立从微观飞机状态到未来区域交通流量的端到端映射，AeroSense保留了飞机级别的动态，同时自然地适应不同的交通密度，而无需依赖历史回溯窗口。在大规模真实世界数据集上的实验表明，AeroSense在预测精度上持续优于基于聚合的预测方法，尤其是在高密度交通时段。这些发现表明，瞬时空域状况为传统的基于时间序列的交通预测范式提供了一种有效的替代方案。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了AeroSense框架，通过模拟单个飞机的状态来预测空域内的交通流量，克服了传统聚合时间序列方法的局限性，尤其是在高密度交通情况下，提高了预测精度。
AI.keywords: 空中交通流预测, 微观建模, 飞机状态, AeroSense, 短期预测
AI.comments: 这项研究通过引入一种新的微观视角来预测空中交通流，解决了现有方法的关键局限性。AeroSense框架通过直接利用飞机状态信息，有望提高预测的准确性和实时性，尤其是在复杂的交通条件下。然而，该方法对ADS-B数据的依赖性以及在不同空域和交通模式下的泛化能力仍需进一步验证。

title: Designing for Collective Access: In Search of a Solution to Accessible Communication in a Mixed-Ability Non-Profit
summary: As mixed-ability collaboration has become increasingly focal within accessibility research, managing varied, and sometimes conflicting, access needs has become a key consideration in designing for access. When an accessibility feature or practice benefits some people while constraining others, how should designers navigate these trade-offs? This paper responds to this question by analyzing how a mixed-ability nonprofit worked to make communication accessible to its members as it grew from a small blind-focused athletic group to a larger cross-disability organization. Based on a six-month study that combines interviews and field observations, we show that working with conflicting access needs is not just a technical 'problem' but a generative process that sparks reflection on technical constraints and preferences, diverse roles and communication norms, and organizational demands. We therefore argue for rethinking "conflicts" in access as key sites for revealing power structures and creating opportunities for accountability and repair.

AI.title_translation: 为集体访问而设计：探寻混合能力非营利组织中无障碍沟通的解决方案
AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了在混合能力非营利组织中，当无障碍需求存在冲突时，设计师如何通过反思和组织过程来解决沟通障碍问题。
AI.motivation: 随着混合能力协作在可访问性研究中日益受到关注，管理不同甚至冲突的可访问性需求已成为可访问性设计的关键考虑因素。当一项可访问性功能或实践使某些人受益但限制了其他人时，设计师应如何权衡这些取舍？
AI.method: 通过对一个混合能力非营利组织为期六个月的研究，结合访谈和实地观察，分析该组织如何在其成员中实现无障碍沟通。
AI.result: 研究表明，处理冲突的可访问性需求不仅仅是一个技术问题，而是一个能引发对技术限制、偏好、不同角色和沟通规范以及组织需求的思考的生成过程。
AI.conclusion: 作者认为，应将可访问性中的“冲突”视为揭示权力结构、创造问责和修复机会的关键环节。
AI.translation: 随着混合能力协作在可访问性研究中日益受到关注，管理不同甚至冲突的可访问性需求已成为可访问性设计的关键考虑因素。当一项可访问性功能或实践使某些人受益但限制了其他人时，设计师应如何权衡这些取舍？本文通过分析一个混合能力非营利组织在其成员中实现无障碍沟通的努力，回应了这一问题，该组织从一个小型、以盲人为中心的运动团体发展成为一个更大的、跨残障类别的组织。基于一项为期六个月的研究，结合了访谈和实地观察，我们表明，处理冲突的可访问性需求不仅仅是一个技术“问题”，而是一个生成过程，它引发了对技术限制和偏好、不同的角色和沟通规范以及组织需求的思考。因此，我们主张重新思考可访问性中的“冲突”，将其视为揭示权力结构以及创造问责和修复机会的关键环节。
AI.summary: 本研究通过对一个混合能力非营利组织的案例分析，探讨了在面对相互冲突的可访问性需求时，如何设计和管理无障碍沟通。研究结合了访谈和实地观察，发现处理这些冲突是一个生成性的过程，能够促进对技术、沟通规范和组织需求的深入反思，并最终将冲突视为揭示权力结构和创造问责机会的关键。
AI.keywords: 混合能力,无障碍沟通,冲突,非营利组织,权力结构
AI.comments: 该研究强调了在混合能力环境中，可访问性设计不仅仅是技术问题，更是一个涉及组织、权力和沟通规范的复杂过程。将冲突视为机遇而非障碍，为未来的研究和实践提供了新的视角。

title: A cell-decomposition based path planner for 3D navigation in constrained workspaces
comments: Accepted for publication at the 23rd IFAC World Congress (Busan, Korea)
summary: This paper proposes a cell decomposition algorithm for binary occupancy grids that ensures mutual complete visibility from each cell to at least one adjacent cell. This decomposition establishes a simplified framework for verifying path feasibility that can be easily embedded in optimization problems. To illustrate its utility, we formulate both second-order cone programs (SOCP) and their mixed-integer variant (MISOCP) within the proposed framework. Furthermore, we propose the KSP-SOCP method, which combines Yen's k-shortest path algorithm with the SOCP, achieving improved solutions compared to a standard SOCP approach while avoiding the computational burden of MISOCP. The cell decomposition algorithm, KSP-SOCP, and MISOCP approaches were evaluated in 9 city-like workspaces. The decomposition efficiently partitioned each map, enabling both optimization methods to compute feasible paths. The proposed KSP-SOCP achieved time performance comparable to the MISOCP while requiring less memory, making it highly suitable for large-scale problems.
comment: Accepted for publication at the 23rd IFAC World Congress (Busan, Korea)

AI.title_translation: 一种基于单元分解的约束工作空间三维导航路径规划器
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种用于二元占用栅格的单元分解算法，用于三维导航，并结合了KSP算法和SOCP优化，在保证路径可行的同时提高了效率和内存使用率。
AI.motivation: 为在约束工作空间中进行三维导航，需要一种能够简化路径可行性验证并能嵌入优化问题的路径规划方法。
AI.method: 提出一种二元占用栅格的单元分解算法，确保每个单元与至少一个相邻单元之间具有完全可见性，并在此基础上构建了SOCP和MISOCP优化问题，同时提出了KSP-SOCP方法。
AI.result: 在9个城市类工作空间中，该单元分解算法能有效地分割地图，使得SOCP和MISOCP方法都能计算出可行路径。KSP-SOCP方法的耗时与MISOCP相当，但内存占用更少。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的单元分解方法能够有效地简化三维导航中的路径规划问题，并且KSP-SOCP方法在效率和内存占用方面优于标准SOCP和MISOCP方法，适用于大规模问题。
AI.translation: 本文提出了一种用于二元占用栅格的单元分解算法，该算法确保了从每个单元到至少一个相邻单元的相互完全可见性。这种分解为验证路径可行性建立了一个简化的框架，可以轻松地嵌入到优化问题中。为了说明其效用，我们在提出的框架内构建了二阶锥规划（SOCP）及其混合整数变体（MISOCP）。此外，我们提出了KSP-SOCP方法，它将Yen的k-最短路径算法与SOCP相结合，与标准的SOCP方法相比，在避免MISOCP的计算负担的同时获得了改进的解决方案。在9个城市类工作空间中对单元分解算法、KSP-SOCP和MISOCP方法进行了评估。该分解有效地分割了每个地图，使得两种优化方法都能计算出可行路径。所提出的KSP-SOCP在时间和性能上与MISOCP相当，但内存占用更少，因此非常适合大规模问题。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种新颖的单元分解算法，用于解决约束工作空间中的三维导航路径规划问题。该算法能够有效地将二元占用栅格地图分解为具有完全可见性的单元，为路径可行性验证提供了一个简化的框架。在此基础上，研究人员构建了基于二阶锥规划（SOCP）和混合整数二阶锥规划（MISOCP）的优化方法。特别地，他们提出了一种结合Yen的k-最短路径算法和SOCP的KSP-SOCP方法。通过在9个城市类工作空间中的实验评估，结果表明该单元分解算法能够高效地分割地图，并且KSP-SOCP方法在计算时间和内存占用方面均表现优于MISOCP方法，为大规模三维导航问题提供了一种有效的解决方案。
AI.keywords: 单元分解, 三维导航, 路径规划, SOCP, KSP-SOCP
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种创新的单元分解方法，有效地解决了三维导航中约束工作空间的路径规划问题。KSP-SOCP方法的提出，在保证路径可行性的前提下，显著提高了计算效率和内存使用率，尤其适用于大规模应用场景。然而，对于复杂或动态环境下的适应性仍需进一步研究。

title: Initiation of Interaction Detection Framework using a Nonverbal Cue for Human-Robot Interaction
summary: This paper describes an initiation of interaction(IoI) detection framework without keywords for human-robot interaction(HRI) based on audio and vision sensor fusion in a domestic environment. In the proposed framework, the robot has its own audio and vision sensors, and can employ external vision sensor for stable human detection and tracking. When the user starts to speak while looking at the robot, the robot can localize his or her position by its sound source localization together with human tracking information. Then the robot can detect the IoI if it perceives the face of the speaker faces the robot. In case that the user does not speak directly, the robot can also detect the IoI if he or she looks at the robot for more than predefined periods of time. A state transition model for the proposed IoI detection framework is designed and verified by experiments with a mobile robot. In order to implement and associate our model in a robot architecture, all the components are implemented and integrated in the Robot Operating System(ROS) environment.

AI.title_translation: 利用非语言线索的人机交互启动检测框架研究
AI.tldr: 提出了一种无需关键词的机器人交互启动检测方法，通过融合视听觉信息和状态转换模型，实现对用户意图的自然识别。
AI.motivation: 为了实现更加自然的人机交互，解决机器人如何在无需特定关键词的情况下，准确识别用户主动发起交互的意图。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于音频和视觉传感器融合的交互启动检测框架，利用声源定位和人脸追踪技术，结合状态转换模型，并在ROS环境下进行集成与验证。
AI.result: 通过移动机器人实验验证了该框架的有效性，机器人能够根据用户的语音方向、视线方向以及注视时长准确判断交互启动。
AI.conclusion: 研究验证了所提出的基于非语言线索的交互启动检测框架在ROS环境下的有效性，能够实现机器人对用户交互意图的准确捕捉。
AI.translation: 本文介绍了一种在家庭环境下，无需关键词的人机交互启动（IoI）检测框架，该框架基于音频和视觉传感器融合。在所提出的框架中，机器人配备了自身的音频和视觉传感器，并可利用外部视觉传感器进行稳定的人体检测与追踪。当用户看着机器人说话时，机器人能够通过声源定位结合人体追踪信息定位用户位置；如果机器人感知到说话者面向自己，即可检测到交互启动。如果用户没有直接说话，机器人也可以通过检测用户注视自己的时长是否超过预设阈值来识别交互启动。文中设计了一个针对该IoI检测框架的状态转换模型，并通过移动机器人实验进行了验证。为了在机器人架构中实现和关联该模型，所有组件均在机器人操作系统（ROS）环境中进行了实现与集成。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种在家庭环境中无需关键词的人机交互启动检测框架。该框架通过融合音频和视觉传感器，利用声源定位和人脸追踪技术，根据用户的语音线索或长时间注视行为来判断交互意图，并通过状态转换模型在ROS环境下实现了该系统的集成与验证。
AI.keywords: 人机交互, 交互启动检测, 传感器融合, 状态转换模型, ROS
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于提出了一种无需特定关键词的交互启动检测框架，通过融合多模态传感器（音频和视觉）以及状态转换模型，增强了机器人在家庭环境中的自然交互能力。局限性在于对于复杂环境下的误触发处理可能仍需进一步优化。

title: CCD-Level and Load-Aware Thread Orchestration for In-Memory Vector ANNS on Multi-Core CPUs
summary: Vector approximate nearest neighbor search (ANNS) underpins search engines, recommendation systems, and advertising services. Recent advances in ANNS indexes make CPU a cost-effective choice for serving million-scale, in-memory vector search, yet per-core throughput remains constrained by memory access latency of vector reading and the compute intensity of distance evaluations in production deployments. With the growing scale of the business and advances in hardware, modern CCD-based multi-core CPUs have been widely deployed for high throughput in our services. However, we find that simply increasing core counts does not yield optimal performance scaling. To improve the efficiency of more cores from the CCD-based architecture, we analyze the distributions of real-world requests in our production environments. We observe high access locality in vector search in our online services and low cache utilization, resulting from overlooking the multi-chiplet nature of CCD based CPUs. Hence, we propose a workload- and hardware-aware thread orchestration framework at CCD-level that (i) provides a uniform interface for both inter-query parallel HNSW search and intra-query parallel IVF search, (ii) achieves cache-friendly and workload-adaptive mapping of task dispatching, and (iii) employs CCD-aware task stealing to address load imbalance. Applied to real production workloads from search, recommendation, and advertising services of Xiaohongshu (RedNote), our approach delivers up to 3.7x higher throughput and 30-90% reductions in P50 and P999 latency. In detail, compared with the original framework, the cache-miss ratio decreases by 6-30%, and the total CPU stall is reduced by 20-80%.

AI.title_translation: CCD级别和负载感知的线程编排，用于内存向量近似最近邻搜索的多核CPU
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种新的线程编排框架，用于在多核CPU上优化内存向量近似最近邻搜索（ANN）。该框架利用CCD（Core Complex Die）架构的特性，通过分析真实生产环境中的请求分布，解决了简单增加核心数量无法带来最佳性能扩展的问题。
AI.motivation: CPU已成为服务百万级内存向量搜索的经济高效选择，但每核心吞吐量受限于内存访问延迟和距离计算的计算强度。现代CCD（Core Complex Die）多核CPU被广泛部署，但简单增加核心数量无法实现最佳性能扩展，需要更高效的利用方法。
AI.method: 提出了一种CCD级别的工作负载和硬件感知的线程编排框架，该框架：(1)为查询间HNSW并行搜索和查询内IVF并行搜索提供统一接口；(2)实现任务调度的缓存友好和工作负载自适应映射；(3)采用CCD感知的任务窃取机制来解决负载不平衡问题。
AI.result: 在小红书（RedNote）的搜索、推荐和广告服务的真实生产工作负载上，该方法实现了高达3.7倍的吞吐量提升，并将P50和P999延迟降低了30-90%。具体而言，与原始框架相比，缓存未命中率降低了6-30%，CPU总停顿时间减少了20-80%。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出的CCD级别、负载感知的线程编排框架能够显著提高多核CPU上内存向量近似最近邻搜索的性能，有效解决了现有方法在利用CCD架构方面的不足，并能在实际生产环境中带来显著的吞吐量和延迟改进。
AI.translation: 向量近似最近邻搜索（ANNS）是搜索引擎、推荐系统和广告服务的基础。ANNS索引的最新进展使得CPU成为服务百万规模、内存中向量搜索的经济高效选择，然而，在生产部署中，每核吞吐量仍然受到向量读取的内存访问延迟和距离评估的计算强度的限制。随着业务规模的增长和硬件的发展，现代基于CCD的多核CPU已被广泛部署以实现高吞吐量。然而，我们发现简单地增加核心数量并不能带来最佳的性能扩展。为了提高基于CCD架构的更多核心的效率，我们分析了我们生产环境中真实请求的分布。我们观察到在我们的在线服务中，向量搜索存在高访问局部性和低缓存利用率，这是由于忽视了CCD（Core Complex Die）CPU的多芯片特性。因此，我们提出了一种在CCD级别的工作负载和硬件感知的线程编排框架，该框架（i）为查询间HNSW搜索和查询内IVF搜索提供统一的接口，（ii）实现任务调度的缓存友好和工作负载自适应映射，以及（iii）采用CCD感知的任务窃取来解决负载不平衡问题。将其应用于小红书（RedNote）的搜索、推荐和广告服务的真实生产工作负载，我们的方法可提供高达3.7倍的吞吐量，并将P50和P999延迟降低30-90%。具体来说，与原始框架相比，缓存未命中率降低了6-30%，CPU总停顿时间减少了20-80%。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种针对多核CPU上内存向量近似最近邻搜索（ANNS）的CCD（Core Complex Die）级别线程编排框架。该框架通过分析生产环境中的请求局部性和缓存利用率，解决了现有方法在利用CCD架构方面的低效问题。它提供了统一的接口、缓存友好的任务调度以及CCD感知的任务窃取，从而在实际应用中实现了显著的吞吐量提升和延迟降低。
AI.keywords: 向量搜索,近似最近邻搜索,多核CPU,CCD架构,线程编排,缓存优化,负载均衡
AI.comments: 该研究有效地解决了在现代多核CPU（特别是采用CCD架构的CPU）上优化内存向量近似最近邻搜索性能的关键问题。通过深入分析生产环境中的实际工作负载和硬件特性，作者提出了一种创新的、软硬件协同的线程编排框架。该框架不仅在理论上解决了缓存利用率低和负载不均衡的问题，而且在实际应用中取得了显著的性能提升（高达3.7倍吞吐量和显著的延迟降低），这证明了其高度的实用价值和工程贡献。该方法在缓存未命中率和CPU停顿时间方面的改进也进一步证实了其有效性。未来的工作可以探索该框架在不同硬件平台和更复杂工作负载下的适应性和可扩展性。

title: TopoU-Net: a U-Net architecture for topological domains
summary: Many modern datasets mix points, edges, regions, groups, objects, events, hyperedges, and relations. Yet neural architectures often force such data into grids, graphs, or sequences, obscuring higher-order structure and making encoder-decoder designs domain-specific. We view U-Net not as a grid-specific architecture, but as a hierarchical encoder-decoder principle: representation spaces, transport maps between levels, and skip connections between matched levels. Combinatorial complexes naturally supply these ingredients through cells, incidences, and ranks. We introduce TopoU-Net, a rank-path U-Net for topological domains. Given a path from an input rank to a bottleneck rank and back, the encoder lifts cochains upward along incidence maps, the decoder transports them downward, and skip connections merge features at matched ranks. Rank replaces spatial scale: choosing paths through nodes, edges, faces, hyperedges, or global cells becomes the central architectural decision. A key quantity is the bottleneck support ratio, the number of cells at the bottleneck relative to the number of cells at the input rank. This ratio is fixed by the complex and chosen path rather than by arbitrary pooling, and it clarifies when skip connections are optional, useful, or structurally important. Across node classification, graph classification, hypergraph node classification, mesh classification, and image reconstruction, TopoU-Net provides a reusable encoder-decoder template for higher-order structured data. Among the evaluated baselines, it achieves the strongest mean accuracy on six of eight node-classification datasets and four of five hypergraph datasets, with the largest gains on heterophilic graphs. Ablations show that removing skip connections is most damaging under severe bottleneck compression.

AI.title_translation: 拓扑U-Net：一种用于拓扑域的U-Net架构
AI.tldr: TopoU-Net是一种基于组合复形的U-Net架构，能够处理混合类型的数据，并通过秩路径取代空间尺度，在多种任务上表现优于基线模型，尤其是在异质图上。
AI.motivation: 现代数据集包含多种结构（点、边、区域等），而现有神经网络架构通常将这些数据强制转换为网格、图或序列，这会隐藏高阶结构并使编码器-解码器设计变得特定于领域。
AI.method: TopoU-Net是一种秩路径U-Net架构，用于拓扑域。编码器沿着关联图将上链（cochains）向上提升，解码器将它们向下输送，跳跃连接在匹配的秩处合并特征。秩取代了空间尺度，成为核心的架构决策。
AI.result: TopoU-Net在节点分类、图分类、超图节点分类、网格分类和图像重建等任务中，作为一种可重用的编码器-解码器模板，在八个节点分类数据集中的六个和五个超图数据集中的四个上取得了最优的平均准确率，在异质图上增幅最大。移除跳跃连接在严重瓶颈压缩下损害最大。
AI.conclusion: TopoU-Net提供了一种处理高阶结构化数据的通用编码器-解码器模板，其性能优于现有方法，尤其是在异质图和严重压缩的情况下，跳跃连接至关重要。
AI.translation: 许多现代数据集混合了点、边、区域、组、对象、事件、超边和关系。然而，神经网络架构常常将这类数据强制塞入网格、图或序列中，这会隐藏高阶结构，并使编码器-解码器设计变得特定于领域。我们将U-Net视为一种通用的编码器-解码器原理，而不是一种特定于网格的架构：它包括表示空间、层级之间的传输映射以及匹配层级之间的跳跃连接。组合复形通过单元、关联和秩自然地提供了这些要素。我们提出了TopoU-Net，一种用于拓扑域的秩路径U-Net。给定从输入秩到瓶颈秩再返回的路径，编码器沿着关联图将上链向上提升，解码器将它们向下输送，跳跃连接在匹配的秩处合并特征。秩取代了空间尺度：通过节点、边、面、超边或全局单元选择路径成为核心的架构决策。一个关键的数量是瓶颈支撑比，即瓶颈处的单元数相对于输入秩处的单元数。这个比率由复形和所选路径固定，而不是由任意的池化决定，它阐明了跳跃连接在何时是可选的、有用的或结构上重要的。在节点分类、图分类、超图节点分类、网格分类和图像重建等任务中，TopoU-Net为高阶结构化数据提供了一个可重用的编码器-解码器模板。在评估的基线模型中，它在八个节点分类数据集中的六个和五个超图数据集中的四个上取得了最优的平均准确率，在异质图上增幅最大。消融实验表明，在最严重的瓶颈压缩下，移除跳跃连接的损害最大。
AI.summary: TopoU-Net是一种新颖的U-Net架构，它将组合复形的概念应用于处理具有复杂高阶结构的数据。该模型使用“秩”而非空间尺度来定义其层次结构，并通过在不同秩层之间传递特征来捕捉数据中的拓扑关系。实验证明，TopoU-Net在多种图和超图相关任务上均优于现有方法，并且其跳跃连接在数据压缩严重时尤为重要。
AI.keywords: TopoU-Net, 拓扑数据, U-Net, 组合复形, 秩路径
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种名为TopoU-Net的新型U-Net架构，旨在解决处理复杂高阶结构化数据（如点、边、区域等的混合）的挑战。与传统方法将数据强制转换为网格、图或序列不同，TopoU-Net利用组合复形的概念，将秩（rank）作为核心概念取代空间尺度，实现了更灵活和强大的数据表示。该方法在多种基准测试中取得了优异的性能，尤其是在异质图和严重压缩的情况下，显示了其鲁棒性和有效性。然而，该研究未详细讨论该架构在处理非常大规模或极其稀疏的数据集时的可扩展性问题，以及在不同类型的拓扑结构（如更高维度的单纯复形）上的泛化能力。

title: RFAmpDesigner: A Self-Evolving Multi-Agent LLM Framework for Automated Radio Frequency Amplifier Design
summary: Automating radio frequency (RF) amplifier design remains challenging because existing methods suffer from the curse of dimensionality, weak use of domain knowledge, and poor transferability, leading to low data efficiency. Meanwhile, although large language models (LLMs) have shown promise in many scientific domains, applying them directly to RF sizing is nontrivial due to the numerical nature of circuit optimization and the reliance on domain-specific design flows. To address this, this paper proposes RFAmpDesigner, a multi-agent framework that automates RF amplifier sizing. It introduces a resource-allocation middleware that reframes high-dimensional parameter tuning as a low-dimensional resource distribution problem, making it easier to inject sizing knowledge into general-purpose LLMs. The framework also follows standard design practice, enabling LLMs to distinguish between high- and low-cost actions and search in parallel. To realize a self-evolving optimization process, the framework employs retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to reuse past knowledge and experience from memory base. As a proof of concept, we apply RFAmpDesigner to low noise amplifiers of varying complexity. The experimental results show that it can automatically synthesize designs with fractional bandwidths ranging from 10\% to 80\% and center frequencies from 10 GHz to 50 GHz. To the best of our knowledge, this work develops the first LLM-driven approach for RF amplifier sizing that operates on design concepts instead of treating netlists as text, offering a novel solution to mitigate data scarcity in RF design.

AI.title_translation: RFAmpDesigner：一种用于自动化射频放大器设计的自进化多智能体 LLM 框架
AI.tldr: RFAmpDesigner 是首个利用大语言模型通过设计概念自动进行射频放大器尺寸优化的框架，通过资源分配和知识检索实现高效的自进化设计。
AI.motivation: 现有射频放大器设计方法存在维度灾难、领域知识利用不足及可移植性差的问题，导致数据效率低下；而直接应用 LLM 处理电路优化面临数值计算困难及对特定设计流程依赖的挑战。
AI.method: 提出 RFAmpDesigner 多智能体框架，利用资源分配中间件将高维参数调整简化为低维资源分配问题，结合检索增强生成（RAG）技术实现知识复用与自进化，并基于设计概念而非网表进行优化。
AI.result: 实验表明，该框架能自动合成中心频率在 10 GHz 至 50 GHz、分数带宽在 10% 至 80% 之间的低噪声放大器，证明了其在不同复杂度场景下的有效性。
AI.conclusion: RFAmpDesigner 证明了基于设计概念的 LLM 驱动框架在射频放大器自动设计中的有效性，能够处理不同复杂度和频段的需求，显著缓解了射频设计中的数据稀缺问题。
AI.translation: 自动化射频 (RF) 放大器设计仍然具有挑战性，因为现有方法受到维度灾难、领域知识利用薄弱和可移植性差的影响，导致数据效率低下。同时，尽管大型语言模型 (LLM) 在许多科学领域显示出潜力，但由于电路优化的数值性质以及对特定领域设计流程的依赖，将它们直接应用于射频尺寸设计并非易事。为了解决这个问题，本文提出了 RFAmpDesigner，这是一个实现射频放大器尺寸设计自动化的多智能体框架。它引入了一种资源分配中间件，将高维参数调整重构为低维资源分配问题，从而更容易将尺寸设计知识注入到通用 LLM 中。该框架还遵循标准设计实践，使 LLM 能够区分高成本和低成本操作并进行并行搜索。为了实现自进化的优化过程，该框架采用了检索增强生成 (RAG) 来重用来自记忆库的过去知识和经验。作为概念验证，我们将 RFAmpDesigner 应用于不同复杂度的低噪声放大器。实验结果表明，它可以自动合成中心频率从 10 GHz 到 50 GHz、分数带宽从 10% 到 80% 的设计。据我们所知，这项工作开发了第一个基于设计概念而不是将网表视为文本的 LLM 驱动的射频放大器尺寸设计方法，为缓解射频设计中的数据稀缺提供了新的解决方案。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 RFAmpDesigner，这是一个基于多智能体 LLM 的自动化射频放大器设计框架。它通过资源分配中间件简化参数调优，结合 RAG 技术实现经验复用，是首个基于设计概念而非网表文本进行射频尺寸设计的 LLM 驱动方案。
AI.keywords: 射频放大器设计, 大语言模型, 多智能体框架, 资源分配, 检索增强生成
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于将复杂的射频电路参数调整问题转化为资源分配问题，从而成功地将大语言模型（LLM）引入到射频设计领域。通过引入RAG技术实现自进化，解决了传统方法在数据效率和领域知识利用上的不足，为自动化硬件设计提供了一种新的范式。

title: Retrieve-then-Steer: Online Success Memory for Test-Time Adaptation of Generative VLAs
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models show strong potential for general-purpose robotic manipulation, yet their closed-loop reliability often degrades under local deployment conditions. Existing evaluations typically treat test episodes as independent zero-shot trials. However, real robots often operate repeatedly in the same or slowly changing environments, where successful executions provide environment-verified evidence of reliable behavior patterns. We study this persistent-deployment setting, asking whether a partially competent frozen VLA can improve its reliability by reusing its successful test-time experience. We propose an online success-memory guided test-time adaptation framework for generative VLAs. During deployment, the robot stores progress-calibrated successful observation-action segments in a long-term memory. At inference, it retrieves state-relevant action chunks, filters inconsistent candidates via trajectory-level consistency, and aggregates them into an elite action prior. To incorporate this prior into action generation, we introduce confidence-adaptive prior guidance, which injects the elite prior into an intermediate state of the flow-matching action sampler and adjusts the guidance strength based on retrieval confidence. This design allows the frozen VLA to exploit environment-specific successful experience while preserving observation-conditioned generative refinement. This retrieve-then-steer mechanism enables lightweight, non-parametric test-time adaptation without requiring parameter updates. Simulation and real-world experiments show improved task success and closed-loop stability, especially in long-horizon and multi-stage tasks.

AI.title_translation: 检索-引导：用于生成式VLA测试时适应的在线成功记忆机制
AI.tldr: 一种无需微调的机器人VLA模型适应方法，通过检索和复用历史成功经验来指导实时动作生成。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型在本地部署时可靠性下降，且通常被视为零样本任务。作者旨在解决如何在重复或缓慢变化的环境中，利用已有的成功执行经验来提升冻结VLA模型的性能。
AI.method: 提出一种在线成功记忆引导的测试时适应框架。在部署期间存储经过进度校准的成功动作片段；在推理时检索相关片段，通过轨迹一致性过滤并生成精英动作先验；最后通过置信度自适应引导机制，将该先验注入流匹配动作采样器中。
AI.result: 在仿真和真实世界实验中，该方法显著提升了任务成功率和闭环稳定性，特别是在长程和多阶段任务中表现优异。
AI.conclusion: Retrieve-then-Steer框架通过利用环境特定的成功经验，无需模型微调即可显著提升生成式VLA模型在机器人操作任务中的可靠性和稳定性。
AI.translation: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在通用机器人操作方面显示出巨大潜力，但在本地部署条件下，其闭环可靠性往往会下降。现有的评估通常将测试片段视为独立的零样本实验。然而，现实中的机器人在相同或缓慢变化的环境中重复操作，成功的执行提供了可靠行为模式的实证。我们研究了这种持续部署环境，探讨一个部分能力的冻结VLA模型是否可以通过重用其测试时的成功经验来提高可靠性。我们提出了一种用于生成式VLA的在线成功记忆引导测试时适应框架。在部署期间，机器人将进度校准后的成功观察-动作片段存储在长期记忆中。在推理时，它检索与状态相关的动作块，通过轨迹级一致性过滤不一致的候选者，并将它们聚合成一个精英动作先验。为了将此先验纳入动作生成，我们引入了置信度自适应先验引导，将精英先验注入流匹配动作采样器的中间状态，并根据检索置信度调整引导强度。这种设计允许冻结的VLA利用环境特定的成功经验，同时保持观察条件下的生成细化。这种“检索-引导”机制实现了轻量级、非参数化的测试时适应，无需参数更新。仿真和真实世界实验表明，该方法提高了任务成功率和闭环稳定性，特别是在长程和多阶段任务中。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为“Retrieve-then-Steer”的框架，通过在机器人部署期间积累成功经验并将其作为先验知识，在推理时动态引导生成式VLA模型，从而在无需模型参数更新的情况下实现了轻量级的测试时适应。
AI.keywords: 视觉-语言-动作模型, 测试时适应, 成功记忆, 机器人操作, 检索增强生成
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地利用“检索-引导”机制，通过存储和复用成功经验来实现VLA模型的测试时适应，无需昂贵的参数更新，在机器人长期部署场景下极具实用价值。其局限性可能在于对环境一致性的依赖以及存储空间的管理效率。

title: Learning to Compress and Transmit: Adaptive Rate Control for Semantic Communications over LEO Satellite-to-Ground Links
summary: The bottleneck of satellite-to-ground links poses a major challenge for the timely downlink of massive on-board imagery. This paper studies adaptive image transmission over LEO satellite-to-ground links using joint source-channel coding (JSCC). We propose an RL-based framework that dynamically selects the channel dimension (compression ratio) of a SwinJSCC encoder to maximize the number of received satisfying reconstruction-quality constraints (PSNR and MS-SSIM) within a finite visibility window. The agent leverages SNR prediction to perform proactive rate adaptation and incorporates an on-board transmission-queue model that captures bursty encoding while penalizing both buffer overflow and underutilization. Simulations under realistic overpass conditions show that the proposed policy substantially outperforms fixed-rate baselines, achieving nearly 95% qualified frames with zero packet loss.

AI.title_translation: 学习压缩与传输：面向低轨卫星对地链路的自适应速率语义通信
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于强化学习的框架，用于在低轨卫星对地链路中进行自适应图像传输。通过动态调整压缩率和预测信噪比，该方法显著提高了在有限可见窗口内满足重建质量要求的图像数量，并实现了零丢包率。
AI.motivation: 卫星对地链路的传输瓶颈限制了海量在轨图像的及时下传。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于强化学习的框架，该框架动态选择SwinJSCC编码器的信道维度（压缩比），以最大化在有限可见窗口内满足重建质量约束（PSNR和MS-SSIM）的图像数量。该智能体利用信噪比预测进行主动速率适应，并纳入了一个在轨传输队列模型，该模型能够处理突发编码，同时惩罚缓冲区溢出和利用不足。
AI.result: 仿真结果表明，所提出的策略显著优于固定速率基线，实现了近95%的合格帧和零丢包率。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的基于强化学习的自适应速率控制方法能够有效解决低轨卫星对地链路的传输瓶颈问题，显著提高图像传输的效率和质量。
AI.translation: 低轨卫星对地链路的瓶颈对海量在轨图像的及时下传提出了重大挑战。本文研究了利用联合源信道编码（JSCC）在低轨卫星对地链路上传输自适应图像。我们提出了一种基于强化学习（RL）的框架，该框架动态选择SwinJSCC编码器的信道维度（压缩比），以最大化在有限可见窗口内满足具有约束的重建质量（PSNR和MS-SSIM）的图像数量。该智能体利用信噪比（SNR）预测进行主动速率适应，并纳入了捕捉突发编码同时惩罚缓冲区溢出和利用不足的在轨传输队列模型。在现实的越轨条件下的仿真表明，所提出的策略显著优于固定速率基线，实现了近95%的合格帧和零丢包率。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于强化学习的自适应速率控制方法，用于解决低轨卫星对地链路的图像传输瓶颈问题。该方法通过动态调整SwinJSCC编码器的压缩比，并结合信噪比预测和传输队列模型，能够在有限的可见窗口内最大化满足重建质量要求的图像数量，实现了近95%的合格帧和零丢包率。
AI.keywords: 自适应速率控制, 语义通信, 低轨卫星, 强化学习, 联合源信道编码
