title: Evaluating the Expressive Appropriateness of Speech in Rich Contexts
summary: Evaluating expressive speech remains challenging, as existing methods mainly assess emotional intensity and overlook whether a speech sample is expressively appropriate for its contextual setting. This limitation hinders reliable evaluation of speech systems used in narrative-driven and interactive applications, such as audiobooks and conversational agents. We introduce CEAEval, a Context-rich framework for Evaluating Expressive Appropriateness in speech, which assesses whether a speech sample expressively aligns with the underlying communicative intent implied by its discourse-level narrative context. To support this task, we construct CEAEval-D, the first context-rich speech dataset with real human performances in Mandarin conversational speech, providing narrative descriptions together with fifteen dimensions of human annotations covering expressive attributes and expressive appropriateness. We further develop CEAEval-M, a model that integrates knowledge distillation, planner-based multi-model collaboration, adaptive audio attention bias, and reinforcement learning to perform context-rich expressive appropriateness evaluation. Experiments on a human-annotated test set demonstrate that CEAEval-M substantially outperforms existing speech evaluation and analysis systems.

AI.title_translation: 评估丰富语境中语音表达的恰当性
AI.tldr: 现有语音评估方法忽略了表达的语境恰当性，阻碍了叙事和交互式应用中语音系统的可靠评估。本文引入了CEAEval框架、CEAEval-D数据集和CEAEval-M模型，用于评估语音在语境中的表达恰当性。CEAEval-M模型显著优于现有系统。
AI.motivation: 现有语音评估方法主要评估情感强度，但忽略了语音样本是否与其语境设置表达恰当，这阻碍了有声读物和会话代理等叙事驱动和交互式应用中语音系统的可靠评估。
AI.method: 本文提出了CEAEval，一个用于评估语音表达恰当性的语境丰富框架。为了支持这项任务，构建了CEAEval-D，这是第一个包含真实人类表演的普通话对话语音语境丰富数据集，提供了叙事描述和涵盖表达属性及表达恰当性的十五个维度的人工标注。进一步开发了CEAEval-M模型，该模型集成了知识蒸馏、基于规划器的多模型协作、自适应音频注意力偏置和强化学习来执行语境丰富的表达恰当性评估。
AI.result: 在人工标注的测试集上的实验表明，CEAEval-M显著优于现有的语音评估和分析系统。
AI.conclusion: 提出的CEAEval框架及其CEAEval-D数据集和CEAEval-M模型为评估语音在语境中的表达恰当性提供了一个有效且优于现有系统的方法。
AI.translation: 评估表达性语音仍然具有挑战性，因为现有方法主要评估情感强度，而忽略了语音样本是否与其语境设置表达恰当。这一限制阻碍了有声读物和会话代理等叙事驱动和交互式应用中语音系统的可靠评估。我们引入了CEAEval，一个用于评估语音表达恰当性的语境丰富框架，它评估语音样本是否在表达上与其篇章级叙事语境所隐含的潜在交流意图对齐。为了支持这项任务，我们构建了CEAEval-D，这是第一个包含真实人类表演的普通话对话语音语境丰富数据集，提供了叙事描述以及涵盖表达属性和表达恰当性的十五个维度的人工标注。我们进一步开发了CEAEval-M，一个集成了知识蒸馏、基于规划器的多模型协作、自适应音频注意力偏置和强化学习来执行语境丰富的表达恰当性评估的模型。在人工标注的测试集上的实验表明，CEAEval-M显著优于现有的语音评估和分析系统。
AI.summary: 本文针对现有语音评估方法忽视语境表达恰当性的问题，提出了CEAEval框架。该框架旨在评估语音在篇章级叙事语境下与交流意图的对齐程度。为支持此任务，研究构建了首个包含真实普通话对话语音和多维度人工标注的语境丰富数据集CEAEval-D。在此基础上，开发了CEAEval-M模型，该模型融合了知识蒸馏、多模型协作、自适应注意力偏置和强化学习等技术。实验结果表明，CEAEval-M在语境丰富表达恰当性评估方面显著优于现有系统。
AI.keywords: 表达恰当性, 语音评估, 语境丰富, 数据集, 模型
AI.comments: 这项研究通过引入“表达恰当性”的概念，填补了现有语音评估方法仅关注情感强度而忽略语境匹配度的空白，对于提升叙事驱动和交互式应用中语音系统的评估可靠性具有重要意义。CEAEval-D数据集的构建，特别是其语境丰富性和多维度人工标注，为该领域的研究提供了宝贵的资源。CEAEval-M模型结合多种先进技术，展现出强大的性能，其创新性体现在对复杂语境下语音表达的精细化理解和评估。

title: RADAR Challenge 2026: Robust Audio Deepfake Recognition under Media Transformations
summary: RADAR Challenge 2026 is an APSIPA Grand Challenge on Robust Audio Deepfake Recognition under Media Transformations, designed to simulate realistic media conditions in real-world audio distribution pipelines, including compression, resampling, noise, and reverberation. It consists of two phases: an English development phase with labeled data for analysis and paper writing, and a multilingual evaluation phase containing more than 100,000 utterances in English, Singapore English, Mandarin Chinese, Taiwanese Mandarin, Japanese, and Vietnamese. Systems are evaluated using equal error rate (EER) for binary real/fake classification. This paper describes the challenge task, the construction of the data set, the evaluation protocol, and the overall results. During the challenge, 33 teams submitted to the development phase and 22 teams submitted to the final evaluation phase. The reported results highlight the remaining challenges of robust audio deepfake detection under multilingual and media-transformed conditions.

AI.title_translation: RADAR挑战2026：媒体转换下的鲁棒音频深度伪造识别
AI.tldr: 一个关于在真实世界音频分发条件下（如压缩、重采样、噪声和混响）进行鲁棒音频深度伪造识别的挑战赛。
AI.motivation: 模拟真实世界音频分发管道中的真实媒体条件，以提高音频深度伪造识别的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 举办了一个包含开发阶段和评估阶段的挑战赛，开发阶段提供带标签的数据，评估阶段包含多种语言和媒体转换。系统通过二元真/假分类的等错误率（EER）进行评估。
AI.result: 33个团队参加了开发阶段，22个团队参加了评估阶段。结果表明，在多语言和媒体转换条件下，鲁棒音频深度伪造检测仍然面临挑战。
AI.conclusion: 鲁棒音频深度伪造检测在多语言和媒体转换条件下仍具挑战性。
AI.translation: RADAR挑战2026是一个关于在媒体转换下进行鲁棒音频深度伪造识别的APSIPA大挑战，旨在模拟真实世界音频分发管道中的真实媒体条件，包括压缩、重采样、噪声和混响。它包含两个阶段：一个带有用于分析和撰写论文的标记数据的英语开发阶段，以及一个包含英语、新加坡英语、中文普通话、台湾普通话、日语和越南语超过10万个发音的多语言评估阶段。系统通过二元真/假分类的等错误率（EER）进行评估。本文介绍了挑战任务、数据集的构建、评估协议和总体结果。在挑战赛期间，33个团队提交了开发阶段的参赛作品，22个团队提交了最终评估阶段的参赛作品。所报告的结果凸显了在多语言和媒体转换条件下进行鲁棒音频深度伪造检测仍然存在的挑战。
AI.summary: RADAR挑战2026是一个旨在应对媒体转换下鲁棒音频深度伪造识别的挑战赛。该挑战模拟了现实世界音频分发中的各种条件，并设置了多语言评估阶段。结果显示，尽管有大量团队参与，但在处理多语言和受损音频方面，音频深度伪造检测仍面临重大挑战。
AI.keywords: 音频深度伪造识别, 鲁棒性, 媒体转换, 多语言, RADAR挑战
AI.comments: 该挑战赛通过模拟真实世界条件，为音频深度伪造检测领域的研究提供了重要平台。多语言和媒体转换的引入增加了识别的难度，突显了该领域未来研究的必要性。

title: Quadratic Forms in Gaussian Random Variables Theoretical Results and Applications
summary: This manuscript reviews theoretical results and applications related to quadratic forms in Gaussian random variables. It summarizes definitions, canonical representations, exact and approximate distributional results, numerical inversion methods, applications, and selected open problems for real and complex quadratic forms, multiforms, and ratios of quadratic forms.

AI.title_translation: 高斯随机变量中的二次型：理论结果与应用
AI.tldr: 该论文综述了高斯随机变量中二次型相关的理论结果和应用，涵盖了定义、标准表示、精确与近似分布结果、数值求逆方法、应用以及实数和复数二次型、多重型和二次型比率的若干待解决问题。
AI.motivation: 对高斯随机变量中的二次型进行理论和应用方面的综述。
AI.method: 综述理论结果和应用，包括定义、标准表示、分布结果（精确和近似）、数值求逆方法、应用以及开放性问题。
AI.result: 提供了关于实数和复数二次型、多重型以及二次型比率的理论结果和应用。
AI.conclusion: 该论文为高斯随机变量中的二次型提供了一个全面的理论和应用综述。
AI.translation: 本文回顾了与高斯随机变量中的二次型相关的理论结果和应用。它总结了实数和复数二次型、多重型以及二次型比率的定义、标准表示、精确和近似分布结果、数值求逆方法、应用以及选定的开放性问题。
AI.summary: 本文全面回顾了高斯随机变量中二次型的理论基础和实际应用，涵盖了其定义、标准形式、精确及近似分布分析、数值计算方法、具体应用场景，并探讨了相关的开放性研究课题，特别关注实数、复数二次型、多重二次型以及二次型之比。
AI.keywords: 二次型, 高斯随机变量, 分布理论, 数值方法, 应用
AI.comments: 这篇综述性文章为理解高斯随机变量中的二次型提供了一个结构化的框架，涵盖了从基础理论到实际应用的广泛内容。其价值在于整合了现有知识，并指出了未来研究的方向。

title: Fast Voxelwise SNR Estimation for Iterative MRI Reconstructions
comments: 29 pages, 7 figures. Preliminary versions presented at the 2026 ISMRM Workshop on Data Sampling and Image Reconstruction and the 2026 ISMRM-ISMRT Annual Meeting
summary:
Purpose: To develop a fast, general-purpose framework for voxelwise noise characterization in linear and nonlinear iterative MRI reconstructions, recovering the image-domain noise variance from which SNR, $g$-factor, and related image-quality metrics are derived. The framework addresses both the intractability of closed-form formulas beyond Cartesian sampling and the long runtime of Pseudo Multiple Replica (PMR) methods.
  Methods: We propose PICO (Probing Image-space COvariance), an estimator that operates in the image domain by probing the image-domain noise covariance operator -- or, for nonlinear compressed-sensing reconstructions, the Jacobian of the converged solution -- with random probe images. Complex random-phase probes are shown theoretically and empirically to minimize estimator variance compared with Gaussian or real-valued alternatives. PICO was validated against analytical benchmarks and high-replica PMR references using retrospective Cartesian knee data ($R=2$), prospective non-Cartesian spiral brain phantom data ($R=2,3,4$), and compressed-sensing knee reconstructions ($R=2$).
  Results: In Cartesian experiments, PICO accurately reproduced analytical SENSE $g$-factor maps. In non-Cartesian spiral imaging ($R=2$), it achieved 1% estimation error in 64 s compared with 462 s for PMR (approximately 7.2x speedup), with the efficiency advantage persisting at higher acceleration. For nonlinear compressed sensing, the Jacobian-based estimator produced noise maps consistent with PMR while converging faster (52 s vs. 95 s; approximately 1.8x speedup).
  Conclusion: PICO provides a computationally efficient alternative to PMR for voxelwise noise and $g$-factor estimation across generalized iterative MRI reconstructions. By reusing existing reconstruction primitives, it enables voxelwise noise maps to be produced as a routine by-product of the reconstruction pipeline.
comment: 29 pages, 7 figures. Preliminary versions presented at the 2026 ISMRM Workshop on Data Sampling and Image Reconstruction and the 2026 ISMRM-ISMRT Annual Meeting

AI.title_translation: 快速迭代磁共振成像重建中的逐个体素信噪比估计
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为PICO的快速逐个体素噪声估计框架，用于迭代MRI重建，能够从图像域噪声协方差中恢复信噪比和g因子，相比现有方法速度更快，且易于集成到重建流程中。
AI.motivation: 现有迭代MRI重建方法在计算噪声方差方面存在效率低下和难以处理非线性/非笛卡尔采样的问题。
AI.method: 提出PICO（Probing Image-space COvariance）估计器，通过在图像域探测噪声协方差算子或收敛解的雅可比矩阵来估计噪声方差。使用复数随机相位探测以最小化估计方差。
AI.result: PICO在笛卡尔采样数据上准确复现了SENSE g因子图；在非笛卡尔螺旋成像中，相比PMR有约7.2倍的速度提升；在非线性压缩感知中，速度提升约1.8倍，并得到与PMR一致的噪声图。
AI.conclusion: PICO为广义迭代MRI重建中的逐个体素噪声和g因子估计提供了一种计算高效的替代方案，可作为重建流程的常规副产品。
AI.translation:
目的：开发一个通用的快速框架，用于线性与非线性迭代MRI重建中的逐个体素噪声表征，从图像域噪声方差恢复信噪比、$g$-因子和相关的图像质量指标。该框架解决了笛卡尔采样以外的解析公式的棘手问题以及伪多重复制（PMR）方法的长运行时间。
方法：我们提出PICO（Probing Image-space COvariance）估计器，它通过探测图像域噪声协方差算子——或者对于非线性压缩感知重建，探测收敛解的雅可比矩阵——来在图像域进行操作。理论上和经验上证明，与高斯或实值替代方法相比，复数随机相位探测可以最小化估计器方差。我们使用回顾性的笛卡尔膝部数据（R=2）、前瞻性的非笛卡尔螺旋脑模体数据（R=2,3,4）以及压缩感知膝部重建（R=2），通过与解析基准和高复制PMR参考进行对比来验证PICO。
结果：在笛卡尔实验中，PICO准确地复现了解析SENSE $g$-因子图。在非笛卡尔螺旋成像（R=2）中，它在64秒内实现了1%的估计误差，而PMR需要462秒（加速约7.2倍），并且在更高的加速下效率优势依然存在。对于非线性压缩感知，基于雅可比矩阵的估计器产生了与PMR一致的噪声图，同时收敛速度更快（52秒对比95秒；加速约1.8倍）。
结论：PICO为广义迭代MRI重建中的逐个体素噪声和$g$-因子估计提供了一种计算高效的PMR替代方案。通过重用现有的重建原语，它使得逐个体素噪声图能够作为重建流程的常规副产品。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种名为PICO（Probing Image-space COvariance）的创新框架，用于快速、逐个体素地估计迭代MRI重建中的噪声方差，进而计算信噪比和g因子。PICO通过在图像域探测噪声协方差算子或收敛解的雅可比矩阵来实现，并采用复数随机相位探测以提高效率和准确性。实验证明，PICO在多种MRI采集（包括笛卡尔、非笛卡尔螺旋和压缩感知）中均表现出显著的速度优势（最高可达7.2倍），同时保持了与传统PMR方法相当的精度。该方法易于集成到现有重建流程中，有望成为常规的图像质量评估手段。
AI.keywords: PICO, 逐个体素噪声估计, MRI重建, g因子, 计算效率
AI.comments: PICO框架在提高MRI图像质量评估效率方面取得了显著进展，尤其是在处理复杂采样和非线性重建时。其速度优势和易集成性是其主要优点。然而，对于极端加速比下的性能稳定性以及对不同类型噪声模型的普适性仍需进一步验证。

title: Single-Microphone Audio Point Source Discriminative Localization From Reverberation Late Tail Estimation
summary: Location information can be a valuable signal for audio segmentation tasks, especially as a complement to methods focusing on the content or qualities of the sources. Though audio source localization is typically performed using the observations of the signal captured by multiple microphones in space, information about a source's location is captured by a single microphone through its arrival time and spectral amplitude--given the source's emitted signal is known. Since reverberation originates from the audio sources in a room, it accordingly contains some information about the emitted audio signals. The late-tail part of reverberation is relatively invariant to the local source and microphone geometry, depending primarily on only the room itself, and thus can provide the necessary reference information about audio signals that depends minimally on their location. In this work, we leverage the robust late-tail estimation of Weighted Prediction Error (WPE) dereverberation within a probabilistic framework to estimate the likelihood of two audio signals collected in the same room as having originated from the same location. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach on the speaker diarization task in both simulated and real environments.

AI.title_translation: 单麦克风音频点源辨别定位基于混响尾部估计
AI.tldr: 该研究提出一种单麦克风音频源定位方法，利用加权预测误差（WPE）解混响技术估计混响尾部，并结合概率框架判断两个音频信号是否来自同一位置，在模拟和真实环境中对说话人日志任务进行了有效性验证。
AI.motivation: 在音频分割任务中，位置信息作为内容或音源特性的补充，具有重要价值。现有技术通常使用多麦克风进行音频源定位，但单麦克风也能通过到达时间和频谱幅度获取位置信息，前提是音源信号已知。混响包含音源的位置信息，特别是混响尾部对房间本身具有鲁棒性，可作为参考信息。
AI.method: 利用加权预测误差（WPE）解混响技术估计混响的晚期尾部，并将其应用于概率框架，以评估在同一房间收集的两个音频信号是否源自同一位置。
AI.result: 在模拟和真实环境中，该方法在说话人日志任务中被证明是有效的。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出的基于混响尾部估计的单麦克风音频源定位方法，能够有效利用混响信息，为音频分割任务提供有价值的位置信息。
AI.translation: 位置信息可以成为音频分割任务的宝贵信号，特别是作为关注信号内容或特性的方法的补充。尽管音频源定位通常使用空间中多个麦克风的观测来执行，但单个麦克风通过其到达时间和频谱幅度捕获的信号，可以获取有关信号源位置的信息——前提是信号源发出的信号是已知的。由于混响源于房间中的音频信号源，因此它也包含有关所发出音频信号的一些信息。混响的晚期尾部部分相对于局部信号源和麦克风几何形状具有相对不变性，主要仅取决于房间本身，因此可以提供关于音频信号的必要参考信息，而该信息对其位置的依赖性极小。在本研究中，我们利用加权预测误差（WPE）解混响中鲁棒的晚期尾部估计，在一个概率框架内，来估计在同一房间收集的两个音频信号是否源自同一位置的可能性。我们在模拟和真实环境的说话人日志任务中，证明了我们方法的有效性。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种新颖的单麦克风音频源定位方法，该方法创新性地利用了加权预测误差（WPE）解混响技术来估计混响的晚期尾部。通过将此信息整合到概率框架中，研究人员能够判断在同一房间录制的两个音频信号是否源自同一位置。该方法在模拟和真实环境的说话人日志任务中均取得了有效性验证，为单麦克风音频定位提供了新的思路。
AI.keywords: 音频源定位, 单麦克风, 混响尾部估计, WPE, 说话人日志
AI.comments: 该研究巧妙地利用了混响尾部的鲁棒性，克服了单麦克风定位的固有挑战。WPE技术的应用是该方法的关键创新点。然而，该方法在复杂声学环境（如多人同时说话、强噪声干扰）下的表现仍有待进一步验证。此外，将该方法扩展到定位多个声源可能是一个有前景的研究方向。

title: Revisiting the Independence Assumption in LEO Satellite-to-Ground Optical Links: A State-Coupled Joint Fading Model
summary: Performance analysis of low Earth orbit (LEO) satellite-to-ground optical links relies on composite fading models that typically evaluate scintillation and angular loss under the assumption of statistical independence. While ensuring analytical tractability, this assumption decouples fading mechanisms driven by the same atmospheric turbulence and fails to capture the distinct effects of free atmosphere (FA) and boundary layer (BL) perturbations. To model this coupling while preserving tractability, this paper develops a state-coupled joint fading model. In the proposed framework, aperture-averaged scintillation and effective angular loss are jointly characterized by a discrete slow atmospheric state, parameterized by separate FA and BL scaling factors. By replacing unconditional independence with state-conditioned independence, the model enables a closed-form derivation of the outage probability, preserving the computational simplicity of the independent baseline. Numerical results show that the independent baseline can misestimate outage under non-nominal layered turbulence states. This outage prediction bias varies with elevation because the relative roles of scintillation and angular loss change with the link geometry, resulting in different residual angular correction requirements for a given outage target.

AI.title_translation: 低地球轨道（LEO）卫星到地面光学链路的独立性假设回顾：一种状态耦合联合衰落模型
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种新的状态耦合联合衰落模型，用于分析低地球轨道（LEO）卫星到地面光学链路，解决了传统模型中独立性假设的局限性，并能更准确地预测非标称层状湍流状态下的中断概率。
AI.motivation: 传统的低地球轨道（LEO）卫星到地面光学链路性能分析模型通常假设闪烁和角度损耗在统计上是独立的，但这种假设忽略了由相同大气湍流驱动的衰落机制之间的耦合，并且未能区分自由大气（FA）和边界层（BL）扰动的不同影响。
AI.method: 开发了一种状态耦合联合衰落模型，该模型将孔径平均闪烁和有效角度损耗通过离散的慢大气状态（由单独的FA和BL缩放因子参数化）联合表征。通过用状态条件独立性取代无条件独立性，实现了中断概率的闭式推导。
AI.result: 数值结果表明，在非标称层状湍流状态下，独立基线模型可能错误估计中断概率。这种中断预测偏差随仰角变化，因为闪烁和角度损耗的相对作用随链路几何形状而变化，导致给定中断目标的不同残余角度校正要求。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的状态耦合联合衰落模型能够比依赖独立性假设的传统模型更准确地预测低地球轨道（LEO）卫星到地面光学链路的中断概率，尤其是在非标称层状湍流状态下。该模型通过状态条件独立性保持了计算效率，并考虑了大气湍流的不同层的影响。
AI.translation: 低地球轨道（LEO）卫星到地面光学链路的性能分析依赖于复合衰落模型，这些模型通常在统计独立性假设下评估闪烁和角度损耗。虽然这种假设保证了分析的可处理性，但它将由相同的大气湍流驱动的衰落机制分离开来，并且未能捕捉到自由大气（FA）和边界层（BL）扰动的不同影响。为了在保持可处理性的同时对这种耦合进行建模，本文开发了一种状态耦合联合衰落模型。在所提出的框架中，孔径平均闪烁和有效角度损耗由离散的慢大气状态联合表征，该状态由单独的FA和BL缩放因子参数化。通过用状态条件独立性取代无条件独立性，该模型能够对中断概率进行闭式推导，从而保持了独立基线的计算简单性。数值结果表明，在非标称层状湍流状态下，独立基线可能错误估计中断概率。这种中断预测偏差随仰角变化，因为闪烁和角度损耗的相对作用随链路几何形状而变化，导致给定中断目标的不同残余角度校正要求。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种新的状态耦合联合衰落模型，用于分析低地球轨道（LEO）卫星到地面光学链路。与传统模型依赖的独立性假设不同，该模型考虑了大气湍流中不同层（自由大气和边界层）的耦合效应。通过引入状态条件独立性，模型在保持计算效率的同时，能够更准确地预测中断概率，尤其是在非标称层状湍流条件下。研究结果强调了在链路设计中考虑这些耦合效应的重要性。
AI.keywords: 状态耦合联合衰落模型, 低地球轨道卫星到地面光学链路, 闪烁, 角度损耗, 独立性假设
AI.comments: 该研究通过引入状态耦合联合衰落模型，有效地解决了传统模型在低地球轨道（LEO）卫星到地面光学链路分析中对独立性假设的过度简化问题。模型创新性地将大气状态参数化，并实现了在保持计算效率的同时提高预测精度的目标。然而，模型对“慢大气状态”的定义及其在不同场景下的适用性仍需进一步验证。此外，实际应用中大气湍流的复杂性和动态性可能比模型假设更为严峻，因此未来研究可关注更精细化的湍流模型和实时自适应校正算法。

title: Efficient Airy Beam Training for Quasi-LoS Terahertz Near-Field Communications
summary: With the enlargement of antenna apertures in 6G Terahertz (THz) communications, the Rayleigh distance expands significantly, rendering near-field propagation a dominant scenario in THz links. Beyond conventional Line-of-Sight (LoS) and Non-Line-of-Sight (NLoS) conditions, quasi-LoS scenarios with partial obstructions have emerged as a critical challenge. Airy beams offer a promising solution to circumvent obstacles due to their unique curving trajectory. However, existing Airy beam training methods typically rely on parameter-based sampling or exhaustive search, leading to significant pilot overhead and low training efficiency. In this paper, an efficient Airy beam training framework is proposed to address this research gap. First, the theoretical bounds of Airy beam generation under finite apertures to prune physically invalid codewords are derived. Based on this, a two-stage Non-Uniform Polar Codebook (NUPC) design is presented, utilizing a probing mechanism to resolve the bending direction and a polar-domain spatial sampling strategy to generate Airy beams. To address ultra-low latency requirements, a Fast-Scanning 1D Codebook (FS1C) is further developed that sweeps the entire LoS region with minimal codewords. Simulation results demonstrate that NUPC achieves a higher average spectral efficiency (SE) by 13.4 bit/s/Hz while reducing training overhead by 54.2% compared to the state-of-the-art hierarchical focusing-Airy codebook (HFAC). Furthermore, FS1C reduces overhead by 92.9% with only a marginal 0.3 bit/s/Hz reduction compared with HFAC.

AI.title_translation: 面向准视距太赫兹近场通信的高效艾里光束训练
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种高效的艾里光束训练框架，用于解决太赫兹近场通信中的准视距场景。通过推导理论边界、设计非均匀极坐标码本（NUPC）和快速扫描一维码本（FS1C），显著提高了谱效率并降低了训练开销，优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的艾里光束训练方法存在导频开销大、训练效率低的问题，无法满足太赫兹近场通信中准视距场景的需求。
AI.method: 提出了一种高效的艾里光束训练框架，包括：1. 推导有限孔径下艾里光束生成的理论边界，以剔除无效码字。2. 设计了一种两阶段非均匀极坐标码本（NUPC），利用探测机制确定弯曲方向，并通过极域空间采样策略生成艾里光束。3. 开发了快速扫描一维码本（FS1C），以最小的码字覆盖整个视距区域，满足超低延迟需求。
AI.result: 与现有的分层聚焦-艾里码本（HFAC）相比，NUPC的平均谱效率提高了13.4 bit/s/Hz，训练开销降低了54.2%。FS1C的训练开销降低了92.9%，仅比HFAC的谱效率降低了0.3 bit/s/Hz。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的高效艾里光束训练框架，包括NUPC和FS1C，能够有效解决太赫兹近场通信中准视距场景下的艾里光束训练问题，显著提升了通信性能并降低了训练开销。
AI.translation: 随着6G太赫兹（THz）通信中天线孔径的扩大，瑞利距离显著增加，使得近场传播成为太赫兹链路中的主导场景。除了传统的视距（LoS）和非视距（NLoS）条件外，具有部分遮挡的准视距场景已成为一个关键挑战。艾里光束因其独特的弯曲轨迹，为绕过障碍物提供了一种有前景的解决方案。然而，现有的艾里光束训练方法通常依赖于基于参数的采样或穷举搜索，导致导频开销巨大且训练效率低下。本文提出了一种高效的艾里光束训练框架来解决这一研究空白。首先，推导了有限孔径下艾里光束生成的理论边界，以修剪物理上无效的码字。在此基础上，提出了一种两阶段非均匀极坐标码本（NUPC）设计，利用探测机制解决弯曲方向，并通过极域空间采样策略生成艾里光束。为了满足超低延迟要求，进一步开发了快速扫描一维码本（FS1C），以最小的码字覆盖整个视距区域。仿真结果表明，与现有的分层聚焦-艾里码本（HFAC）相比，NUPC实现了更高的平均谱效率（SE），提高了13.4 bit/s/Hz，同时训练开销降低了54.2%。此外，FS1C的开销降低了92.9%，仅比HFAC的谱效率降低了0.3 bit/s/Hz。
AI.summary: 本研究针对太赫兹近场通信中的准视距场景，提出了一种高效的艾里光束训练框架。该框架通过推导理论边界优化码本设计，并引入两阶段非均匀极坐标码本（NUPC）和快速扫描一维码本（FS1C）。实验结果显示，NUPC在提高谱效率和降低训练开销方面优于现有方法，而FS1C则在保持接近性能的同时大幅减少了训练开销，有效解决了现有方法的效率问题。
AI.keywords: 艾里光束,太赫兹通信,近场通信,码本设计,训练效率
AI.comments: 该研究有效地解决了太赫兹通信中近场传播和准视距场景下的艾里光束训练效率低下问题。提出的NUPC和FS1C码本设计在提高谱效率和降低训练开销方面取得了显著成效，具有重要的理论和应用价值。然而，对于FS1C与HFAC之间微小的谱效率差异，可以进一步探讨其在实际通信系统中的影响和权衡。

title: Dimension and model reduction approaches for linear Bayesian inverse problems with rank-deficient prior covariances
summary: Bayesian inverse problems use observed data to update a prior probability distribution for an unknown state or parameter of a scientific system to a posterior distribution conditioned on the data. In many applications, the unknown parameter is high-dimensional, making computation of the posterior expensive due to the need to sample in a high-dimensional space and the need to evaluate an expensive high-dimensional forward model relating the unknown parameter to the data. However, inverse problems often exhibit low-dimensional structure due to the fact that the available data are only informative in a low-dimensional subspace of the parameter space. Dimension reduction approaches exploit this structure by restricting inference to the low-dimensional subspace informed by the data, which can be sampled more efficiently. Further computational cost reductions can be achieved by replacing expensive high-dimensional forward models with cheaper lower-dimensional reduced models. In this work, we propose new dimension and model reduction approaches for linear Bayesian inverse problems with rank-deficient prior covariances, which arise in many practical inference settings. The dimension reduction approach is applicable to general linear Bayesian inverse problems whereas the model reduction approaches are specific to the problem of inferring the initial condition of a linear dynamical system. We provide theoretical approximation guarantees as well as numerical experiments demonstrating the accuracy and efficiency of the proposed approaches.

AI.title_translation: 线性贝叶斯逆问题降维与降模型方法，具有秩亏缺先验协方差
AI.tldr: 该论文提出用于线性贝叶斯逆问题的降维和降模型方法，特别关注秩亏缺先验协方差的情况，并通过理论和数值实验证明了其准确性和效率。
AI.motivation: 高维参数空间中的贝叶斯逆问题计算成本高昂，而实际问题往往具有低维结构，仅需在数据可识别的子空间进行推断。
AI.method: 提出新的降维方法，适用于一般线性贝叶斯逆问题；提出降模型方法，适用于线性动力学系统的初始条件推断。两种方法都利用了数据的低维结构，并考虑了秩亏缺的先验协方差。
AI.result: 理论上保证了近似精度，并通过数值实验证明了所提方法的准确性和效率。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的降维和降模型方法能够有效处理具有秩亏缺先验协方差的线性贝叶斯逆问题，显著降低计算成本，同时保持较高的精度。
AI.translation: 贝叶斯逆问题利用观测数据更新科学系统未知状态或参数的先验概率分布，得到以数据为条件的后验分布。在许多应用中，未知参数是高维的，由于需要在高维空间进行采样以及评估将未知参数与数据相关联的高维正向模型，因此计算后验分布的成本很高。然而，逆问题通常表现出低维结构，因为可用数据仅在参数空间的低维子空间中具有信息量。降维方法通过将推断限制在由数据告知的低维子空间来利用这种结构，该子空间可以更有效地采样。通过用更便宜的低维降模型替换昂贵的高维正向模型，可以进一步降低计算成本。在本研究中，我们为具有秩亏缺先验协方差的线性贝叶斯逆问题提出了新的降维和降模型方法，这种情况在许多实际推断设置中会出现。降维方法适用于一般的线性贝叶斯逆问题，而降模型方法则特定于推断线性动力学系统初始条件的问。我们提供了理论近似保证以及证明所提出方法准确性和效率的数值实验。
AI.summary: 本研究针对具有秩亏缺先验协方差的线性贝叶斯逆问题，提出了一种新的降维和降模型方法。该方法利用数据可识别的低维子空间进行推断，并用更经济的降模型替代昂贵的高维正向模型，从而有效降低计算成本。研究提供了理论分析和数值验证，证明了该方法在准确性和效率方面的优越性。
AI.keywords: 贝叶斯逆问题,降维,降模型,秩亏缺协方差,计算效率
AI.comments: 该研究解决了高维贝叶斯逆问题中的计算瓶颈，提出的降维和降模型方法具有实际应用价值。秩亏缺先验协方差的处理是该方法的一个重要特点。未来的工作可以探索该方法在非线性问题中的适用性。

title: Explicit and Effectively Symmetric Runge-Kutta Methods
summary: Symmetry is a key property of numerical methods. The geometric properties of symmetric schemes make them an attractive option for integrating Hamiltonian systems, whilst their ability to exactly recover the initial condition without the need to store the entire solution trajectory makes them ideal for the efficient implementation of Neural ODEs. In this work, we present a Hopf algebraic approach to the study of symmetric B-series methods. We show that every B-series method can be written as the composition of a symmetric and "antisymmetric" component, and explore the structure of this decomposition for Runge-Kutta schemes. A major bottleneck of symmetric Runge-Kutta schemes is their implicit nature, which requires solving a nonlinear system at each step. By introducing a new set of order conditions which minimise the antisymmetric component of a scheme, we derive what we call Explicit and Effectively Symmetric (EES) schemes -- a new class of explicit Runge-Kutta schemes with near-symmetric properties. We present examples of second-order EES schemes and demonstrate that, despite their low order, these schemes readily outperform higher-order explicit schemes such as RK4 and RK5, and achieve results comparable to implicit symmetric schemes at a significantly lower computational cost.

AI.title_translation: 显式且有效对称的Runge-Kutta方法
AI.tldr: 通过引入新的序条件，作者提出了一类显式且有效对称（EES）的Runge-Kutta方法，在保持显式计算低成本的同时，实现了接近隐式对称方案的数值性能。
AI.motivation: 对称数值方案在积分哈密顿系统和实现神经ODE方面具有重要优势，但传统的对称Runge-Kutta方法通常是隐式的，计算成本高昂。研究旨在寻找一种显式且具备近对称特性的方法。
AI.method: 利用Hopf代数对B-series方法进行对称与反对称分解，并推导出一套新的序条件，通过最小化反对称分量来设计显式且有效对称（EES）的Runge-Kutta方案。
AI.result: 提出的EES方案在保持显式计算优势的同时，其性能超越了RK4和RK5等高阶显式方法，并以显著更低的计算成本达到了与隐式对称方案相当的结果。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入最小化非对称分量的序条件，成功构建了显式且有效对称（EES）的Runge-Kutta方法，该方法在计算效率和数值稳定性之间取得了卓越的平衡。
AI.translation: 对称性是数值方法的关键属性。对称格式的几何特性使其成为积分哈密顿系统的理想选择，而它们无需存储整个解轨迹即可精确恢复初始条件的能力，使其非常适合神经ODE的高效实现。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种研究对称B-series方法的Hopf代数方法。我们证明了每个B-series方法都可以写成对称和“反对称”分量的组合，并探讨了Runge-Kutta格式的这种分解结构。对称Runge-Kutta格式的一个主要瓶颈是它们的隐式性质，这需要在每一步求解非线性系统。通过引入一套新的序条件来最小化格式的反对称分量，我们推导出了所谓的显式且有效对称（EES）格式——这是一类具有近对称特性的新型显式Runge-Kutta格式。我们展示了二阶EES格式的例子，并证明尽管它们的阶数较低，但这些格式很容易胜过RK4和RK5等高阶显式格式，并以显著更低的计算成本实现了与隐式对称格式相当的结果。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于Hopf代数的对称B-series方法分析框架，通过将方法分解为对称和反对称分量，推导出一套最小化反对称性的新序条件。以此构建的“显式且有效对称（EES）”Runge-Kutta方法，不仅保留了显式方法的计算高效性，还具备了接近对称方案的几何优越性。
AI.keywords: 对称Runge-Kutta方法, B-series, 神经ODE, 哈密顿系统, Hopf代数
AI.comments: 该研究巧妙地利用Hopf代数分析B-series方法，通过量化对称性并将非对称分量最小化，成功解决了一直以来对称Runge-Kutta方法必须是隐式的难题。这种方法在保持计算高效性的同时，赋予了显式方法类对称的几何特性，在处理哈密顿系统和神经ODE时具有极高的实用价值。

title: Estimation of a Gas Diffusion Coefficient by Fitting Molecular Dynamics Trajectories to Finite-Difference Simulations
summary: A procedure is presented to estimate the diffusion coefficient of a uniform patch of argon gas in a uniform background of helium gas. Molecular Dynamics (MD) simulations of the two gases interacting through the Lennard-Jones potential are carried out using the LAMMPS software package. In addition, finite-difference (FD) calculations are used to solve the continuum diffusion equation for the argon concentration with a given diffusion coefficient. To contain the computational cost and facilitate data visualization, both MD and FD computations were done in two space dimensions. The MD argon trajectories were binned to the FD grid, and the optimal diffusion coefficient was estimated by minimizing the difference between the binned MD data and the FD solution with a nonlinear least squares procedure (Levenberg-Marquardt algorithm). Numerical results show the effect of the MD binning parameter and FD grid spacing. The estimated diffusion coefficient is compared to an experimental measurement.

AI.title_translation: 通过拟合分子动力学轨迹与有限差分模拟估算气体扩散系数
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种通过将分子动力学模拟数据与有限差分扩散方程拟合来估算气体扩散系数的方法。
AI.motivation: 旨在建立一种通过拟合分子动力学轨迹与有限差分模拟结果来准确估算气体扩散系数的有效程序。
AI.method: 采用LAMMPS进行分子动力学（MD）模拟，利用有限差分（FD）法求解连续扩散方程；将MD轨迹分箱（binning）映射到FD网格，并使用Levenberg-Marquardt算法通过最小化二者差异来拟合最优扩散系数。
AI.result: 研究揭示了MD分箱参数和FD网格间距对结果的影响，并将估算出的扩散系数与实验测量值进行了对比验证。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能够有效地估算气体扩散系数，且计算结果与实验测量值具有可比性，验证了跨尺度仿真拟合的可行性。
AI.translation: 本文提出了一种估算均匀氦气背景中均匀氩气斑块扩散系数的程序。利用LAMMPS软件包进行基于Lennard-Jones势的气体相互作用分子动力学（MD）模拟。此外，利用有限差分（FD）计算求解具有给定扩散系数的氩气浓度连续扩散方程。为了控制计算成本并促进数据可视化，MD和FD计算均在二维空间中进行。将MD氩气轨迹分箱至FD网格，并通过非线性最小二乘程序（Levenberg-Marquardt算法）最小化分箱MD数据与FD解之间的差异，从而估算最优扩散系数。数值结果显示了MD分箱参数和FD网格间距的影响。最后将估算的扩散系数与实验测量值进行了比较。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了一种估算氩气在氦气背景中扩散系数的方法。通过二维分子动力学模拟生成轨迹数据，并将其与有限差分法求解的连续扩散方程结果进行匹配，利用非线性最小二乘法优化得到扩散系数。
AI.keywords: 分子动力学, 气体扩散系数, 有限差分法, Lennard-Jones势, 非线性最小二乘法
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种通过结合微观分子动力学模拟与宏观有限差分方程来估算扩散系数的方法。其创新点在于通过非线性最小二乘法对齐两种尺度的数据。局限性在于为了降低计算成本，研究仅局限于二维空间，且依赖于网格划分参数的选择。

title: About subspaces the most deviating from the coordinate ones
summary:
Using the largest principal angle as a distance between same-dimensional linear subspaces of $\mathbb{R}^n$, we construct $k$-dimensional subspaces which deviate from every coordinate $k$-subspace by at least $\arccos(1/\sqrt n)$. The construction is motivated by the hypothesis of Goreinov, Tyrtyshnikov and Zamarashkin that this value is the largest possible one for all $n > k > 0$. The subspaces are scaled star spaces of $2$-connected series-parallel graphs with $k+1$ vertices and $n$ edges, equipped with a particular positive edge weighting, while the largest principal angles take two values -- $\arccos(1 / \sqrt{n})$ and $π/2$, depending on whether a $k$-edge subgraph corresponding to a coordinate $k$-subspace is a spanning tree or not.
  For a fixed series-parallel graph, we also prove that the constructed weighting is the unique positive one, up to scaling, for which the corresponding $k$-subspace deviates from all coordinate $k$-subspaces by at least $\arccos(1 / \sqrt{n})$.

AI.title_translation: 关于偏离坐标子空间最远的子空间的研究
AI.tldr: 通过级联并联图构建了偏离坐标子空间距离最大的k维子空间，证明了其距离下界为arccos(1/√n)。
AI.motivation: 验证Goreinov、Tyrtyshnikov和Zamarashkin提出的关于k维子空间与坐标子空间之间最大可能偏离值的猜想。
AI.method: 利用2-连通级联并联图的缩放星空间，并配合特定的正边权重分配，构建满足条件的k维子空间。
AI.result: 构造出的k维子空间偏离所有坐标k-子空间的最小距离为arccos(1/√n)，并证明了对于给定的级联并联图，该权重分配是实现此距离的唯一正权重方案。
AI.conclusion: 论文构造了一类偏离坐标子空间距离达到最大值的k维子空间，验证并支持了Goreinov等人的关于最大偏离值的猜想。
AI.translation: 利用最大主角作为ℝ^n中同维线性子空间之间的距离，我们构造了偏离每个坐标k-子空间至少arccos(1/√n)的k维子空间。该构造受Goreinov、Tyrtyshnikov和Zamarashkin猜想的启发，即对于所有n > k > 0，该值是可能达到的最大值。这些子空间是具有k+1个顶点和n条边的2-连通级联并联图的缩放星空间，并配备了特定的正边权重，其中最大主角取两个值——arccos(1/√n)和π/2，具体取决于对应于坐标k-子空间的k-边子图是否为生成树。对于固定的级联并联图，我们还证明了所构造的权重是唯一（除缩放外）能使相应的k-子空间偏离所有坐标k-子空间至少arccos(1/√n)的正权重。
AI.summary: 本文研究了n维空间中k维子空间与坐标子空间之间的最大偏离距离问题。作者利用级联并联图的结构构造了一类子空间，使其与所有坐标子空间的距离至少为arccos(1/√n)，从而支持了相关理论猜想，并证明了其权重构造的唯一性。
AI.keywords: 主角, 坐标子空间, 级联并联图, 子空间距离, 极值问题
AI.comments: 该研究通过图论与线性代数相结合的方法，解决了一个关于子空间几何性质的极值问题，展现了组合结构在子空间距离分析中的强大应用潜力。其局限性在于该构造主要针对特定图结构，对于更一般情形下的普适性未做深入探讨。

title: An L-Stable Implicit Two-Stage Fourth-Order Temporal Discretization Scheme for Lax-Wendroff-Type Solvers Applied to Stiff Problems
summary: The explicit two-stage fourth-order (TSFO) temporal-spatial coupling method is efficient and compact but suffers severe time-step restrictions for stiff problems with multiple scales. To address Professor Jiequan Li's call for an implicit extension, this paper first constructs an implicit TSFO time discretization scheme using the method of undetermined coefficients and Taylor expansion. Second, using a model equation and the maximum modulus principle, sufficient conditions for L-stability are derived. Third, a Newton iteration accelerates convergence. Numerical experiments on classical stiff benchmarks show that the proposed implicit scheme achieves fourth-order temporal accuracy in two stages. Compared to the classical fourth-order implicit Runge-Kutta method, it allows larger stable time steps and reduces convergence errors by an order of magnitude. More importantly, this implicit scheme can be extended to construct an implicit TSFO temporal-spatial coupling method that captures flow-field correlations and handles strong discontinuities, fundamentally contrasting with method-of-lines approaches. Additionally, it unlocks Lax-Wendroff-type solvers to naturally and synchronously embed both stiff source terms and flow transport into time derivatives, thereby avoiding operator-splitting errors.

AI.title_translation: 一种应用于刚性问题的Lax-Wendroff型求解器的L-稳定隐式两阶段四阶时间离散方案
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种全新的隐式四阶时间离散方案，有效解决了显式Lax-Wendroff型求解器在处理刚性问题时的稳定性限制，并实现了更高精度的同步计算。
AI.motivation: 显式两阶段四阶(TSFO)方法在处理具有多尺度特征的刚性问题时，受限于严重的时间步长限制，需要一种隐式扩展方案来提升计算效率和稳定性。
AI.method: 使用待定系数法和泰勒展开构建隐式TSFO时间离散方案；利用模型方程和最大模原理推导L-稳定性条件；采用牛顿迭代法加速收敛。
AI.result: 数值实验表明，该方案实现了四阶时间精度，相比经典的四阶隐式Runge-Kutta方法，允许更大的稳定时间步长，且收敛误差降低了一个数量级。该方法能够同步处理刚性源项和流动传输，避免了算子分裂误差。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的隐式两阶段四阶方案在处理刚性问题时表现优异，不仅实现了L-稳定性，还通过同步嵌入源项和传输项提升了计算精度和稳定性，证明了其在解决复杂流体问题中的应用潜力。
AI.translation: 显式两阶段四阶（TSFO）时空耦合方法虽高效且紧凑，但在处理具有多尺度的刚性问题时受到严格的时间步长限制。为响应李杰权教授关于隐式扩展的呼吁，本文首先利用待定系数法和泰勒展开构建了一种隐式TSFO时间离散方案。其次，利用模型方程和最大模原理，推导了L-稳定性的充分条件。第三，采用牛顿迭代法加速收敛。针对经典刚性基准问题的数值实验表明，所提出的隐式方案在两阶段内实现了四阶时间精度。与经典的四阶隐式Runge-Kutta方法相比，该方案允许更大的稳定时间步长，并将收敛误差降低了一个数量级。更重要的是，该隐式方案可扩展用于构建隐式TSFO时空耦合方法，以捕捉流场相关性并处理强间断，这与线法（method-of-lines）形成了根本对比。此外，它使Lax-Wendroff型求解器能够自然且同步地将刚性源项和流动传输嵌入时间导数中，从而避免了算子分裂误差。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种用于Lax-Wendroff型求解器的隐式两阶段四阶时间离散方案，旨在解决刚性问题中的时间步长限制。该方法通过待定系数法构建，具备L-稳定性，并通过牛顿迭代加速收敛。实验证明其在精度、稳定性和处理多物理过程耦合方面优于传统方法。
AI.keywords: L-稳定性, 隐式方案, 两阶段四阶方法, 刚性问题, Lax-Wendroff型求解器
AI.comments: 该论文成功解决了显式Lax-Wendroff型求解器在处理刚性问题时的时间步长限制问题。其创新点在于将隐式格式引入两阶段四阶时间离散方案，不仅保持了高精度，还通过避免算子分裂误差，在处理包含刚性源项和流动传输的复杂问题上具有显著优势。这是一个在计算流体力学领域针对刚性问题的重要改进。

title: High order numerical discretizations of the Einstein-Euler equations in the Generalized Harmonic formulation
summary: We propose two new alternative numerical schemes to solve the coupled Einstein-Euler equations in the Generalized Harmonic formulation. The first one is a finite difference (FD) Central Weighted Essentially Non-Oscillatory (CWENO) scheme on a traditional Cartesian mesh, while the second one is an ADER (Arbitrary high order Derivatives) discontinuous Galerkin (DG) scheme on 2D unstructured polygonal meshes. The latter, in particular, represents a preliminary step in view of a full 3D numerical relativity calculation on moving meshes. Both schemes are equipped with a well-balancing (WB) property, which allows to preserve the equilibrium of a priori known stationary solutions exactly at the discrete level. We validate our numerical approaches by successfully reproducing standard vacuum test cases, such as the robust stability, the linearized wave, and the gauge wave tests, as well as achieving long-term stable evolutions of stationary black holes, including Kerr black holes with extreme spin. Concerning the coupling with matter, modeled by the relativistic Euler equations, we perform some special relativistic Riemann problems, a classical test of spherical accretion onto a Schwarzschild black hole, as well as an evolution of a perturbed non-rotating neutron star, demonstrating the capability of our schemes to operate also on the full Einstein-Euler system. Altogether, these results provide a solid foundation for addressing more complex and challenging simulations of astrophysical sources through DG schemes on unstructured 3D meshes.

AI.title_translation: 广义调和方程组的爱因斯坦-欧拉方程高阶数值离散化
AI.tldr: 本文提出了两种新的数值方案来求解广义调和方程组中的爱因斯坦-欧拉方程：一种是基于笛卡尔网格的有限差分中心加权本质上非振荡（CWENO）方案，另一种是基于二维非结构多边形网格的任意高阶导数（ADER）间断伽辽金（DG）方案。两种方案都具有良好的平衡（WB）性质，能够精确保持离散层面的稳态解。通过真空测试用例（如鲁棒稳定性、线性波和规范波测试）以及稳态黑洞（包括具有极端自旋的克尔黑洞）的长期稳定演化来验证这些方法。在物质耦合方面，通过模拟特殊的相对论黎曼问题、球形吸积到史瓦西黑洞以及扰动非旋转中子星的演化，证明了该方案能够处理完整的爱因斯坦-欧拉方程组。这些结果为在非结构三维网格上使用DG方案进行更复杂的や天体物理源模拟奠定了基础。
AI.motivation: 开发用于求解广义调和方程组中的爱因斯坦-欧拉方程的新型数值方案，特别是为了未来在移动网格上进行三维数值相对论计算。
AI.method: 提出了两种数值方案：1. 基于笛卡尔网格的有限差分中心加权本质上非振荡（CWENO）方案。2. 基于二维非结构多边形网格的任意高阶导数（ADER）间断伽辽金（DG）方案。两种方案均具备良好的平衡（WB）性质。
AI.result: 两种方案均成功复现了标准的真空测试用例，并实现了稳态黑洞（包括具有极端自旋的克尔黑洞）的长期稳定演化。在与物质耦合的模拟中，成功处理了特殊的相对论黎曼问题、球形吸积到史瓦西黑洞以及扰动非旋转中子星的演化。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的两种数值方案（CWENO和ADER-DG）能够有效地求解广义调和方程组中的爱因斯坦-欧拉方程，并为未来在非结构三维网格上使用DG方案进行更复杂的や天体物理源模拟奠定了坚实的基础。
AI.translation: 我们提出了两种新的数值方案来求解广义调和方程组中的爱因斯坦-欧拉方程。第一种是基于传统笛卡尔网格的有限差分（FD）中心加权本质上非振荡（CWENO）方案，第二种是基于二维非结构多边形网格的任意高阶导数（ADER）间断伽辽金（DG）方案。后者尤其代表了在进行全三维数值相对论计算（在移动网格上）方面的初步尝试。两种方案均具备良好的平衡（WB）性质，该性质允许在离散层面上精确保持先验已知的稳态解的平衡。我们通过成功复现标准的真空测试用例，如鲁棒稳定性、线性波和规范波测试，以及实现包括具有极端自旋的克尔黑洞在内的稳态黑洞的长期稳定演化，来验证我们的数值方法。在与物质耦合方面，物质由相对论性欧拉方程组描述，我们进行了一些特殊的相对论黎曼问题模拟、球形吸积到史瓦西黑洞的经典测试，以及一个扰动后的非旋转中子星的演化，证明了我们的方案也有能力处理完整的爱因斯坦-欧拉方程组。总而言之，这些结果为通过非结构三维网格上的DG方案解决更复杂和更具挑战性的や天体物理源模拟提供了坚实的基础。
AI.summary: 本文提出了两种新的数值方案——有限差分中心加权本质上非振荡（CWENO）方案和任意高阶导数（ADER）间断伽辽金（DG）方案——用于求解广义调和方程组中的爱因斯坦-欧拉方程。这两种方案都具备良好的平衡（WB）性质，能够精确保持稳态解。通过一系列真空测试和物质耦合测试（包括黑洞吸积和中子星演化），验证了这些方案的有效性和稳定性。特别是ADER-DG方案为未来在三维非结构网格上进行数值相对论模拟铺平了道路。
AI.keywords: 爱因斯坦-欧拉方程, 广义调和方程组, 数值离散化, 间断伽辽金, CWENO
AI.comments: 本文提出的两种新数值方案在求解复杂的爱因斯坦-欧拉方程方面取得了显著进展。CWENO方案在传统笛卡尔网格上的应用以及ADER-DG方案在非结构多边形网格上的创新，都为数值相对论领域带来了新的可能性。特别是ADER-DG方案在为未来三维数值相对论计算奠定基础方面具有重要意义。然而，文章中提及的“Preliminary step”表明该方案在三维应用上仍有进一步的完善空间。此外，虽然提到了“moving meshes”，但具体实现细节和对计算性能的影响有待进一步探讨。

title: Forward-KL Convergence of Time-Inhomogeneous Langevin Diffusions
summary: Many practical samplers rely on time-dependent drifts -- often induced by annealing or tempering schedules -- to improve exploration and stability. This motivates a unified non-asymptotic analysis of the corresponding Langevin diffusions and their discretizations. We provide a convergence analysis that includes non-asymptotic bounds for the continuous-time diffusion and its Euler--Maruyama discretization in the forward-Kullback--Leibler divergence under a single set of abstract conditions on the time-dependent drift. The results apply to many practically-relevant annealing schemes, including geometric tempering and annealed Langevin sampling. In addition, we provide numerical experiments comparing the annealing schemes covered by our theory in low- and high-dimensional settings.

AI.title_translation: 时间非齐次 Langevin 扩散的 Forward-KL 收敛性
AI.tldr: 该论文分析了具有时间依赖性漂移的 Langevin 扩散及其离散化在 Forward-KL 散度下的收敛性，并给出了非渐近界限，适用于多种退火方案。
AI.motivation: 为了改进探索和稳定性，许多实际采样器依赖于时间依赖性漂移，这通常是由退火或回火方案引起的。因此，有必要对相应的 Langevin 扩散及其离散化进行统一的非渐近分析。
AI.method: 对时间依赖性漂移的 Langevin 扩散及其 Euler-Maruyama 离散化在 Forward-KL 散度下的收敛性进行了分析，并给出了非渐近界限。
AI.result: 在对时间依赖性漂移的一组抽象条件下，为连续时间扩散及其 Euler-Maruyama 离散化在 Forward-KL 散度下的收敛性提供了非渐近界限。这些结果适用于包括几何回火和退火 Langevin 采样在内的多种实际退火方案。此外，还提供了比较理论覆盖的退火方案在低维和高维设置下的数值实验。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为时间非齐次 Langevin 扩散及其离散化在 Forward-KL 散度下的收敛性提供了理论分析和非渐近界限，并验证了其在实际退火方案中的适用性。
AI.translation: 许多实际采样器依赖于时间依赖性漂移——通常由退火或回火方案引起——以改善探索和稳定性。这促使对相应的 Langevin 扩散及其离散化进行统一的非渐近分析。我们提供了收敛性分析，包括在时间依赖性漂移的单一抽象条件下，连续时间扩散及其 Euler-Maruyama 离散化在正向 Kullback-Leibler 散度下的非渐近界限。结果适用于许多实际相关的退火方案，包括几何回火和退火 Langevin 采样。此外，我们还提供了比较我们理论所涵盖的退火方案在低维和高维环境下的数值实验。
AI.summary: 本研究对具有时间依赖性漂移的 Langevin 扩散及其 Euler-Maruyama 离散化在 Forward-KL 散度下的收敛性进行了非渐近分析。在对时间依赖性漂移的一组抽象条件下，论文得出了收敛界限，并表明这些结果适用于几何回火和退火 Langevin 采样等实际退火方案。此外，还通过数值实验对这些方案进行了比较。
AI.keywords: Langevin 扩散, Forward-KL 散度, 时间非齐次, 非渐近分析, 退火方案
AI.comments: 这项工作为理解和改进依赖于退火或回火策略的采样方法提供了重要的理论基础。其非渐近界限对于实际应用中的采样器性能分析很有价值。然而，抽象条件在多大程度上能够捕捉到所有实际场景的细微差别，以及这些界限在实践中的紧密程度，仍有待进一步研究。

title: Discovering new phases via computing second-order stationary states of Landau-Brazovskii model
summary: In this work, we report a stable ordered structure -- the cubic FDDD phase -- that has not previously been identified in the Landau-Brazovskii (LB) model, a fundamental and important model for studying crystals and their phase transitions. The key to this discovery is the proposed implicit-explicit trust region method for computing second-order stationary points in the high-dimensional nonconvex energy landscape of the LB model. Different from existing first-order gradient-based algorithms, which only guarantee convergence to first-order stationary points and may therefore stagnate at saddle points, the proposed method is theoretically guaranteed to converge to second-order stationary points corresponding to local minima. Numerical experiments verify the theoretical properties of the algorithm and demonstrate its robustness in locating stable phases from different initial conditions. Based on the discovered FDDD phase, we further construct an updated phase diagram of the LB model and identify its stable region. These results show that targeting second-order stationary points provides an effective computational paradigm for exploring complex free-energy landscapes and uncovering new stable phases.

AI.title_translation: 通过计算Landau-Brazovskii模型的二阶平稳点发现新相
AI.tldr: 利用一种新的二阶平稳点计算算法，在Landau-Brazovskii模型中成功发现了一种新的FDDD稳定相。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于一阶梯度的算法往往只能收敛到一阶平稳点，容易陷入鞍点，无法有效探索复杂的能量景观以发现新的稳定相。
AI.method: 提出了一种隐式-显式信任域方法（implicit-explicit trust region method），旨在计算高维非凸能量景观中的二阶平稳点，从而确保收敛至局部极小值。
AI.result: 发现了此前在Landau-Brazovskii模型中未被识别的FDDD立方相，并据此构建了更新后的模型相图，验证了所提算法在定位稳定相方面的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 通过计算二阶平稳点，成功识别出LB模型中未曾发现的FDDD立方相，并更新了其相图，证明了该计算范式在发现新稳定相方面的有效性。
AI.translation: 在这项工作中，我们报告了一种稳定的有序结构——立方FDDD相，此前在Landau-Brazovskii (LB) 模型中尚未被识别。LB模型是研究晶体及其相变的一个基础且重要的模型。这一发现的关键在于所提出的用于计算LB模型高维非凸能量景观中二阶平稳点的隐式-显式信任域方法。与现有的仅能保证收敛到一阶平稳点且可能停滞在鞍点的一阶梯度算法不同，该方法在理论上保证收敛到对应于局部极小值的二阶平稳点。数值实验验证了该算法的理论性质，并证明了其从不同初始条件定位稳定相的鲁棒性。基于所发现的FDDD相，我们进一步构建了更新后的LB模型相图并确定了其稳定区域。这些结果表明，针对二阶平稳点为探索复杂自由能景观和揭示新的稳定相提供了一种有效的计算范式。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种用于计算Landau-Brazovskii模型中二阶平稳点的隐式-显式信任域算法，有效克服了传统一阶算法易陷入鞍点的缺陷。通过该方法，研究人员成功发现了LB模型中此前未知的FDDD立方相，并更新了相应的相图，证明了该方法在探索复杂能量景观中的优越性。
AI.keywords: Landau-Brazovskii模型, 二阶平稳点, 信任域方法, FDDD相, 能量景观
AI.comments: 该研究通过引入二阶平稳点计算方法，成功突破了传统一阶梯度算法容易陷入鞍点的局限性，为探索复杂能量景观下的新物理相提供了一种强有力的计算工具，具有重要的理论与应用价值。

title: A Numerical PDEs Approach to Evolution Equations in Shape Analysis Based on Regularized Morphoelasticity
summary: This work studies a variational formulation and numerical solution of a regularized morphoelasticity problem of shape evolution. The foundation of our analysis is based on the governing equations of linear elasticity, extended to account for volumetric growth. In the morphoelastic framework, the total deformation is decomposed into an elastic component and a growth component, represented by a growth tensor $G$. While the forward one-step problem -- computing displacement given a growth tensor -- is well-established, a more challenging and relevant question in biological modeling is the inverse problem in a continuous sense. While this problem is fundamentally ill-posed without additional constraints, we will explore parametrized growth models inscribed within an optimal control problem inspired by the Large Deformation Diffeomorphic Metric Mapping (LDDMM) framework. By treating the growth process as a path within a shape space, we can define a physically meaningful metric and seek the most plausible, energy-efficient trajectory between configurations. In the construction, a high-order regularization term is introduced. This elevates the governing equations to a high-order elliptic system, ensuring the existence of a smooth solution. This dissertation focuses on the issue of solving this equation efficiently, as this is a key requirement for the feasibility of the overall approach. This will be achieved with the help of finite element solvers, notably from the FEniCSx library in Python. Also, we implement a Mixed Finite Element Method, which decomposes the problem into a system of coupled second-order equations as a treatment of these high-order systems that have significant computational challenges.

AI.title_translation: 基于正则化形态弹性学的形状分析演化方程的偏微分方程数值方法
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种基于正则化形态弹性学的形状演化数值方法，通过将变形分解为弹性和生长部分，并利用最优控制理论和有限元方法解决反演问题，以实现高效的形状演化模拟。
AI.motivation: 生物建模中的形状演化反演问题具有挑战性且至关重要，需要开发能够高效解决相关方程的数值方法。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于正则化形态弹性学的变分法和数值解法，将总变形分解为弹性和生长分量。利用最优控制理论和类LDDMM框架处理反演问题，并引入高阶正则化项将控制方程转化为高阶椭圆系统。采用混合有限元方法（MFEM）和FEniCSx库进行数值求解。
AI.result: 开发了一种高效的数值方法，能够求解高阶椭圆系统，为形态弹性学中的形状演化问题提供可行的解决方案。
AI.conclusion: 通过正则化形态弹性学、最优控制和混合有限元方法，可以有效地解决形状演化问题，为生物建模和形状分析提供了新的途径。
AI.translation: 本研究研究了正则化形态弹性学形状演化问题的变分法和数值解。我们的分析基础是线性弹性学的控制方程，并扩展以考虑体积增长。在形态弹性学框架中，总变形被分解为弹性分量和生长分量，由生长张量 G 表示。虽然前向单步问题——给定生长张量计算位移——已经很成熟，但生物建模中一个更具挑战性且相关的问题是连续意义上的反演问题。虽然此问题在没有附加约束的情况下根本上是适得其反的，但我们将探索嵌入到受大变形微分同胚度量映射（LDDMM）框架启发的最佳控制问题中的参数化生长模型。通过将生长过程视为形状空间中的一个路径，我们可以定义一个物理上有意义的度量，并寻找配置之间最合理、能量最低的轨迹。在构造中，引入了一个高阶正则化项。这使得控制方程成为一个高阶椭圆系统，确保了光滑解的存在。本论文的重点是高效求解该方程的问题，因为这是整个方法可行性的关键要求。这将在有限元求解器的帮助下实现，特别是来自 Python 的 FEniCSx 库。此外，我们还实施了一种混合有限元方法，该方法将问题分解为一组耦合的二阶方程，作为处理这些具有重大计算挑战的高阶系统的手段。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种基于正则化形态弹性学的形状演化数值方法。该方法将变形分解为弹性和生长部分，并利用最优控制理论来解决具有挑战性的反演问题。通过引入高阶正则化项，将控制方程转化为高阶椭圆系统，并采用混合有限元方法和FEniCSx库进行高效求解，旨在为生物建模和形状分析提供一种可行的解决方案。
AI.keywords: 形态弹性学, 形状演化, 最优控制, 有限元方法, 正则化
AI.comments: 该研究在形态弹性学领域提出了创新的数值方法，特别是在处理形状演化的反演问题方面。通过结合最优控制理论和高阶正则化技术，以及利用先进的有限元求解器，有望解决生物建模中的关键挑战。然而，计算复杂性和模型的可扩展性可能是未来研究需要关注的方面。

title: Drift-Free Conservative Dynamics from Quantized Interaction Rules
summary: Conservation laws are conventionally discretized through floating-point flux evaluation, with invariants obtained by cancellation of approximate interface contributions and admissible weak solutions selected by reconstruction and Riemann solvers. Here we introduce an operator-level formulation in which conservative dynamics is realized as an exact discrete interaction rule on a quantized state space. The update is defined by an antisymmetric integer-transfer operator, which enforces conservation exactly at the arithmetic level and eliminates round-off drift from the primitive evolution \cite{highamAccuracyStabilityNumerical2002}. For scalar laws, monotone order-preserving transfers select admissible shock structures within the primitive update, rather than through flux reconstruction. Numerical experiments show that the interaction rule preserves high-frequency transport near the Nyquist limit and maintains sharply localized discontinuities in Burgers dynamics. The same construction extends to multidimensional problems and systems of conservation laws through oriented, vector-valued integer transfers. These results indicate that conservative dynamics admits an exact discrete realization in which both invariance and entropy selection are encoded at the operator level, rather than arising from approximate flux cancellation.

AI.title_translation: 源自量化交互规则的无漂移保守动力学
AI.tldr: 通过使用整数传递算子在量化空间实现动力学，消除了数值模拟中的浮点漂移并精确满足守恒律。
AI.motivation: 传统数值方法在处理守恒律时依赖浮点通量评估，导致存在近似抵消误差和数值漂移，且通常需要额外的通量重构和黎曼求解器来保证物理有效性。
AI.method: 引入了一种算子级公式，在量化状态空间上使用反对称的整数传递算子来定义更新规则；对于标量守恒律，通过单调保序传递选择可接受的激波结构。
AI.result: 数值实验证明，该方法在接近奈奎斯特极限时能保持高频传输，并在Burgers方程中维持了尖锐的间断，且该方法可推广至多维问题和守恒律方程组。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，保守动力学可以实现精确的离散化，通过算子级的整数传递机制，不仅能严格满足守恒律，还能有效地进行熵选择，克服了传统浮点计算带来的数值漂移。
AI.translation: 守恒律通常通过浮点通量评估进行离散化，其不变量是通过近似界面贡献的抵消获得的，而可接受的弱解则是通过重构和黎曼求解器选择的。本文引入了一种算子级公式，其中保守动力学被实现为量化状态空间上的精确离散交互规则。更新由一个反对称的整数传递算子定义，该算子在算术层面严格执行守恒，并消除了原始演化中的舍入漂移。对于标量定律，单调保序传递在原始更新中选择可接受的激波结构，而不是通过通量重构。数值实验表明，该交互规则保持了接近奈奎斯特极限的高频传输，并在Burgers动力学中保持了尖锐的局部间断。相同的构造通过定向的、向量值的整数传递扩展到多维问题和守恒律方程组。这些结果表明，保守动力学允许一种精确的离散实现，其中不变性和熵选择是在算子级别编码的，而不是由近似通量抵消产生的。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种在量化状态空间下实现保守动力学的算子级方法，通过使用反对称整数传递算子，在算术层面严格执行守恒律并消除浮点漂移，同时通过单调传递实现熵选择，从而替代了传统的近似通量重构。
AI.keywords: 保守动力学, 量化状态空间, 整数传递算子, 熵选择, 离散守恒律
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的算子级方法，通过在量化状态空间上使用整数传递算子，从根本上解决了传统数值方法中浮点运算带来的漂移问题。其核心贡献在于将守恒律和熵条件直接内嵌到离散交互规则中，而非依赖于近似的通量重构，这对高精度、长时程的物理模拟具有重要意义。

title: Error Analysis of Time-Dependent Test Functions in the Semi-Lagrangian Discontinuous Finite Element Scheme Based on the Characteristic Galerkin Method
comments: Lack of experimental data and incorrect first proof method, currently unable to remedy
summary: This paper studies the time-dependent test-function error in the characteristic Galerkin-type semi-Lagrangian discontinuous finite element (CSLDG) method caused by numerical integration errors of the characteristic ODE solver, and its effect on convergence. Unlike classical finite element methods and standard DG methods, the test functions in CSLDG are constructed by characteristic backtracking. As a result, ODE errors affect not only the upstream integration region but also enter directly into the discrete weak formulation through perturbations of the test function support. Neglecting mesh geometric errors, we introduce an ideal auxiliary solution and an auxiliary solution retaining the test-function error, and derive the corresponding error equation and recursive relations. First, based on a global time-dependent test-function error analysis, we show that the optimal $L^2$ convergence order of the $P^K$-CSLDG method is preserved provided that the ODE solver order satisfies $D\ge 2K+3+d$. We then propose a new analysis based on the propagation of local modal coefficient errors, which controls the error cell by cell through the actual modal update formulas and recovers the global $L^2$ estimate. This leads to an improved sufficient condition $D\ge K+1+\frac{d}{2}$. The results show that the required ODE accuracy depends strongly on the analytical route, and that the modal-coefficient-based analysis is both closer to the actual implementation and more consistent with numerical observations.
comment: Lack of experimental data and incorrect first proof method, currently unable to remedy

AI.title_translation: 基于特征Galerkin方法的半拉格朗日间断有限元格式中时间依赖测试函数的误差分析
AI.tldr: 本文分析了CSLDG方法中特征ODE求解器误差对收敛性的影响，并提出了一种新的局部模态分析方法，放宽了对ODE求解器精度的理论要求。
AI.motivation: 在特征Galerkin型半拉格朗日间断有限元（CSLDG）方法中，特征ODE求解器的数值积分误差会通过测试函数的支持集扰动直接影响离散弱形式，需要明确该误差对收敛性的影响及所需的ODE求解器精度。
AI.method: 引入理想辅助解和带有测试函数误差的辅助解；推导误差方程和递归关系；对比全局时间依赖测试函数误差分析与基于局部模态系数误差传播的分析方法。
AI.result: 证明了在特定ODE求解器精度条件下（D≥K+1+d/2），P^K-CSLDG方法能够保持最优的L^2收敛阶，该结果比传统全局分析方法要求更低且更符合实际应用。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明了通过基于模态系数的局部误差分析，可以显著放宽对特征ODE求解器精度的理论要求（从 D≥2K+3+d 优化至 D≥K+1+d/2），使理论结果与数值观测更加一致。
AI.translation: 本文研究了在特征Galerkin型半拉格朗日间断有限元（CSLDG）方法中，由特征ODE求解器的数值积分误差引起的时间依赖测试函数误差及其对收敛性的影响。与经典有限元方法和标准DG方法不同，CSLDG中的测试函数是通过特征回溯构建的。因此，ODE误差不仅影响上游积分区域，还通过测试函数支持集的扰动直接进入离散弱形式。在忽略网格几何误差的前提下，我们引入了一个理想辅助解和一个保留测试函数误差的辅助解，并推导了相应的误差方程和递归关系。首先，基于全局时间依赖测试函数误差分析，我们证明了只要ODE求解器阶数满足 D≥2K+3+d，P^K-CSLDG方法的最优L^2收敛阶即可保持。随后，我们提出了一种基于局部模态系数误差传播的新分析方法，通过实际的模态更新公式逐单元控制误差，并恢复了全局L^2估计。这导致了一个改进的充分条件 D≥K+1+d/2。结果表明，所需的ODE精度在很大程度上取决于分析路径，且基于模态系数的分析既更接近实际实现，也与数值观察更一致。
AI.summary: 本文研究了CSLDG方法中特征ODE求解器产生的数值积分误差如何影响测试函数及其收敛性。通过推导误差递归关系，作者提出了一种基于局部模态系数误差传播的分析方法，优化了保持最优L^2收敛阶所需的ODE求解器精度条件，使其更符合实际数值观察。
AI.keywords: 半拉格朗日间断有限元, 特征Galerkin方法, 时间依赖测试函数, 误差分析, ODE求解器精度
AI.comments: 该研究通过提出一种基于局部模态系数误差传播的新分析框架，成功改进了CSLDG方法中对特征ODE求解器精度的要求。这一成果在理论上更贴近实际计算表现，为数值模拟中ODE求解器的选择提供了更合理的指导。

title: NSPOD: Accelerating Krylov solvers via DeepONet-learned POD subspaces
summary: The convergence of Krylov-based linear iterative solvers applied to parametric partial differential equations (PDEs) is often highly sensitive to the domain, its discretization, the location/values of the applied Dirichlet/Neumann boundary conditions, body forces and material properties, among others. We have previously introduced hybridization of classical linear iterative solvers with neural operators for specific geometries, but they tend to not perform well on geometries not previously seen during training. We partially addressed this challenge by introducing the deep operator network Geo-DeepONet and hybridizing it with Krylov-based iterative linear solvers, which, despite learning effectively across arbitrary unstructured meshes without requiring retraining, led to only modest reductions in iterations compared to state-of-the-art preconditioners. In this study we introduce Neural Subspace Proper Orthogonal Decomposition (NSPOD), a multigrid-like deep operator network-based preconditioner which can dramatically reduce the number of iterations needed for convergence in Krylov-based linear iterative solvers, even when compared to state-of-the-art methods such as algebraic multigrid preconditioners. We demonstrate its efficiency via numerical experiments on a linearized version of solid mechanics PDEs applied to unstructured domains obtained from complex CAD geometries. We expect that the findings in this study lead to more efficient hybrid preconditioners that can match, or possibly even surpass, the convergence properties of the current gold standard preconditioning methods for solid mechanics PDEs.

AI.title_translation: NSPOD：通过DeepONet学习的POD子空间加速Krylov求解器
AI.tldr: NSPOD利用深度学习算子网络学习POD子空间，为参数化PDE提供了一种比传统代数多重网格更高效的预处理方案。
AI.motivation: 现有的Krylov求解器在处理参数化偏微分方程时，对几何变化非常敏感，且以往的神经算子方法在处理未见过的几何形状时泛化能力较差，或仅能带来有限的迭代次数优化。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为NSPOD的方法，这是一种基于深度算子网络的多重网格风格预处理技术，旨在通过学习POD子空间来加速Krylov迭代求解器。
AI.result: 数值实验表明，NSPOD在处理复杂CAD几何形状的非结构化网格上的线性化固体力学PDE时，能够显著减少收敛所需的迭代次数，表现优于现有的代数多重网格预处理方法。
AI.conclusion: NSPOD证明了深度学习算子网络可以作为一种高效的预处理手段，在处理复杂几何结构和参数化PDE时，能够超越传统的代数多重网格预处理方法。
AI.translation: 基于Krylov的线性迭代求解器在应用于参数化偏微分方程（PDEs）时，其收敛性往往对领域、离散化、Dirichlet/Neumann边界条件的位置/值、体力以及材料属性等高度敏感。我们之前曾引入经典线性迭代求解器与神经算子的混合方法以应对特定几何形状，但它们在训练期间未见过的几何形状上表现不佳。我们通过引入深度算子网络Geo-DeepONet并将其与基于Krylov的迭代线性求解器混合，部分解决了这一挑战。尽管该方法能在任意非结构化网格上有效学习而无需重新训练，但与最先进的预处理技术相比，迭代次数的减少仅属一般。在本研究中，我们引入了神经子空间本征正交分解（NSPOD），这是一种基于多重网格风格的深度算子网络预处理技术，与代数多重网格预处理等最先进的方法相比，它能显著减少基于Krylov的线性迭代求解器收敛所需的迭代次数。我们通过在从复杂CAD几何形状获得的非结构化领域上应用的线性化固体力学PDE的数值实验，证明了其效率。我们期望本研究的发现能带来更高效的混合预处理技术，使其能够匹配，甚至可能超越当前固体力学PDE预处理方法的黄金标准。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为NSPOD的深度算子网络预处理技术，通过学习POD子空间来加速参数化偏微分方程的Krylov求解过程。该方法在处理复杂非结构化网格的固体力学问题时，展现出比传统代数多重网格预处理方法更快的收敛速度。
AI.keywords: NSPOD, Krylov求解器, 深度算子网络, POD, 预处理
AI.comments: 该研究通过将DeepONet与POD技术结合，成功解决了参数化偏微分方程在复杂几何形状下求解慢的问题。其创新之处在于提出了一种多重网格风格的预处理方法，在保证泛化性的同时显著提升了收敛速度，具有很高的实用价值和理论意义。

title: On Discrete-Time Approximations to Infinite Horizon Differential Games
summary: In this paper we study a discrete-time semidiscretization and a fully discretization (discrete-time, discrete-state) of an infinite time horizon noncooperative $N$-player differential game. We prove that as either the discretization time step or both time step and mesh size parameters approach zero the discrete value function approximates the value function of the differential game. Furthermore, the discrete Nash equilibrium is an $ε$-Nash equilibrium for the continuous-time differential game both in the discrete-time and fully discrete cases.

title: Compactly supported, orthogonal, continuous piecewise polynomial multiresolution analysis
summary: We present explicit representations in terms of hypergeometric functions for the scaling functions in the $C^0$ orthogonal multiresolution analyses associated with piecewise continuous polynomials. Closed formulas for the Mellin transform of these functions as well as their Fourier transforms are derived. Some new multiresolution analyses whose scaling functions have coefficients that are rational numbers are introduced and discussed.

title: Spectral Gaps with Quantum Counting Queries and Oblivious State Preparation
summary: Approximating the $k$-th spectral gap $Δ_k=|λ_k-λ_{k+1}|$ and the corresponding midpoint $μ_k=\frac{λ_k+λ_{k+1}}{2}$ of an $N\times N$ Hermitian matrix with eigenvalues $λ_1\geqλ_2\geq\ldots\geqλ_N$, is an important special case of the eigenproblem with numerous applications in science and engineering. In this work, we present a quantum algorithm which approximates these values up to additive error $εΔ_k$ using a logarithmic number of qubits. Notably, in the QRAM model, its total complexity (queries and gates) is bounded by $O\left( \frac{N^2}{ε^{2}Δ_k^2}\mathrm{polylog}\left( N,\frac{1}{Δ_k},\frac{1}ε,\frac{1}δ\right)\right)$, where $ε,δ\in(0,1)$ are the accuracy and the failure probability, respectively. For large gaps $Δ_k$, this provides a speed-up against the best-known complexities of classical algorithms, namely, $O \left( N^ω\mathrm{polylog} \left( N,\frac{1}{Δ_k},\frac{1}ε\right)\right)$, where $ω\lesssim 2.371$ is the matrix multiplication exponent. A key technical step in the analysis is the preparation of a suitable random initial state, which ultimately allows us to efficiently count the number of eigenvalues that are smaller than a threshold, while maintaining a quadratic complexity in $N$. In the black-box access model, we also report an $Ω(N^2)$ query lower bound for deciding the existence of a spectral gap in a binary (albeit non-symmetric) matrix.

title: Explicit and Effectively Symmetric Schemes for Neural SDEs on Lie Groups
summary: Backpropagation through (neural) SDE solvers is traditionally approached in two ways: discretise-then-optimise, which offers accurate gradients but incurs prohibitive memory costs; and optimise-then-discretise, which achieves constant memory cost by solving an auxiliary backward SDE, but suffers from slower evaluation and gradient approximation errors. Algebraically reversible solvers promise both memory efficiency and gradient accuracy, yet existing methods such as Reversible Heun are often unstable under complex models and large step sizes, and their non-standard auxiliary-state structure obstructs extension to manifold-valued SDEs. Building on the recently introduced Explicit and Effectively Symmetric (EES) schemes - a class of stable, near-reversible explicit Runge--Kutta methods - we address both limitations of existing schemes. We extend EES schemes from ODEs to SDEs and show that they admit an efficient Williamson 2N-storage realisation. Bazavov's commutator-free construction then lifts these schemes to arbitrary Lie groups and homogeneous spaces. To our knowledge, this is the first explicit (near-)reversible integrator in this setting, unlocking the reversible adjoint approach for manifold-valued problems. On Euclidean neural SDE benchmarks, our schemes improve stability under stiff drift and large steps compared with other reversible solvers, while the commutator-free lift reduces memory by up to an order of magnitude on manifold-valued problems versus other baselines. These results establish effectively symmetric integration as a unified, geometry-aware foundation for memory-efficient and stable training of neural SDEs.

title: Deep set based operator learning with uncertainty quantification
summary: Learning operators from data is central to scientific machine learning. While DeepONets are widely used for their ability to handle complex domains, they require fixed sensor numbers and locations, lack mechanisms for uncertainty quantification, and are thus limited in practical applicability. Recent permutation-invariant extensions, such as the Variable-Input Deep Operator Network, relax these sensor constraints but still rely on sufficiently dense observations and cannot capture uncertainties arising from incomplete measurements or from operators with inherent randomness. To address these challenges, we propose UQ-SONet, a permutation-invariant operator learning framework with built-in uncertainty quantification. Our model integrates a set transformer embedding to handle sparse and variable sensor locations, and employs a conditional variational autoencoder to approximate the conditional distribution of the solution operator. By minimizing the negative ELBO, UQ-SONet provides principled uncertainty estimation while maintaining predictive accuracy. Numerical experiments on deterministic and stochastic PDEs, including the Navier-Stokes equation, demonstrate the robustness and effectiveness of the proposed framework.

title: Adaptive digital twins for predictive decision-making: Online Bayesian learning of transition dynamics
summary: This work shows how adaptivity can enhance value realization of digital twins in civil engineering. We focus on adapting the state transition models within digital twins represented through probabilistic graphical models. The bi-directional interaction between the physical and virtual domains is modeled using dynamic Bayesian networks. By treating state transition probabilities as random variables endowed with conjugate priors, we enable hierarchical online learning of transition dynamics from a state to another through effortless Bayesian updates. We provide the mathematical framework to account for a larger class of distributions with respect to the current literature on digital twins. To compute dynamic policies with precision updates we solve parametric Markov decision processes through reinforcement learning. The proposed adaptive digital twin framework enjoys enhanced personalization, increased robustness, and improved cost-effectiveness. We assess our approach on a case study involving structural health monitoring and maintenance planning of a railway bridge.

title: Discrete Double-Bracket Flows for Isotropic-Noise Invariant Eigendecomposition
summary: We study eigendecomposition on $SO(n)$ under streaming observations $C_k = C_{\mathrm{sig}} + σ_k^2 I + E_k$, where the isotropic background $σ_k^2 I$ may be time-varying and arbitrarily large. Standard algorithms couple their stability to $\lVert C_k \rVert_2 \approx σ^2$, forcing step sizes, contraction rates, and iteration counts to degrade with the noise floor. We observe that $σ^2 I$ lies in the center of the matrix algebra and therefore *should never enter* the eigenspace dynamics. We construct a discrete double-bracket flow whose skew-symmetric generator $Ω= [A, \operatorname{diag}(A)]$ operates in the tangent Lie algebra $\mathfrak{so}(n)$, where scalar multiples of the identity vanish by antisymmetry. The resulting trajectory, Lyapunov function, and maximal stable step size $η_{\max} = 1/L_C$ depend exclusively on the trace-free signal $C_e$ -- achieving pointwise, pathwise $σ^2$-invariance. We establish input-to-state stability with a noise ball governed solely by trace-free perturbations, prove global convergence via strict-saddle geometry and a discrete Łojasiewicz argument, and extend the framework to top-$k$ eigentracking on the Stiefel manifold $\operatorname{St}(k,n)$ at cost $k$ matrix-vector products per step.

title: Utility-Aware Progressive Inference over UDP Packet Blocks for Emergency Communications
summary: Emergency communications increasingly rely on remote visual inference for timely hazard detection under stringent bandwidth and latency constraints. However, conventional UDP-based visual delivery typically performs inference only after the full payload has been received, even though partially received packet blocks may already contain sufficient task-relevant evidence for reliable decision making. This paper proposes a utility-aware progressive inference framework for emergency communications, which operates directly on UDP packet blocks and determines when sufficient task value has been accumulated for early hazard recognition. Specifically, the sender estimates packet-level decision utility as lightweight control metadata, while the receiver progressively updates partial observations, accumulates the utility of received packets, and triggers an early stop once the normalized utility exceeds a prescribed threshold. Experiments on a fire-scene detection dataset show that, at the main operating point, the proposed method reduces the average packet budget by 34.2% and the decision delay by 1209.17 ms while retaining 91.5% of the full-reception match rate. The method also maintains its advantage over the stability-based baseline under moderate packet loss and different packet-arrival orders. These results demonstrate that packet-level utility provides an effective basis for communication-efficient and delay-aware hazard recognition over UDP-based emergency links.

title: Environment-Conditioned Diffusion Meta-Learning for Data-Efficient WiFi Localization
summary: Fingerprinting-based localization often suffers from poor cross-environment generalization, especially when only a few labeled samples are available in the target environment. Existing methods mitigate distribution shifts through domain adaptation or improved signal representations, but they usually ignore environmental geometry or use it in a deterministic manner, limiting their ability to capture diverse multipath variations in complex propagation conditions. To address this issue, we propose EnvCoLoc, an environment-conditioned diffusion meta-learning framework for few-shot fingerprinting localization. EnvCoLoc extracts structured descriptors from 3D point clouds and uses them to condition a latent diffusion generator, which produces environment-specific parameter offsets to modulate a shared meta-learned initialization. This design injects geometry-aware priors into the adaptation process and provides more informative initializations for new environments. To learn the stochastic mapping from coarse environmental descriptors to high-dimensional parameter corrections under limited data, the diffusion generator and localization network are jointly optimized within a two-loop meta-learning framework. The generated offsets capture systematic environment-dependent variations, while gradient-based inner-loop adaptation further refines the model to reduce residual task-specific mismatch. We also provide an excess-loss analysis for finite-step adaptation, theoretically supporting the benefit of geometry-aware initialization. Real-world experiments show that EnvCoLoc consistently improves localization accuracy over baseline methods, achieving up to a 20.0% reduction in mean localization error in NLOS scenarios with only 10 support samples.

title: Polarization-Aware Ray-Tracing Enhanced Back-Projection Algorithm for Microwave Imaging in Complex Multipath Environments
comments: This article has been published in the Proceedings of the 2025 International Symposium on Electromagnetic Theory (URSI EMTS 2025). \c{opyright} 2025 IEEE. Personal use of this material is permitted. Permission from IEEE must be obtained for all other uses, in any current or future media. Citation information: DOI: 10.46620/URSIEMTS25/RKHF8213
summary: A ray-tracing (RT) enhanced back-projection algorithm (RT-BPA) for microwave imaging in multipath environments is presented. By tightly incorporating the concept of ray-tracing into a generalized version of traditional BPA, this method ensures improved image quality by addressing two important issues. First, when the line-of-sight (LOS) path is obstructed, reflected paths, if available, enable imaging of hidden targets, which extends the applicability of the standard BPA beyond its normal use case. Second, the consideration of reflected ray-paths is equivalent to virtually increasing the aperture size, thus, improving image resolution without requiring new measurements. A key factor in achieving these advancements is the consideration of the vector nature of electromagnetic waves with polarization-dependent phase compensation, which is often ignored when employing a scalar-wave based formulation of the electromagnetic vector field. In addition, the presented method employs a shooting and bouncing rays (SBR) framework, offering better flexibility compared to manual path evaluation in existing RT-BPAs.

title: A Generative AI-Enhanced Digital Twin Framework for Proactive Interference Management in Hybrid Near/Far-Field Wireless Systems
summary: The applications of Digital Twins (DT) and Generative AI (GenAI) have demonstrated their capabilities in modeling and learning-based wireless communications. However, their joint potential for proactive wireless system design remains largely underexplored, particularly in extremely large-scale multiple-input multiple-output (XL-MIMO) networks, characterized by hybrid near-field (NF) and far-field (FF) propagation regimes. In this work, we propose an integrated GenAI-enhanced DT framework for proactive interference management in dynamic indoor scenarios. The DT constructs a high-resolution, site-specific virtual replica of the deployment environment, understanding where and why blockage occurs within a realistic 3D representation of the indoor space. Integration of the GenAI module further assists the framework in anticipating and proactively suppressing blockage, rather than reacting after the disruption occurs. Extensive simulation results based on Sionna ray-tracing datasets demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves significant improvements in interference suppression, signal-to-interference-plus-noise ratio (SINR), and outage probability compared to conventional reactive schemes and purely deterministic DT-based approaches.

title: LO-Free Receiver: Next-Gen Low-Power Joint Communication and Sensing
comments: The paper was accepted by VTC
summary: This paper introduces and analyzes Spatial Phase Manifold Communications (SPMC), a paradigm that facilitates joint communication and sensing (JCAS) over Local Oscillator (LO) free receiver. Information is embedded in, and recovered from, the relative spatial phase between antennas. In contrast to conventional coherent receivers that rely on LOs and on channel estimation/equalization, SPMC exploits antenna-domain correlation to form a baseband observable that is a function of inter-antenna phase differences. Since these phase differences are fundamentally tied to Direction-of-Arrival (DoA) and vice-versa, the formulation recasts communication and sensing as inference over the unit-circle manifold and thus naturally supports JCAS decomposition, i.e., data and spatial sensing are encoded and recovered through DoA signatures. We develop a comprehensive framework comprising: (i) a manifold-domain signal model and corresponding phase-alphabet design; (ii) an LO-free quadrature spatial-correlator receiver architecture that resolves the phase-sign ambiguity without requiring an LO; and (iii) an analysis of error probability and sensing precision, including robustness to phase noise. The proposed paradigm is particularly suited to massive Internet-of-Things (IoT) deployments, for which hardware simplicity, LO distribution cost, power consumption, and seamless sensing integration are critical, especially at millimeter-wave and higher carrier frequencies.
comment: The paper was accepted by VTC

title: Unsupervised Online Channel Estimation for High-Mobility OFDM via Implicit Neural Representation
summary: Accurate channel estimation remains challenging in high-mobility wireless systems because Doppler shifts induce severe inter-carrier interference (ICI) in Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDM). We propose an unsupervised online channel estimation framework based on Implicit Neural Representation (INR). Unlike discrete-grid estimators, the proposed method decouples channel representation from the OFDM sampling resolution by modeling the time-varying frequency-selective channel as a continuous function of time-frequency coordinates. A Sinusoidal Representation Network (SIREN) with Gaussian Fourier feature mapping captures fine-grained channel variations and high-frequency details without offline pre-training or labeled data. For each received slot, the network parameters are updated by per-slot online fitting that minimizes a physics-aware ICI loss, while a confidence-aware decision-directed loop balances reliable pilots and dynamically harvested pseudo-pilots. Simulations in realistic Vehicle-to-Everything (V2X) environments show that the proposed method achieves near-optimal link-level reliability, significantly outperforming Least Squares (LS) and robust Linear Minimum Mean Square Error (LMMSE) estimators. Compared with supervised deep learning baselines, it also exhibits strong out-of-distribution (OOD) robustness under environmental distribution shifts, establishing an adaptable data-efficient physical-layer paradigm.

title: Signal-Dependent Shot Noise Modeling of Rydberg Atomic Quantum Receivers: A Design Perspective
summary: In this paper, we develop a communication-oriented complex baseband equivalent model for superheterodyne Rydberg atomic quantum receivers (RAQRs). The model explicitly captures photodetection-induced signal-dependent shot noise and its coupling with the optical operating point. By leveraging an atomic superheterodyne architecture and a strong local oscillator, we construct a complex baseband representation for both the received signal and the signal-dependent shot noise under both direct incoherent optical detection and balanced coherent optical detection. The derived model reveals that the optical operating point jointly determines the normalized effective receive gain and the equivalent noise background, thereby establishing a traceable gain-noise tradeoff governed by system design. More importantly, the proposed model shows that neglecting signal-dependent shot noise may lead to inaccurate operating-point design. Finally, by extending to the multiple-input-multiple-output (MIMO) case, we derive a lower bound on the achievable rate while considering the signal-dependent shot noise. Our analysis \textcolor{black}{reveals} that the non-zero asymptotic rate of RAQ-MIMO and its superiority over conventional RF-MIMO hinge on the normalized noise floor of the RAQ receive chain falling below that of RF MIMO. Simulation results validate our analysis and yield practical, closed-form design guidelines for RAQR front ends, revealing parameter regimes in which RAQ-MIMO outperforms conventional MIMO systems.

title: Quantifying System Level KPI Deviations of Sionna RT: Material and Near-Field Error Analysis Using a 5G OAI Testbed
summary: Ray tracing (RT) has recently gained renewed interest in wireless communications, driven by its integration into digital twin (DT) frameworks for site specific channel modeling. Several previous studies have validated RT at the channel level, yet how these errors propagate into real 5G system level key performance indicators (KPIs) on actual hardware remains unquantified. This paper addresses this gap by comparing Sionna RT simulated channels against vector network analyzer (VNA) measured channels using an OpenAirInterface (OAI) 5G NR testbed. Channel measurements are conducted at 20 receiver positions in an indoor laboratory, with both channel types injected into a hardware in the loop channel emulator interfacing an OAIBOX MAX base station and a Quectel UE. RSRP, PUCCH SNR, and SINR are evaluated under both conditions. The results identify antenna near-field transition effects as a critical position-dependent error source, alongside material property mismatch, providing a quantitative benchmark for digital twin-based 5G and beyond network planning.

title: SF-Flow: Sound field magnitude estimation via flow matching guided by sparse measurements
summary: Reconstructing a 3D sound field from sparse microphone measurements is a fundamental yet ill-posed problem, which we address through Acoustic Transfer Function (ATF) magnitude estimation. ATF magnitude encapsulates key perceptual and acoustic properties of a physical space with applications in room characterization and correction. Although recent generative paradigms such as Flow Matching (FM) have achieved state-of-the-art performance in speech and music generation, their potential in spatial audio remains underexplored. We propose a novel framework for 3D ATF magnitude reconstruction as a guided generation task, with a 3D U-Net conditioned by a permutation-invariant set encoder. This architecture enables reconstruction from an arbitrary number of sparse inputs while leveraging the stable and efficient training properties of FM. Experimental results demonstrate that SF-Flow achieves accurate reconstruction up to \SI{1}{kHz}, trains substantially faster than the autoencoder baseline, and improves significantly with dataset size.

title: Exponential Noise Robustness of Type-Based Multiple Access for Over-the-Air Computation
summary: This paper studies the robustness of type-based multiple access (TBMA) in over-the-air computation (AirComp) under nonparametric estimation, where no prior knowledge of the data distribution is available. While conventional AirComp approaches rely on amplitude modulations and suffer from noise sensitivity, TBMA enables the use of more structured modulation formats that can be exploited for improved performance. We show that the superposition of transmitted signals in TBMA induces a discrete lattice structure in the received signal space, where each lattice point corresponds to the number of devices accessing a given channel resource. By exploiting this structure through nearest-lattice-point projection, noise effects can be substantially suppressed. The proposed technique achieves an exponential decay of the mean squared error (MSE) with respect to the energy-to-noise spectral density ratio, whereas in conventional techniques the MSE only scales inversely with this ratio. Simulation results validate the theoretical findings and demonstrate that TBMA provides a fundamental robustness advantage over traditional AirComp.

title: RIS-assisted Multiuser MISO Transmission and the Impact of Imperfect Channel Estimation
comments: This work has been accepted for publication in IEEE Communications Letters. The final published version is available via IEEE Xplore
summary: This paper proposes the joint design of reconfigurable intelligent surfaces (RIS) and zero-forcing (ZF) precoding for the downlink (DL) multiuser multiple-input single-output (MU-MISO) setup in millimeter-wave (mmWave) bands, where ZF is particularly attractive due to its ability to suppress inter-user interference by exploiting the large antenna arrays and sparse directional channels characteristic of mmWave systems. This ensures efficient spatial multiplexing with manageable complexity, making ZF a practical and in modern 5G/6G deployments. However, a careful design is necessary to overcome potential rank deficiency in the channel matrix. For the MU-MISO case, rank deficiency may arise if users exhibit significantly different channel gains or if, being in far-field, they are aligned with the position of the transmitter. On the other hand, the deployment of a RIS introduces artificial scattering which can shape the radio environment to address those situations. We explore the joint design under perfect channel knowledge, assess the impact of imperfect channel estimation on the bit error rate (BER) and propose a robust design of pilot transmissions that equalizes multiuser interference across users in the presence of channel errors in the precoder design. This evaluation shows the advantages of optimized RIS-aided ZF MU-MISO communication for the DL of wireless systems.
